title: RPA: Residual Patch-Token Adapter for Image Retrieval from EEG and MEG
comment: 34 pages, 13 figures
summary: Most existing MEG and EEG (M/EEG) visual decoding methods align brain signals with a single global embedding extracted from a pretrained visual encoder, leaving open whether intermediate patch representations, which preserve richer and more granular rich visual information, can improve representation learning. To address this question, we introduce the Residual Patch Adapter (RPA), a lightweight, modular adapter that leverages all patch tokens from an intermediate layer of a ViT visual encoder for alignment. Through extensive ablation analyses, we first show that pooling or masking patch tokens degrades the learned representation, demonstrating that retaining the full set of patch tokens is important for EEG alignment, while the CLS token provides little unique information. We then use a series of six quantitative feature analyses to show that both higher-level semantics and lower-level visual features, including color and texture, are essential for this EEG-to-image alignment. Under current protocols, our system achieves Top-1 accuracies of 95.4\% within-subject and 35.5\% cross-subject on THINGS-EEG2, and 65.2\% and 6.7\%, respectively, on THINGS-MEG, achieving state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance across both datasets. Evaluations with alternative brain encoders, including pretrained EEG foundation models, demonstrate that the approach extends beyond the projection-based EEG encoder. Furthermore, we provide a plug-and-play interface that allows RPA to be replaced by convolution, attention, or ConvNeXt alternatives. Together, these findings provide significant insight into M/EEG-to-image representation learning by establishing design principles for leveraging the latent space of visual encoders, and open new directions for brain--image alignment and non-invasive brain--computer interface (BCI).

AI.tldr: 本文提出残差Patch适配器（RPA），利用ViT中间层的全部patch token进行M/EEG-图像对齐，在THINGS-EEG2和THINGS-MEG上取得SOTA，并揭示保留完整patch token与结合高低层视觉特征的重要性。
AI.motivation: 现有M/EEG视觉解码方法多将脑信号与预训练视觉编码器的单一全局嵌入对齐，未验证保留更丰富细粒度信息的中间层patch表示能否提升表示学习。论文旨在回答该问题并建立利用视觉编码器隐空间的设计原则。
AI.method: 提出轻量模块化的残差Patch适配器（RPA），对齐ViT视觉编码器中间层的所有patch token。通过消融实验比较pooling/掩码patch token与CLS token的作用；使用六项定量特征分析考察高层语义与低层视觉特征（颜色、纹理）的必要性；并验证方法在替代脑编码器（含预训练EEG基础模型）上的泛化性，同时提供可插拔接口以支持卷积、注意力或ConvNeXt等替代。
AI.result: 在THINGS-EEG2上取得被试内Top-1 95.4%、跨被试35.5%；在THINGS-MEG上取得65.2%和6.7%，两数据集均达SOTA。消融显示pooling或掩码patch token会降低表示质量，CLS token提供的独特信息很少；高层语义与颜色、纹理等低层视觉特征对对齐均不可或缺。
AI.conclusion: 保留完整patch token对EEG对齐至关重要，高低层视觉特征均需纳入。研究为M/EEG-图像表示学习确立了利用视觉编码器隐空间的设计原则，并为脑-图像对齐与非侵入式BCI开辟新方向。

title: PanoSeg3R: Feed-Forward 3D Semantic Segmentation for Panoramic Images with an Automatic Data Curation Pipeline
summary: We present PanoSeg3R, a feed-forward framework for 3D panoramic semantic segmentation. Unlike existing methods designed for perspective inputs, PanoSeg3R jointly predicts 3D geometry and multi-view semantic segmentation in one single forward pass. Built upon a pretrained reconstruction backbone that supports panoramic images, our approach extends feed-forward 3D reconstruction with a query-based mask decoder. Furthermore, we introduce an automatic panorama data curation pipeline that leverages the complementary strengths of off-the-shelf foundation models to generate reliable pseudo semantic annotations, substantially expanding the training data and improving zero-shot generalization. PanoSeg3R achieves state-of-the-art performance on panoramic 3D semantic segmentation, improving 3D mIoU by up to 16.02 on ScanNet++, while the curated training data further improves zero-shot performance by up to 4.26 and 43.28 mIoU on Stanford2D3D and ToF-360, respectively. Website: https://harryyoon777.github.io/PanoSeg3R/

AI.tldr: PanoSeg3R是一个面向三维全景语义分割的前馈框架，单次前向即可联合预测三维几何与多视角语义分割，并在多个基准上取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有三维语义分割方法多针对透视输入设计，无法充分利用全景图像的整体场景覆盖能力；同时全景三维标注数据稀缺，制约了模型的泛化能力。
AI.method: 基于支持全景图像的重建骨干网络，将前馈三维重建扩展为查询（query）驱动的掩码解码器，实现几何与多视角语义的联合预测；并提出全景数据自动整理（curation）流水线，借助现成基础模型的互补能力生成可靠伪语义标注以扩充训练数据。
AI.result: 在全景三维语义分割上达到SOTA，ScanNet++上三维mIoU最高提升16.02；整理后的训练数据在Stanford2D3D与ToF-360上分别将零样本性能最高提升4.26与43.28 mIoU。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明统一的全景前馈重建-分割框架结合自动伪标注数据整理，能显著提升全景三维语义分割精度与零样本泛化能力。

title: Vision2CAD: A Visual Agent Harness for Explicit Geometry Referencing and Localization in Parametric CAD Modeling
summary: Generating parametric CAD models requires accurate geometry and stable feature dependencies. Existing methods face challenges in selecting geometric references, interpreting sketch-plane local coordinates, and establishing sketch constraints to projected external geometry. We present Vision2CAD, a visual agent harness that combines vision-language model (VLM) reasoning with deterministic CAD kernel operations. An ID-based interface supports explicit geometry selection, a local-coordinate bridge converts view coordinates into sketch coordinates, and projected-edge localization supports external sketch constraints. These mechanisms establish feature dependencies within the supported modeling operations and constraint types. We also introduce the Geometry Explicit Reference Dataset (GERD), which aligned commands, geometry states and IDs at every modeling step. On GERD-EVL and a DeepCAD test subset, Vision2CAD improves mIoU by 11.1\% and 5.6\% and reduces Chamfer distance by 17.3\% and 41.8\%, respectively. Parameter-editing experiments and ablation studies further proved the preservation of parametric dependencies.

AI.tldr: 提出 Vision2CAD 视觉智能体框架，将 VLM 推理与确定性 CAD 内核操作结合，并发布 GERD 数据集，提升参数化 CAD 生成的几何精度与特征依赖稳定性。
AI.motivation: 生成参数化 CAD 模型需要准确的几何表示和稳定的特征依赖关系。现有方法在几何参考选择、草图平面局部坐标解释、以及将草图约束关联到投影外部几何等方面存在困难。
AI.method: Vision2CAD 采用视觉智能体框架，融合 VLM 推理与确定性 CAD 内核操作。核心机制包括：基于 ID 的接口实现显式几何选择；局部坐标桥接将视图坐标转换为草图坐标；投影边定位支持外部草图约束。同时构建 Geometry Explicit Reference Dataset（GERD），在每个建模步骤对齐命令、几何状态与 ID。
AI.result: 在 GERD-EVL 和 DeepCAD 测试子集上，Vision2CAD 分别将 mIoU 提升 11.1% 和 5.6%，Chamfer 距离降低 17.3% 和 41.8%。参数编辑实验与消融研究进一步验证了参数依赖关系的保持。
AI.conclusion: Vision2CAD 通过在支持的建模操作与约束类型中建立特征依赖，有效提升了参数化 CAD 生成的几何精度和参数依赖稳定性。

title: COT-TTS: Audio Context-Aware Text-to-Speech with Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
comment: Under review at IEEE/ACM Transactions on Audio, Speech, and Language Processing (TASLP)
summary: Recently, text-to-speech systems have made significant progress in speech expressiveness and controllability. However, the speaking style of generated speech typically relies on clear user-specified instructions. In natural conversations, speaking style should be naturally inferred from the preceding conversational context. Therefore, we propose COT-TTS, a context-aware, reasoning-based text-to-speech task. Given historical conversation audio, target text, and a reference speech, the system should comprehend the conversational context, infer an explicit intermediate reasoning, and finally synthesize the target speech with the specified timbre. To support this task, we constructed a large-scale bilingual conversational speech dataset comprising 9 million training samples, including a high-quality subset of 1 million samples. We further constructed a source-disjoint benchmark with 800 human-verified samples and established strong task-specific baselines. Additionally, we developed end-to-end autoregressive models with parameter sizes of 0.6B and 1.7B, generating emotion-labeled transcripts, editable speech style inferences, and speech tokens. Experimental results show that the proposed model achieves performance comparable to large-scale baseline systems with significantly fewer parameters. At the same time, the model performs well in terms of duration consistency and emotional consistency, and can generate appropriate emotional, stress, and rhythmic variations based on the conversational context. To facilitate future research, we will publicly release the data construction pipeline, dataset, trained models, and related resources. The demo page and additional resources are available at https://luckybian.github.io/COT-TTS

AI.tldr: 提出COT-TTS：一种上下文感知、基于推理的文本到语音任务，需从历史对话音频、目标文本和参考语音中理解语境、推断显式中间推理并合成带指定音色的目标语音。构建900万条双语对话语音数据集（含100万高质量子集）与800条人工校验的源不相交基准，开发0.6B/1.7B端到端自回归模型，输出情感标注转写、可编辑语音风格推理与语音token。结果显示小参数量下性能可比大规模基线，在时长一致性与情感一致性上表现良好，并能依据对话语境生成情感、重音与韵律变化。
AI.motivation: 现有TTS在表现力与可控性上进步显著，但生成语音的说话风格通常依赖用户明确指定的指令；自然对话中，说话风格应从前置对话语境中自然推断。因此需要将语境理解与推理引入TTS，实现从对话历史自动推断风格。
AI.method: 定义COT-TTS任务：输入历史对话音频、目标文本与参考语音，系统理解对话语境、推断显式中间推理，再以指定音色合成目标语音。构建大规模双语对话语音数据集（900万训练样本，含100万高质量子集）与800条人工校验的源不相交基准，建立任务专用强基线。开发0.6B与1.7B端到端自回归模型，生成情感标注转写、可编辑语音风格推理及语音token。
AI.result: 所提模型在参数量显著更少的情况下达到与大规模基线系统相当的性能；在时长一致性与情感一致性方面表现良好，并可根据对话语境生成恰当的情感、重音与韵律变化。
AI.conclusion: COT-TTS将对话语境推理引入语音合成，验证了基于推理的上下文感知TTS的可行性，且小模型可媲美大规模基线。为促进后续研究，将公开数据构建流程、数据集、训练模型及相关资源。

title: LLaDA-PRM: A Bidirectional Step-Level Reasoning Evaluator
comment: 17 pages, 7 figures, 8 tables, including appendices
summary: Step-level reasoning evaluators are commonly based on autoregressive language models, whose causal attention restricts each step representation to the problem, previous steps, and the current step. Yet, when the complete solution is available, the validity of an earlier step may become clearer only through its downstream consequences. We validate this hypothesis through a controlled 54-run comparison of causal and bidirectional LLaDA evaluators at 1B--3B scale, changing only the self-attention mask, and find bidirectional attention yields consistent improvements. Building on this finding, we introduce \prm{}, an 8B bidirectional evaluator that reaches 88.8 step-level F1 on MR-MATH-invalid and 83.8 on the out-of-distribution MR-GSM8K original-question subset, outperforming ReasonEval-Llemma-34B by 11.3 and 10.3 F1 points, respectively. \prm{} also remains effective when evaluating incomplete reasoning traces in online settings, outperforming the strongest baselines on both benchmarks by a large margin. We further show that \prm{} provides an effective training-data selection signal, improving Mistral-7B performance on MATH-500.

AI.tldr: 本文提出双向注意力过程奖励模型（PRM），在1B-3B规模受控对比中验证双向注意力优于因果注意力，构建8B双向评估器，在MR-MATH-invalid与OOD MR-GSM8K上显著超越ReasonEval-Llemma-34B，并可有效用于在线评估与训练数据筛选。
AI.motivation: 现有步骤级推理评估器多基于自回归语言模型，其因果注意力使每步表示仅依赖问题、前序步骤与当前步骤；当完整解答可得时，某一步的正确性往往需借助后续步骤的下游结果才能判断，因此因果注意力存在信息受限问题。
AI.method: 在1B-3B规模上开展54组受控实验，仅改变自注意力掩码，对比因果与双向LLaDA评估器；基于该发现构建8B双向评估器PRM，用于步骤级评估、在线不完整推理轨迹评估及训练数据选择。
AI.result: 双向注意力带来一致性提升；PRM在MR-MATH-invalid上达88.8步骤级F1，在OOD MR-GSM8K原题子集上达83.8，分别超ReasonEval-Llemma-34B 11.3与10.3个F1点；在线不完整推理轨迹评估中大幅领先最强基线；作为训练数据选择信号提升Mistral-7B在MATH-500上的表现。
AI.conclusion: 双向注意力是步骤级推理评估的有效设计，PRM以更小规模取得更优性能，并具备在线评估与数据选择的应用价值。

title: Analyzing Public Discourse on Urbanism: Topic Clustering, Sentiment Analysis and Retrieval-Augmented Generation using YouTube Comments
summary: Online discourse about urban issues - walkability, cycling infrastructure, public transit, housing density, and street safety - is voluminous but unstructured, and existing city-evaluation tools capture none of it. We present a pipeline and conversational system that combines geographic entity resolution, topic modeling, sentiment analysis, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) over 22,788 chunks of YouTube transcripts and comments spanning 309 North American cities. Beyond the system itself, our contribution is a set of measurements about what happens when standard NLP components meet short, informal, geographically ambiguous text. A Twitter-tuned RoBERTa classifier outperforms a VADER lexicon baseline by 12.6 macro-F1 points (0.589 vs. 0.464; McNemar p = 0.0001), but both models collapse on the neutral class, which dominates urbanist comment traffic; annotators disagree on the same class (Cohen's kappa = 0.53). Dense retrieval beats a TF-IDF baseline at every cutoff (P@5 0.790 vs. 0.560), and video-level relevance proxies understate chunk-level precision by a wide margin (0.660 vs. 0.94 under human rating). For groundedness evaluation, we find BERTScore unusable when a multi-sentence generated summary is compared against a single short comment - scores are nearly flat regardless of relevance - and show that ROUGE-1-based groundedness is a paraphrase-driven lower bound rather than a hallucination rate. These findings generalize beyond the urbanist domain to any RAG system built over short user-generated documents.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个融合地理实体解析、主题建模、情感分析与RAG的城市议题对话系统，覆盖309个北美城市的22,788个YouTube文本块；其核心贡献在于系统测量标准NLP组件面对短文本、非正式、地理歧义内容时的表现，并揭示情感分类中性类崩塌、稠密检索优于TF-IDF、视频级相关性高估、BERTScore不可用等方法学问题。
AI.motivation: 城市议题（步行友好度、自行车基础设施、公共交通、住房密度、街道安全）的在线讨论数量庞大但高度非结构化，而现有城市评价工具完全无法捕捉这类数据。作者希望搭建管道与对话系统加以利用，更重要的动机是系统性地量化"标准NLP组件作用于短、非正式、地理歧义文本"时会发生什么，从而为同类RAG系统提供可复用的经验证据。
AI.method: 方法上，构建了一条处理管道与对话系统，整合地理实体解析、主题建模、情感分析与检索增强生成（RAG），数据为覆盖309个北美城市的22,788个YouTube转录文本与评论块。评测方面：(1) 用Twitter调优的RoBERTa分类器与VADER词典基线做情感对比，采用macro-F1与McNemar检验，并用Cohen's kappa衡量标注者一致性；(2) 对比稠密检索与TF-IDF基线的P@K；(3) 比较视频级相关性代理与chunk级精度（人工评分）；(4) 用BERTScore与基于ROUGE-1的groundedness指标评估多句生成摘要对单条短评论的忠实度。
AI.result: 结果：RoBERTa较VADER提升12.6个macro-F1点（0.589 vs. 0.464，McNemar p=0.0001），但两者在中性类上均崩塌，而中性类在城市议题评论中占主导，标注者对该类一致性也低（Cohen's kappa=0.53）。稠密检索在各截断点均优于TF-IDF（P@5 0.790 vs. 0.560）。视频级相关性代理严重低估chunk级精度（0.660 vs. 人工评分0.94）。groundedness评估中，BERTScore在多句摘要对单条短评论时几乎无区分度、不可用；基于ROUGE-1的groundedness只是复述驱动的下界，并非幻觉率。
AI.conclusion: 作者认为，这些发现不局限于城市议题领域，而是可推广到任何建立在短篇用户生成文档之上的RAG系统：标准NLP组件与评估指标在此类文本上会系统性失效，需谨慎选择模型与度量方式。

title: DOA-SORT: Directional Occlusion-Aware Multi-Object Tracking with Distributional Observations
summary: Identity association in multi-object tracking (MOT) is vulnerable to partial occlusion, truncated detections, and fluctuating confidence scores. Existing motion-dominant trackers commonly represent occlusion as a scalar penalty. This treatment misses the directional observation bias caused by occlusion: left, right, top, and bottom occlusions distort the location and shape of a detection in different ways. We propose \ours{} (Directional Occlusion-Aware SORT), an online and training-free tracker that models these biases explicitly. First, it infers a soft front--back ordering from box overlap and relative bottom positions, and estimates directional occlusion coverage and depth. It then constructs a mixture of one clean and four directional occlusion observation components. The model uses a five-dimensional observation comprising box center, area, confidence, and aspect ratio, and adapts observation noise to predicted occlusion and detection confidence. The directional mixture likelihood is used in high-confidence association, low-confidence association, and track recovery; ambiguity penalties and local order-consistency swaps further reduce identity errors among nearby objects. On the DanceTrack validation split, \ours{} improves HOTA from 63.00 to 66.34, AssA from 45.10 to 49.57, and IDF1 from 62.19 to 65.28 over OA-SORT with the same detector and evaluation protocol. The gains are concentrated in association quality while detection accuracy remains stable. Additional local evaluations on MOT17 and MOT20 train splits characterize cross-dataset behavior under the same no-ReID tracking protocol.

AI.tldr: 提出DOA-SORT，一种在线、免训练的多目标跟踪器，显式建模方向性遮挡观测偏差，在DanceTrack验证集上显著提升关联指标。
AI.motivation: 现有运动主导的跟踪器将遮挡表示为标量惩罚，忽略了遮挡带来的方向性观测偏差（左、右、上、下遮挡以不同方式扭曲检测框的位置和形状）。
AI.method: 1) 从框重叠和相对底部位置推断软性前后排序，估计方向性遮挡覆盖率与深度；2) 构建由一个干净分量和四个方向性遮挡分量组成的混合观测模型；3) 采用包含框中心、面积、置信度和长宽比的五维观测，并根据预测遮挡和检测置信度自适应调整观测噪声；4) 将方向混合似然用于高置信关联、低置信关联和轨迹恢复，并引入歧义惩罚与局部顺序一致性交换以减少近邻目标的身份错误。
AI.result: 在DanceTrack验证集上，相同检测器和评测协议下相比OA-SORT：HOTA由63.00提升至66.34，AssA由45.10提升至49.57，IDF1由62.19提升至65.28；增益集中在关联质量，检测精度保持稳定。另在MOT17和MOT20训练集上以相同无ReID协议进行局部评估，刻画跨数据集行为。
AI.conclusion: 方向性遮挡建模能有效缓解身份关联误差，且无需训练、可在线运行，具有跨数据集适用性。

title: ZIL: Zero-shot Image-to-LiDAR Registration
summary: Image-to-LiDAR registration estimates the camera pose of an image with respect to a LiDAR point cloud. It has diverse applications in autonomous driving, robot navigation etc. However, state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods still 1) mostly assume same-frame inputs, struggling with the image and point cloud from distant frames; 2) rely on domain-specific training, failing to generalize to unseen scenarios. We propose ZIL, the first foundation model for zero-shot non-synchronized image-to-LiDAR registration. ZIL encodes the input image and point cloud with the Vision and Point Transformers. In addition to regressing the relative pose, ZIL also learns to predict 3D coordinates, which substantially improves the pose accuracy without additional annotations. Interestingly, naive mix-data training cannot enable zero-shot generalization, which requires normalization on both camera intrinsics and the LiDAR vertical-axis origin. Trained on 7 public datasets with 1.4M LiDAR frames, ZIL consistently and significantly outperforms previous SOTA with a single model across 5 in-domain and zero-shot benchmarks, reducing the translation and rotation errors by up to 87% and 76% (shown in Fig. 1). Code and models are available at https://github.com/ZijunLi7/ZIL.

AI.tldr: ZIL 是首个面向零样本非同步图像到 LiDAR 配准的基础模型，通过多数据集大规模训练与关键归一化策略，在域内与零样本基准上显著超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有图像到 LiDAR 配准方法存在两大局限：一是多假设图像与点云来自同一帧，难以处理跨帧（非同步）输入；二是依赖特定域训练，难以泛化到未见场景。因此需要一种具备零样本泛化能力的非同步配准方案。
AI.method: 提出 ZIL 基础模型：使用 Vision Transformer 编码图像、Point Transformer 编码点云；除回归相对位姿外，还引入 3D 坐标预测作为辅助任务以提升位姿精度且无需额外标注。为实现零样本泛化，需对相机内参和 LiDAR 垂直轴原点进行归一化，仅靠朴素混合数据训练无法达到该效果。模型在 7 个公开数据集、140 万 LiDAR 帧上训练。
AI.result: 单一模型在 5 个域内与零样本基准上持续且显著优于此前 SOTA，平移误差最多降低 87%，旋转误差最多降低 76%。
AI.conclusion: ZIL 证明了通过大规模混合数据训练结合内参与 LiDAR 垂直轴原点归一化，可构建具备零样本泛化能力的非同步图像到 LiDAR 配准基础模型，代码与模型已开源。

title: Clinical Domain Classification from Medical Transcriptions
summary: Clinical domain classification plays an important role in organizing and analyzing large volumes of unstructured medical text. However, medical transcription datasets are often highly imbalanced, which can substantially degrade classification performance, particularly for underrepresented clinical specialties. In this work, we present a comparative study of machine learning and transformer-based approaches for clinical domain classification from medical transcriptions. We evaluate six traditional machine learning classifiers---Naive Bayes, Support Vector Machine (SVM), Decision Tree, Random Forest, K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), and XGBoost---along with two pretrained transformer models, BERT and XLNet, and a few-shot large language model prompting approach. Experiments are conducted on medical transcription data collected from MTSamples, comprising 5,013 samples across 40 clinical specialties. To address severe class imbalance, we investigate two balancing strategies: text augmentation using NLP-based synonym replacement and Synthetic Minority Over-sampling Technique (SMOTE). Experimental results demonstrate that data balancing substantially improves classification performance across the evaluated models. In particular, BERT achieves the highest F1-score of 0.996 on the SMOTE-balanced dataset while requiring lower training time than XLNet. The results highlight the effectiveness of transformer-based representations combined with appropriate data balancing strategies for clinical domain classification and provide a systematic comparison of classical machine learning, transformer models, and few-shot prompting for medical transcription analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文对医学转写文本的临床科室分类进行系统比较研究，评估6种传统机器学习分类器、BERT与XLNet两种预训练Transformer模型及大语言模型少样本提示方法，并采用同义词替换文本增强与SMOTE两种策略应对类别不平衡。实验基于MTSamples的5,013条样本、40个临床专科，结果表明数据平衡可显著提升性能，BERT在SMOTE平衡数据上取得最高F1值0.996，且训练时间低于XLNet。
AI.motivation: 临床科室分类对大规模非结构化医学文本的组织与分析具有重要意义，但医学转写数据集普遍存在严重的类别不平衡问题，尤其会显著降低对样本稀缺专科的分类性能。因此需要系统比较不同模型方法，并探究有效的类别平衡策略以缓解不平衡带来的性能退化。
AI.method: 研究采用对比实验设计：一是6种传统机器学习分类器（朴素贝叶斯、支持向量机、决策树、随机森林、K近邻、XGBoost）；二是两种预训练Transformer模型（BERT、XLNet）；三是大语言模型少样本提示方法。数据来自MTSamples医学转写数据集，共5,013条样本、覆盖40个临床专科。针对严重类别不平衡，考察两种平衡策略：基于NLP同义词替换的文本增强与合成少数类过采样技术（SMOTE）。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，数据平衡在各评估模型上均带来显著的分类性能提升。其中BERT在SMOTE平衡后的数据集上取得最高F1值0.996，且训练时间低于XLNet。研究同时给出了经典机器学习、Transformer模型与少样本提示方法在医学转写分析上的系统性比较结果。
AI.conclusion: Transformer表征与恰当的数据平衡策略相结合，可有效提升临床科室分类性能，验证了该组合方案在医学转写文本分析中的有效性，并为后续相关研究提供了系统性的方法对比基准。

title: Towards Robust Classroom Attendance: A Comprehensive Evaluation of Face Detection and Recognition Models
comment: 6 pages, 5 figures. Accepted at the International Conference on Converging Intelligence (CICON 2026), Track 1: Artificial Intelligence and Data Science
summary: Manual attendance methods, such as paper or register-based systems, take a lot of time, can lead to errors, and are easy to falsify. Face recognition is more reliable, but it frequently struggles in classrooms because lighting and other conditions can vary. Face recognition datasets are designed for regulated environments and do not capture the actual challenges found in classrooms. To address this, a new face detection and recognition dataset, the Visage Face dataset, comprising 16,234 face samples, is proposed for the task of face detection and recognition. The photos are taken from different angles and under varying lighting conditions, with students showing a range of expressions, and some faces partly covered to reflect real-life situations. A YOLO-based system is used to detect faces and tested seven advanced face recognition models with thirteen configurations: LVFace, QCFace, FaceLiVTv2, TopoFR, EdgeFace, TransFace, and GhostFaceNets. Of these, FaceLiVTv2-M performed best, with 99.75% Top-1/Top-5 accuracy and an inference time of 6.459 ms. These results show that the Visage Face Dataset is a realistic and challenging benchmark for face recognition in classroom attendance.

AI.tldr: 提出Visage Face数据集（16,234个样本，多角度、多光照、遮挡等真实课堂场景），采用基于YOLO的检测系统并评测7种先进人脸识别模型的13种配置，其中FaceLiVTv2-M表现最优，Top-1/Top-5准确率达99.75%，推理时间6.459 ms，验证该数据集是课堂考勤场景下真实且具挑战性的基准。
AI.motivation: 传统人工考勤（纸质或签到）耗时、易出错且易被伪造；人脸识别虽更可靠，但在课堂中因光照等条件多变而难以稳定工作。现有人脸识别数据集面向受控环境设计，无法反映课堂中的真实困难，因此需要构建贴近实际的课堂人脸检测与识别数据集。
AI.method: 构建Visage Face数据集，包含16,234个人脸样本，采集覆盖不同角度、不同光照条件、多种表情以及部分人脸遮挡的情况。采用基于YOLO的系统进行人脸检测，并对LVFace、QCFace、FaceLiVTv2、TopoFR、EdgeFace、TransFace、GhostFaceNets共7种先进人脸识别模型开展13种配置的评测。
AI.result: 在13种配置中FaceLiVTv2-M表现最佳，Top-1/Top-5准确率达到99.75%，推理时间为6.459 ms。
AI.conclusion: Visage Face数据集为课堂考勤中的人脸识别提供了真实且具有挑战性的基准，能够反映实际场景下的检测与识别难题。

title: DriveReferee: Geometric Safety Verdicts Need Not Be Learned for Driving World-Action Models
summary: Generative world-action models (WAMs) jointly generate future video and vehicle actions, while their action branches remain primarily optimized by expert imitation. Yet imitation provides no explicit closed-loop geometric verdict for generated trajectories, making verification important during both training and deployment. Closed-loop evaluators can check collision and drivable-area violations, but require privileged scene state unavailable at deployment. Existing approaches often close this gap by learning a verifier from sensor features. For these geometric checks, the rule itself is explicit. For example, collision is determined by whether the rolled-out ego footprint overlaps occupied vehicle space. What is unavailable at deployment is the scene state needed to apply the rule. We introduce DriveReferee, which uses a learned geometry readout to predict the scene representation from camera observations and executes the geometric safety rule directly rather than learning it. The resulting analytic referee evaluates collision and drivable-area safety from a scene state and candidate trajectory. During training, it scores self-sampled trajectories on ground-truth state and distills the resulting preferences into the WAM policy. At deployment, the same referee evaluates generated trajectories on this predicted state and selects a safer alternative when needed. The analytic referee requires no verdict-specific training, and its decisions follow an explicit geometric rule. Under matched candidates and inference budgets, it matches or outperforms all learned-verifier and heuristic baselines. Given the same predicted state and trajectory, learning the verdict provides no measurable downstream gain despite requiring tens of thousands of evaluator-labeled training examples. On the full NAVSIM navtest, DriveReferee reaches 92.02 PDMS with single-camera visual input and no external training data.

AI.tldr: 提出 DriveReferee，用学习到的几何读出从相机观测预测场景状态，再执行显式几何安全规则（碰撞/可行驶区域）作为解析裁判，训练时蒸馏偏好给策略，部署时选择更安全轨迹。无需 verdict 专用训练，在 NAVSIM navtest 上单目输入达到 92.02 PDMS。
AI.motivation: 生成式世界-动作模型（WAM）虽能联合生成未来视频与车辆动作，但动作分支主要靠专家模仿优化，模仿不提供对生成轨迹的显式闭环几何判定，因此训练与部署阶段都需要验证。闭环评估器可检查碰撞与可行驶区域违规，但其依赖部署时不可得的特权场景状态。现有方法通过学习验证器从传感器特征弥补差距，但几何规则本身是显式的（如碰撞由自车足迹与占用车辆空间是否重叠决定），真正缺失的只是应用规则所需的场景状态。
AI.method: DriveReferee：用一个学习到的几何读出（geometry readout）从相机观测预测场景表示，然后直接执行几何安全规则而非学习它。解析裁判基于场景状态与候选轨迹评估碰撞与可行驶区域安全性。训练时，在真实（ground-truth）状态上对自采样轨迹打分，将偏好蒸馏进 WAM 策略；部署时，在预测状态上评估生成轨迹，必要时选出更安全的替代轨迹。解析裁判不需要针对 verdict 的训练，决策遵循显式几何规则。
AI.result: 在相同候选与推理预算下，DriveReferee 达到或超过所有学习型验证器与启发式基线。在给定相同预测状态与轨迹时，学习 verdict 未带来可测量的下游增益，尽管其需要数万条评估器标注训练样本。在完整 NAVSIM navtest 上，仅单目视觉输入且无外部训练数据，DriveReferee 达到 92.02 PDMS。
AI.conclusion: 对于显式几何安全规则，应预测规则应用所需的场景状态而非学习判定本身：解析裁判免训练、决策可解释、性能更强，说明在安全验证中"学状态、用规则"优于"学规则"。

title: Beyond Final-Token Classification: Heterogeneous Readouts for Evidence-Grounded Suicide Risk Detection
comment: Competition paper for the IEEE Big Data Cup 2026. Ranked 2nd among 31 participating teams and invited for submission to IEEE Big Data 2026
summary: The IEEE BigData Cup benchmark combines three prediction problems with different output structures: ordinal suicide-risk classification, multi-label psychosocial factor detection, and extraction of supporting phrases. We introduce heterogeneous readout decomposition (HRD), which separates semantic verification from output realization. A locally deployed Qwen3.8-27B model, adapted with task-specific QLoRA adapters, produces both answer-token margins and layer-63 answer states for card-conditioned queries. HRD compares four latent scores for ordinal risk, retains token margins for most factors while routing seven labels through one shared latent probe, and constructs evidence sets from verbatim span candidates with calibrated, risk-conditional constraints. On two held-out user-grouped confirmation folds, the latent risk readout improves weighted F1 from 0.8237 to 0.8372 and macro F1 from 0.7965 to 0.8185. Selective factor routing improves macro F1 by 0.0105 and tail-label macro F1 by 0.0189; in contrast, global latent replacement and independent label-specific probes fail. The constrained evidence decoder raises pooled phrase F1 from 0.7488 to 0.7609 in row-level out-of-fold evaluation. Lenormand's best public result is 0.8052 on Subtask 1 and 0.6636 on Subtask 2, giving a composite score of 0.7627. These results identify the answer-token boundary, rather than semantic representation alone, as a measurable source of error in this benchmark.

AI.tldr: 该文提出异构读出分解（HRD），将语义验证与输出实现解耦，在IEEE BigData Cup基准的三类任务上分别改进序数风险分类、多标签因素检测与支持性短语抽取，并指出答案token边界是可测量的误差来源。
AI.motivation: IEEE BigData Cup基准包含三种输出结构不同的预测任务（序数自杀风险分类、多标签心理社会因素检测、支持性短语抽取）。作者希望统一处理这三类异构输出，并探究误差究竟来自语义表示还是输出实现环节。
AI.method: 提出异构读出分解（HRD），把语义验证与输出实现分离。使用本地部署的Qwen3.8-27B模型，配合任务特定的QLoRA适配器，对卡片条件查询同时产生答案token margin与第63层答案状态。具体包括：对序数风险比较四个潜在分数；对多数因素保留token margin，并将七个标签路由至一个共享潜在探针；用带校准、风险条件约束的约束证据解码器从逐字片段候选中构建证据集合。
AI.result: 在两个留出、按用户分组的确认折上，潜在风险读出将加权F1从0.8237提升至0.8372，宏F1从0.7965提升至0.8185；选择性因素路由使宏F1提升0.0105、尾部标签宏F1提升0.0189，而全局潜在替换与独立标签专用探针均失败；约束证据解码器在行级折外评估中将池化短语F1从0.7488提升至0.7609。作者报告其综合得分为0.7627（子任务1为0.8052，子任务2为0.6636）。
AI.conclusion: 结果识别出答案token边界（而非仅语义表示）是本基准中可测量的误差来源，说明输出实现环节对异构预测任务性能具有实质影响。

title: NLPCC 2026 Task 10: Citation-Level Faithfulness Verification with DeBERTa Ensembles and Class-Wise Calibration
comment: Accepted to the NLPCC 2026 Shared Task 10 system paper track. Ranked 2nd in Track 2 on the final leaderboard
summary: This paper presents our system for Track 2 of the NLPCC 2026 Shared Task 10 on citation-level faithfulness in AI-assisted scientific reporting. Given an atomic scientific claim and the structured full text of its cited paper, the task requires both a four-way relation label and up to three evidence paragraph identifiers. The label head ensembles a paragraph-aware cross-encoder with a document-level DeBERTa-large classifier, followed by class-wise decision calibration. Probability-level fusion is motivated by an out-of-fold tendency to over-predict Topical Match. The evidence head combines paragraph scores from top-20 and top-30 joint models with BM25 scores. The system runs fully offline without external retrieval or LLM prompting. On the final leaderboard, our system achieved 82.9898 overall (89.5491 Macro-F1 and 76.4305 Joint@3), ranking second in Track 2. Ablations and error analysis show that model complementarity and calibration drive the label gains. Gold-evidence inference changes label Macro-F1 negligibly, whereas evidence ranking remains important for Joint@3.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NLPCC 2026共享任务10 Track 2（AI辅助科学报告中的引用级忠实性）的参赛系统：对给定原子科学论断与其被引论文结构化全文，同时预测四分类关系标签和至多三个证据段落ID，最终以82.9898总分（Macro-F1 89.5491，Joint@3 76.4305）位列第二。
AI.motivation: 任务要求同时判定论断与被引论文的引用关系类别并定位支持证据段落，属细粒度引用忠实性评估；且系统需完全离线运行，不依赖外部检索或大模型提示，因此需要依靠模型互补与概率校准提升性能。
AI.method: 标签头：段落感知交叉编码器与文档级DeBERTa-large分类器集成，再按类别做决策校准；因折外预测显示"Topical Match"存在过度预测倾向，故采用概率级融合。证据头：融合top-20与top-30联合模型的段落得分及BM25得分进行排序。
AI.result: 最终排行榜总分82.9898，其中Macro-F1为89.5491、Joint@3为76.4305，Track 2排名第二。消融与错误分析表明模型互补性和校准是标签性能提升的主要来源；使用金标准证据推理对标签Macro-F1影响可忽略，而证据排序对Joint@3仍十分重要。
AI.conclusion: 通过段落级与文档级模型的概率融合、类别校准以及多模型得分与BM25的证据融合，可在无外部检索与LLM提示的纯离线设定下取得领先的引用忠实性判定与证据定位效果。

title: MIS-Bench: Benchmarking Multimodal LLMs for Psychotherapeutic Interpersonal Skills Assessment
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly used as evaluators, yet their reliability in professional assessment tasks that require expert judgment remains unclear. We investigate this challenge in the context of assessing psychotherapeutic interpersonal skills and introduce MIS-Bench, a Multimodal Interpersonal Skills (MIS) benchmark comprising 996 psychotherapy response videos annotated across 8 dimensions of Facilitative Interpersonal Skills. Across 9 MLLMs with multiple modality and prompting settings, we find that current models show only modest agreement with human experts, inconsistent gains from multimodal input, and limited benefits from reasoning-based prompting. To mitigate this gap, we propose MIS-RAFT, a regression-aware fine-tuning method inspired by RAFT and tailored to fine-grained interpersonal skill scoring at one-decimal precision. MIS-RAFT addresses the mismatch between autoregressive token prediction and scalar-valued expert assessment, significantly improving agreement with human ratings. Overall, MIS-Bench reveals a clear gap between general multimodal capability and expert-level interpersonal judgment, while MIS-RAFT offers a promising path toward more reliable model-based assessment.

AI.tldr: 本文研究MLLM作为专业评估者的可靠性，构建心理治疗人际技能基准MIS-Bench（996段视频、8维度），发现9个MLLM与人类专家一致性有限，并提出回归感知微调方法MIS-RAFT改善评分一致性。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）日益被用作评估者，但在需要专家判断的专业评估任务中，其可靠性尚不明确。本文聚焦心理治疗人际技能评估这一高专业度场景，探究模型能否胜任细粒度专家级评判。
AI.method: 1）构建MIS-Bench基准：包含996段心理治疗回应视频，按Facilitative Interpersonal Skills的8个维度标注；2）在多种模态与提示设置下评测9个MLLM；3）提出MIS-RAFT，一种受RAFT启发、面向一位小数精度细粒度人际技能评分的回归感知微调方法，缓解自回归token预测与标量专家评估之间的不匹配。
AI.result: 现有模型与人类专家仅有中等一致性；多模态输入未带来一致增益；基于推理的提示收益有限。MIS-RAFT显著提升与人类评分的一致性。
AI.conclusion: MIS-Bench揭示了通用多模态能力与专家级人际判断之间存在明显差距，而MIS-RAFT为更可靠的模型化评估提供了可行路径。

title: Human-Level Accuracy, Non-Human Strategies: Revealing Model-Human Divergence in Video Physical Reasoning
comment: ECCV 2026. Code: https://github.com/fanhong-li/model-human-divergence
summary: Video foundation models now reach human-level accuracy on physical-reasoning benchmarks, yet such tasks require predicting unobserved physical outcomes. Do these models perform human-like forward simulation, or do they exploit statistical regularities in visible scenes? Accuracy alone cannot distinguish these strategies. We introduce a distributional evaluation framework that treats model seeds and human raters as populations, enabling comparison of consensus, uncertainty, and strategy. On the Physion benchmark, we evaluate three ViT-L architectures (V-JEPA2, VideoMAEv2, DINOv2). V-JEPA2 narrows the accuracy gap to ~1 percentage point (73.2% vs. 74.2%), yet model-human disagreement reaches 26.4%, far exceeding human-human disagreement (4.8%), with substantially lower agreement (kappa ~ 0.48 vs. 0.91). The divergence follows forward-simulation demands: models outperform humans on geometric reasoning (linking, +11.8 pp) but underperform on gravitational dynamics (rolling, -11.8 pp) and causal chains (dominoes, -10.5 pp). Strategy fingerprinting confirms all three architectures share non-human strategies while none aligns with humans. Attribution analysis suggests that unobservable outcome features, rather than visible scene properties, predict this divergence, consistent with models relying more on scene-level statistical regularities than on explicit forward simulation, a systematic divergence that accuracy alone cannot reveal. Code is available at https://github.com/fanhong-li/model-human-divergence.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出分布评估框架，将模型种子与人类评分者视为群体，发现尽管V-JEPA2在Physion基准上准确率接近人类（73.2% vs 74.2%），但其模型-人类分歧率达26.4%，远超人类间分歧4.8%，表明模型更多依赖场景统计规律而非类人前向模拟。
AI.motivation: 视频基础模型在物理推理基准上已达人类水平准确率，但物理推理任务本身要求预测未观察到的物理结果。准确率无法区分模型是在进行类人的前向模拟，还是在利用可见场景中的统计规律性。这一根本性问题亟需一种能够超越单一准确率指标的评估方法来揭示模型的真实推理策略。
AI.method: 提出一种分布评估框架，将模型种子和人类评分者均视为群体，从而比较共识度、不确定性及策略。在Physion基准上评估三种ViT-L架构：V-JEPA2、VideoMAEv2和DINOv2。采用准确性、模型-人类一致性（Cohen's kappa）、策略指纹分析（strategy fingerprinting）以及归因分析等方法，区分前向模拟与场景统计规律的依赖。
AI.result: V-JEPA2将准确率差距缩小至约1个百分点（73.2% vs 74.2%），但模型-人类分歧率达26.4%，远超人类间分歧的4.8%，一致性显著更低（kappa约0.48 vs 0.91）。分歧模式契合前向模拟需求：模型在几何推理上超越人类（连接任务+11.8 pp），但在引力动力学（滚动-11.8 pp）和因果链（多米诺骨牌-10.5 pp）上表现不佳。策略指纹确认三种架构共享非人类策略，且无一与人类对齐。归因分析表明不可观察的结果特征而非可见场景属性更能预测这种分歧。
AI.conclusion: 模型更依赖场景层面的统计规律而非显式前向模拟，存在准确性指标无法揭示的系统性分歧。研究表明仅凭准确率无法判断视频基础模型是否真正进行了类人物理推理，需要分布评估框架来揭示模型与人类在策略和不确定性上的本质差异。

title: PixelART: Image-to-Layer Decomposition without Latents or Text-to-Image Pretraining
summary: Image-to-layer decomposition converts a flattened image into editable RGBA layers, enabling element-level editing in design workflows. Existing diffusion-based systems typically adapt large pretrained text-to-image (T2I) models and introduce RGBA autoencoders or variable-layer architectural modules. We revisit this design choice and ask whether layer decomposition truly requires these heavyweight components. We introduce PixelART, a pixel-space rectified-flow Transformer trained from scratch for image-to-layer (I2L) decomposition. PixelART directly denoises regional RGBA pixel patches using a single-stream multi-modal diffusion Transformer, avoiding RGBA-VAEs, pretrained T2I backbones, and layer-specific decoders. We identify a key property of the task: high-noise timesteps determine layer assignment and coarse layer organization, while low-noise timesteps mainly refine color, alpha, texture, and boundaries. Based on this observation, we propose a terminal-boosted timestep sampling strategy to increase training coverage in the high-noise layer assignment regime. Trained on 4M multi-layer design templates, PixelART achieves state-of-the-art layer decomposition and composite reconstruction on Design-Multi-Layer-Bench and LICA with over 80% fewer parameters, 98% lower latency, and 85% lower memory than the recent Qwen-Image-Layered model. Ablation experiments show that pixel-space $\mathbf{x}$-prediction, terminal-boosted timestep sampling, and data/model scaling are critical, while T2I pretraining brings marginal benefits to the I2L task.

AI.tldr: 提出PixelART——从零训练的像素空间rectified-flow Transformer，无需RGBA-VAE、预训练T2I主干与层级专用解码器即可完成图像到图层分解，性能SOTA且参数/延迟/显存大幅降低。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散式图像到图层（I2L）分解方法普遍依赖大型预训练T2I模型，并额外引入RGBA自编码器或可变图层架构模块。作者质疑这种"重量级"设计是否为该任务所必需，试图探索更轻量、更直接的方案。
AI.method: 1) 提出PixelART：单流多模态扩散Transformer，直接在像素空间对区域RGBA像素块去噪，从零训练，采用rectified flow；不依赖RGBA-VAE、T2I预训练主干和层级专用解码器。2) 发现任务关键性质：高噪声时间步决定图层分配与粗略图层组织，低噪声时间步主要细化颜色、alpha、纹理和边界。3) 据此提出terminal-boosted timestep sampling，增强高噪声"图层分配"区间的训练覆盖。4) 在4M多层设计模板上训练。
AI.result: 在Design-Multi-Layer-Bench和LICA上取得SOTA的图层分解与合成重建效果；相比Qwen-Image-Layered，参数量减少80%以上、延迟降低98%、显存降低85%。消融显示像素空间x-prediction、terminal-boosted时间步采样以及数据/模型规模扩展均关键，而T2I预训练对I2L任务仅带来微弱收益。
AI.conclusion: 图层分解并不需要RGBA-VAE与预训练T2I主干等重型组件；像素空间从零训练的rectified-flow Transformer是更高效且更优的方案，为I2L任务提供了简洁、可扩展的新范式。

title: Diagnose, Then Repair: A Two-Stage MQM-Guided Post-Editing Framework for Domain-Specific Machine Translation
comment: Accepted to the ACL 2026 Industry Track and presented at ACL 2026
summary: LLM-based machine translation evaluation can closely match human judgments, but in practice it remains largely diagnostic, with the signals rarely translating into direct quality improvements under real production constraints. We propose a two-stage, evaluator-guided automatic post-editing framework that turns MQM-style evaluation into targeted repairs: a retrieval-augmented LLM evaluator outputs structured, span-level MQM diagnoses under an explicit edit contract, and a separate LLM post-editor applies minimal edits restricted to those diagnoses. This separation improves controllability and reduces paraphrastic drift compared to one-stage "judge-and-refine" baselines. In a systematic study involving seven LLMs spanning three model providers and seven languages, our best configuration consistently improves both COMET-22 and COMETKiwi scores over one-stage post-edit methods, while the evaluator's error spans and severities show strong agreement with human MQM annotations and human editor preferences.

AI.tldr: 提出两阶段评估器引导的自动译后编辑框架，将MQM式评估转化为定向修复，在7个LLM、7种语言上验证可提升COMET-22与COMETKiwi。
AI.motivation: 基于LLM的机器翻译评估虽能接近人工判断，但实际多停留在诊断层面，难以在真实生产约束下直接转化为译文质量提升，评估信号与质量改进之间存在脱节。
AI.method: 两阶段评估器引导的自动译后编辑：第一阶段用检索增强的LLM评估器在显式编辑契约下输出结构化、跨度级（span-level）的MQM诊断；第二阶段用独立的LLM译后编辑器仅针对这些诊断执行最小编辑。该职责分离提升了可控性，并较一阶段"评判-修正"基线减少改写漂移。
AI.result: 在涵盖三个模型提供商、七种语言的七个LLM系统研究中，最优配置在COMET-22和COMETKiwi上均持续优于一阶段译后编辑方法；评估器给出的错误跨度与严重程度与人工MQM标注及人工编辑偏好高度一致。
AI.conclusion: 将评估与编辑分离、以结构化MQM诊断驱动最小编辑，可将LLM评估的诊断能力有效转化为可量化的译文质量提升，且与人工判断保持一致，具备实际生产应用潜力。

title: AlexandriaX 2026: The First Shared Task on Dialectal Arabic Machine Translation
comment: To Appear in ArabicNLP 2026, resources available in the following project page: https://alexandriax.dlnlp.ai
summary: Dialectal Arabic machine translation (MT) remains challenging despite recent progress in Arabic language technologies, particularly because effective translation requires modeling not only semantic content but also dialectal variation, conversational context, speaker and addressee characteristics, and sociolinguistic appropriateness. Moreover, conventional MT metrics provide limited insight into the linguistic errors produced by dialectal systems. We present the AlexandriaX 2026 Shared Task on Dialectal Arabic MT, which addresses these challenges through three complementary subtasks: (1) context-aware English-to-Dialectal Arabic dialogue translation across 13 Arabic varieties, (2) cross-dialect Arabic translation in the financial domain covering six Arabic dialects, and (3) span-level MT error detection and classification using linguistically motivated error categories across five Arabic varieties. The shared task attracted 38 registrations for Subtask 1, 33 for Subtask 2, and 35 for Subtask 3. Twelve unique teams submitted their system description papers, all of which we accepted for publication. The best system on Subtask 1 achieved 30.42 spBLEU in the constrained track and 33.49 spBLEU in the unconstrained track. On Subtask 2, the top system obtained 28.40 spBLEU. On Subtask 3, the best system achieved an overall score of 49.82, outperforming the 24.29 baseline. Taken together, the results of the leading systems across the three subtasks highlight the benefits of explicit dialect modeling, context-aware generation, retrieval and reranking, and specialized approaches to interpretable MT error analysis. All the resources of AlexandriaX 2026 shared task are publicly available, including data, baselines, and evaluation code on our project page: https://alexandriax.dlnlp.ai.

AI.tldr: AlexandriaX 2026 提出方言阿拉伯语机器翻译共享任务，涵盖三个子任务（对话上下文翻译、金融跨方言翻译、翻译错误检测），共 12 支队伍提交系统，最佳系统显著优于基线。
AI.motivation: 方言阿拉伯语机器翻译仍具挑战，不仅需建模语义内容，还需处理方言变异、对话上下文、说话人与受话人特征及社会语言学适切性；同时传统翻译指标难以揭示方言系统产生的语言错误。
AI.method: 设置三个互补子任务：1）覆盖13种阿拉伯方言的上下文感知英→方言阿拉伯语对话翻译；2）金融领域涵盖六种方言的跨方言阿拉伯语翻译；3）覆盖五种方言、基于语言学动机错误类别的跨度级翻译错误检测与分类。提供数据、基线与评测代码并公开所有资源。
AI.result: 子任务1注册38个、子任务2注册33个、子任务3注册35个；12支唯一队伍提交系统描述论文并全部接收。子任务1最佳系统受限赛道30.42 spBLEU、非受限33.49 spBLEU；子任务2最佳28.40 spBLEU；子任务3最佳总分49.82，优于24.29的基线。
AI.conclusion: 领先系统结果表明显式方言建模、上下文感知生成、检索与重排序以及面向可解释翻译错误分析的专业方法具有显著效益，所有资源共享于项目页面。

title: To Consolidate or not to Consolidate? Evaluating the Impact of Consolidation in Multi-Reference Training using Peer Reviews
summary: Natural language generation (NLG) tasks span the spectrum of conditional entropy, ranging from highly constrained machine translation to open-ended dialogue generation. Structured tasks like automated peer-review generation occupy the intermediate region, where a single input admits multiple valid, overlapping outputs. In this work, we demonstrate that traditional single- and multi-reference training paradigms are suboptimal for these intermediary tasks. We provide empirical evidence that consolidating diverse references into a unified training signal is crucial for developing effective systems. To facilitate this, we introduce MERC-36K, a large-scale corpus of over 36,000 papers paired with original and consolidated peer reviews. Using this dataset, we train specific architectures to isolate the impact of different reference paradigms and benchmark against existing state-of-the-art systems. Through extensive automatic and human evaluation, we demonstrate that models trained on consolidated references significantly outperform those trained on unconsolidated references. Dataset and code will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文针对"结构化中间型"自然语言生成任务（如自动同行评审生成），指出传统单/多参考训练范式不理想，提出将多样参考整合为统一训练信号的思路，并发布MERC-36K数据集（36,000+论文及原始与整合后的评审），实验证明基于整合参考训练的模型显著优于未整合参考训练的模型。
AI.motivation: NLG任务存在条件熵谱系：从高度受限的机器翻译到开放式的对话生成。像自动同行评审生成这类结构化任务处于中间区域，同一输入可对应多个有效且相互重叠的输出。传统单参考或多参考训练范式在这种"中间型"任务上表现次优，因此需要探明更合适的训练信号构造方式。
AI.method: 1) 提供经验证据，论证将多样参考整合为统一训练信号对构建有效系统的必要性；2) 构建大规模语料MERC-36K，包含36,000多篇论文及其原始评审与整合评审；3) 利用该数据集训练特定架构，以隔离不同参考范式的影响，并与现有最先进系统进行基准比较；4) 开展广泛的自动评估与人工评估。
AI.result: 基于整合参考（consolidated references）训练的模型，在自动评估和人工评估中均显著优于基于未整合参考（unconsolidated references）训练的模型；同时通过与现有最先进系统的基准对比验证了该范式的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 对于自动同行评审生成等处于条件熵中间区域的结构化NLG任务，整合多样参考为统一训练信号是关键且有效的策略；MERC-36K数据集为相关研究提供了支撑，数据集与代码将在论文录用后公开。

title: Normalise or condition? Noise-floor front-ends for on-board keyword spotting under UAV rotor ego-noise
summary: A microphone on the airframe of a small multi-rotor UAV is dominated by rotor ego-noise, so spoken flight commands arrive at negative signal-to-noise ratio (SNR). We study small-footprint keyword spotting (KWS) for a ten-word command vocabulary under real ego-noise, training on one quadrotor and testing on another. Besides per-clip accuracy we measure the streaming false-alarm rate on 4.4 h of continuous rotor noise. We compare classical noise-robust front-ends (CMN, PCEN, spectral subtraction), test-time adaptation, and two front-ends that track the per-band ego-noise floor over the two seconds preceding the decision window and either subtract it (normalisation) or feed it to the network as a second input channel (conditioning). Per clip, all front-ends look alike: +2-3 points on average, up to +14 at -15 dB. On continuous rotor noise they differ sharply. Normalising front-ends fire about ten times more often than plain log-mel at the same threshold and end up below it at a budget of one false alarm per hour (-9 points at 0 dB). Conditioning keeps the baseline's false-alarm rate and turns its gain into detections (+8 points at -10 dB over three seeds); on top of PCEN it gives the best per-clip accuracy and false-alarm rate, and a level-anchored variant is also invariant to the microphone gain. Real drone+interferer recordings expose the remaining failure mode, environmental sounds and bystander speech, which training negatives halve. A single script reproduces all on-device numbers on the NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX flight computer, where the complete pipeline costs 3 ms per 100 ms hop on the CPU.

AI.tldr: 研究小型多旋翼无人机自噪声(负SNR)下的关键词识别(KWS)，对比多种前端方案，发现流式误报率差异显著，噪声条件化(conditioning)方案最优，且可在Jetson Orin NX上实时运行。
AI.motivation: 机身麦克风受旋翼自噪声(ego-noise)主导，语音指令到达时SNR为负值，传统前端方法在该极端条件下的有效性未知，且逐片段准确率可能掩盖流式部署中的误报问题，因此需要系统评估前端在真实自噪声下的表现。
AI.method: 在十词命令词表下训练小型KWS模型，一个四旋翼训练、另一个测试。对比经典鲁棒前端(CMN、PCEN、谱减)、测试时自适应，以及两种跟踪决策窗之前两秒逐频带自噪声底的方法：减除(归一化)与作为第二输入通道送入网络(条件化)。除逐片段准确率外，在4.4小时连续旋翼噪声上测量流式误报率。
AI.result: 逐片段上各前端表现相近(+2-3点，-15 dB时最高+14)；但在连续噪声上差异巨大：归一化前端误报约为log-mel的十倍，在每小时一次误报预算下反而更低(-9点@0 dB)。条件化保持基线误报率并将增益转化为检测(+8点@-10 dB，三随机种子)。叠加PCEN后取得最佳逐片段准确率与误报率，电平锚定变体还对麦克风增益不变。真实录音揭示剩余失效模式为环境声与旁观者语音，用训练负样本可减半。
AI.conclusion: 噪声底跟踪的条件化前端在流式部署中显著优于归一化与经典鲁棒前端，兼顾准确率、误报率和增益不变性。完整流程在Jetson Orin NX飞行计算机CPU上每100 ms跳步耗时3 ms，具备实时性，单一脚本可复现全部机载结果。

title: C$^{2}$-INR: Customized Convolutional Implicit Neural Representation
summary: Implicit Neural Representation (INR) leverages neural networks to represent discrete signals such as images as continuous ones, where the network weights serve as a compact form of the signal itself. Most existing INR methods adopt Multi-Layer Perceptrons (MLPs) as their backbone. Since these models render each pixel independently, they inherently fail to exploit the spatial correlations that exist between neighboring pixels. In contrast,convolutional INRs can process pixels in parallel while inherently accounting for inter-pixel dependencies, making them a more natural fit for representing images. Nevertheless, convolutional INRs remain relatively underexplored, and the majority of them rely on fixed architectural settings, leaving little room for image-specific adaptation. In this paper, we investigate network customization for convolutional INRs. We replace conventional filters with irregular directional kernels, whose allocation is guided by the directional energy in the image spectrum, i.e., directions exhibiting stronger energy are assigned a larger number of kernels, enabling content-tailored convolution settings. These kernels are further reformulated via an orthogonal basis to achieve a superior sparse representation. Moreover, we introduce an annealed Gumbel-Softmax-based mechanism for kernel-level activation function selection, which gives the most suitable activation function for each convolution kernel. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method, namely C$^{2}$-INR, achieves superior performance against state-of-the-art approaches under comparable parameter budgets across a wide range of image processing tasks, including representation, inpainting, and super-resolution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出C²-INR，一种面向卷积式隐式神经表示（INR）的网络定制方法：用方向性非规则卷积核替代常规卷积核，核分配由图像频谱的方向能量引导；核经正交基重构实现稀疏表示，并用退火Gumbel-Softmax进行核级激活函数选择。在表示、修复、超分辨率等任务中，在相近参数量下优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有INR多以MLP为骨干，逐像素独立渲染，无法利用相邻像素间的空间相关性；卷积式INR可并行处理像素并天然建模像素间依赖，更适合图像表示，但研究不足，且大多采用固定架构，缺乏针对图像内容的自适应能力。因此作者研究卷积式INR的网络定制问题。
AI.method: 1) 用非规则方向性卷积核替换常规卷积核，核的数量分配由图像频谱的方向能量决定——能量更强的方向分配更多卷积核，实现内容定制的卷积配置；2) 将这些核通过正交基进行重构，以获得更优的稀疏表示；3) 引入基于退火Gumbel-Softmax的机制，在核级别进行激活函数选择，为每个卷积核匹配最合适的激活函数。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，C²-INR在表示、图像修复（inpainting）和超分辨率等广泛图像处理任务上，在可比参数预算下取得了优于当前最先进方法的性能。
AI.conclusion: 卷积式INR可通过内容自适应的核分配、正交基稀疏化与核级激活函数选择实现有效网络定制，从而在多种图像处理任务中超越现有方法，说明面向图像内容的架构自适应是提升卷积INR性能的有效途径。

title: Modernising the Compressed-Domain Video Captioner: A Controlled Study of SigLIP2 and GPT-2 Substitutions
comment: 8 pages, 1 figure, 6 tables. Code, configurations and the exact commit for every run: https://github.com/nepalashim/compressed-video-captioning-ablation-cocap-siglip2-gpt2
summary: Compressed-domain video captioning avoids full video decoding by operating directly on I-frames, motion vectors and residuals, trading a small amount of accuracy for a large gain in inference speed. CoCap established this pipeline using a CLIP vision encoder and a shallow BERT-style multimodal decoder. Both components predate substantially stronger alternatives. We ask a narrow, controlled question: how much of CoCap's accuracy is limited by these two components, and which of the two is the binding constraint? We replace the CLIP I-frame encoder with SigLIP2 and the BERT-style decoder with GPT-2, and evaluate three configurations (the original pairing, the encoder substitution alone, and both substitutions together) under identical data, sampling budget and optimisation schedule. All comparisons are made against our own reproduction of CoCap rather than its published numbers, because we train on a 4,999-clip subset of VATEX at a reduced sampling budget; absolute values are therefore not comparable with the original work. Our reproduction tracks the published result closely: CIDEr and METEOR run slightly above it (54.9 against 52.7; 23.4 against 23.2), BLEU-4 and ROUGE-L slightly below (29.7 against 31.4; 48.9 against 49.4). We attribute the differences to our evaluation subset rather than to any improvement in either direction. We find the two substitutions pull in opposite directions: SigLIP2 alone improves every metric (+4.5 CIDEr), while adding GPT-2 on top erodes that gain, because a pretrained decoder overfits 4,999 clips within two epochs. We additionally report inference latency for each configuration, since speed is the property that motivates compressed-domain captioning in the first place, and an accuracy gain purchased at a latency cost should be reported as such.

AI.tldr: 该研究在压缩域视频描述框架CoCap上做了受控消融：将CLIP I帧编码器替换为SigLIP2、将浅层BERT式解码器替换为GPT-2，在相同数据与采样预算下比较三种配置，发现编码器替换带来全面提升（CIDEr +4.5），而叠加GPT-2反而削弱该增益（因预训练解码器在小规模数据上过拟合）。
AI.motivation: CoCap的压缩域视频描述流水线依赖两个较老的组件：CLIP视觉编码器与浅层BERT式多模态解码器，均已被更强的替代方案超越。作者希望回答一个明确、受控的问题：CoCap的精度在多大程度上受这两个组件限制，以及两者中哪一个是瓶颈。
AI.method: 替换CLIP I帧编码器为SigLIP2、解码器为GPT-2，构造三种配置（原始配对、仅换编码器、两者同时替换），在完全一致的数据、采样预算与优化调度下训练评估，并以作者自行复现的CoCap（非原论文数值）为基线。数据为VATEX的4,999个片段子集，采样预算缩减。
AI.result: 复现结果与原文接近：CIDEr 54.9 vs 52.7，METEOR 23.4 vs 23.2（略高），BLEU-4 29.7 vs 31.4，ROUGE-L 48.9 vs 49.4（略低），差异归因于评测子集而非性能改进。替换效果方向相反：仅SigLIP2使所有指标提升（CIDEr +4.5）；再叠加GPT-2会侵蚀该增益，因为预训练解码器在4,999个片段上两个epoch内即过拟合。文中同时报告了各配置的推理延迟。
AI.conclusion: 限制CoCap精度的绑定约束主要在于视觉编码器而非解码器：升级编码器可稳定获益，而盲目引入更强的预训练解码器在小数据预算下反而有害。由于速度是压缩域视频描述的核心动机，任何以延迟为代价换取的精度提升都应如实报告。

title: SatOV: Restoring Spatial Priors for Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Segmentation in Remote Sensing Imagery
summary: Open-vocabulary semantic segmentation (OVS) of remote sensing imagery is a challenging pixel-level task requiring strong generalization and adaptation to the spatial characteristics of remote sensing data. Although existing vision-language foundation models perform well in general domains, their image-level classification design weakens the spatial priors needed for high-resolution remote sensing segmentation: structural spatial relations are degraded during deep feature transformation, and fine-grained spatial details are lost during downsampling. To address these complementary deficiencies, we propose SatOV, a training-free framework for open-vocabulary remote sensing segmentation that restores spatial priors at two stages of the representation pipeline. Specifically, Residual QQ Attention (ResQQ) extracts Query-Key self-attention from an intermediate CLIP layer and fuses it with final-layer Query-Query attention via a residual combination, restoring structural spatial priors suppressed by the final-layer representation. Spatially Modulated Upsampling (SatUp) uses the original high-resolution RGB image as spatial guidance, combining spatial feature modulation with guided cross-attention to reconstruct pixel-level textures and boundaries. Extensive experiments on DOTA, UDD, LoveDA, and Vaihingen show that SatOV consistently improves training-free OVS and achieves competitive quantitative and qualitative results against state-of-the-art methods. These results validate the effectiveness of restoring spatial priors at both the representation and spatial-resolution stages for remote sensing open-vocabulary segmentation.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练框架 SatOV，通过恢复遥感影像开放词汇语义分割中的空间先验，在多个数据集上取得优于现有方法的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言基础模型虽在通用域表现良好，但其图像级分类设计弱化了高分辨率遥感分割所需的空间先验：深层特征变换导致结构空间关系退化，下采样导致细粒度空间细节丢失。
AI.method: SatOV 在两个阶段恢复空间先验：ResQQ 从 CLIP 中间层提取 Query-Key 自注意力，与末层 Query-Query 注意力做残差融合，恢复被末层表示抑制的结构空间先验；SatUp 以原始高分辨率 RGB 图像为空间引导，结合空间特征调制与引导式交叉注意力重建像素级纹理与边界。
AI.result: 在 DOTA、UDD、LoveDA 与 Vaihingen 上的大量实验表明，SatOV 稳定提升免训练 OVS 性能，并在定量与定性指标上达到与 SOTA 方法相当的水平。
AI.conclusion: 在表示阶段与空间分辨率阶段同时恢复空间先验，对遥感开放词汇分割有效，验证了该双阶段策略的合理性与优越性。

title: Alignment Forecasting: Predicting Misalignment From Training Data
summary: Training a language model on data with a narrow flaw can sometimes make the model broadly misaligned. Inspecting the data at face value often does not settle whether it will emerge, and today it is caught only after training, by auditing the resulting model. To complement post-hoc audits, we introduce Alignment Forecasting: the task of predicting alignment failures before training. Given a target model, a fine-tuning dataset, and a failure mode such as deception or sycophancy, a forecaster outputs the probability that fine-tuning would meaningfully increase that failure mode. To measure progress on alignment forecasting, we introduce ALIGNMENTFORECASTBENCH, a benchmark of over 5,000 forecasting questions spanning 17 target models, 32 datasets, and 16 failure modes. Frontier models prompted directly perform poorly on ALIGNMENTFORECASTBENCH. We therefore propose a forecasting scaffold in which an LLM reads the dataset and rates how strongly and broadly it pushes the model toward misbehavior, and a simple learned model combines that rating with the failure mode's base rate and the target model's prior tendency. This forecasts well above chance, and beats a model fine-tuned on the task and a simple forecaster allowed to see how weaker models behaved after fine-tuning on the same data. Its signals also flag problematic training examples that a frontier-model classifier misses. Filtering those examples out from real post-training data such as UltraChat results in more aligned models on our multiple-choice evaluation in most cases, though the benefit in open-ended conversations is unclear. More progress is needed before forecasts can reliably guide training data curation in practice, but our results suggest that forecasting many alignment failures before training can be tractable in the SFT setting.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"对齐预测"（Alignment Forecasting）任务，即在微调前预测数据集是否会引发模型的对齐失败，并构建了包含5000+问题、17个目标模型、32个数据集、16种失败模式的ALIGNMENTFORECASTBENCH基准。提出的LLM评分+学习模型组合的预测框架显著优于随机水平，并能标记前沿分类器遗漏的有害训练样本。
AI.motivation: 训练数据中狭窄的缺陷有时会导致模型出现广泛的对齐失败，而仅凭数据表面检查难以判断该缺陷是否会显现，目前只能在训练后通过审计模型来发现问题。为补充事后审计的不足，作者希望实现对训练前对齐失败的预测。
AI.method: 作者将任务形式化为：给定目标模型、微调数据集和某种失败模式（如欺骗、谄媚），预测器输出微调会显著加剧该失败模式的概率。构建了ALIGNMENTFORECASTBENCH基准。提出一种预测脚手架：由LLM阅读数据集并评估其将模型推向不当行为的强度与广度，再由一个简单学习模型将该评分与失败模式的基础率及目标模型先验倾向相结合。同时与直接提示的前沿模型、在该任务上微调的模型以及可见弱模型行为的简单预测器进行对比。
AI.result: 直接提示的前沿模型在该基准上表现不佳；所提脚手架显著高于随机水平，并优于在该任务上微调的模型以及可见弱模型微调后表现的简单预测器。其信号还能标记出前沿模型分类器遗漏的有问题的训练样本。将UltraChat等真实后训练数据中的这些样本过滤后，在大多数情况下能使模型在多项选择评估中更对齐，但在开放式对话中的收益尚不明确。
AI.conclusion: 在预测器能可靠指导实际训练数据筛选之前仍需更多进展，但结果表明在SFT场景下于训练前预测多种对齐失败是可行的。

title: LINGO: Latent Initialization and Gradient Optimization for Sparse-view X-ray Novel View Synthesis and CT Reconstruction with 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: In novel view synthesis and Computed Tomography (CT) reconstruction with sparse-view X-ray imaging, insufficient angular coverage leads to structural ambiguity and accumulated noise. Integrating 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) with X-ray absorption physics can achieve promising results, but it suffers from noisy initialization, positional insensitivity, and weak gradients in low-density regions. In this paper, we propose a unified Latent Initialization and Gradient Optimization (LINGO) framework to address these issues. LINGO combines latent mask-space initialization with dynamic gradient optimization to improve point cloud structural completeness while accelerating training. It constructs voxel-level 3D filters from X-ray masks to robustly suppress background noise and provide reliable geometric priors. By employing an adaptive voxel scaling strategy and dynamically scaling loss, LINGO can adjust spatial resolution and explicitly amplify gradients in low-density structures. To evaluate the quality of initialization, we introduce the Initialization Point Cloud Structural Deviation (IPSD) metric. Experiments on the X3D dataset indicate that for the novel view synthesis task, LINGO improves the Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR) and Structural Similarity Index (SSIM) by an average of 0.72 and 0.0039, respectively, over baselines under identical sparse-view settings, achieving comparable reconstruction quality within 5k steps to state-of-the-art models typically trained with 30k iterations. For the CT reconstruction task, LINGO also demonstrates consistent improvements, with average PSNR and SSIM gains of 0.36 and 0.0134. These results highlight LINGO's effectiveness in both accelerating training and enhancing reconstruction quality across different sparse-view imaging scenarios.

AI.tldr: LINGO框架通过潜在初始化与动态梯度优化，缓解稀疏视角X射线成像中3DGS的初始化噪声、位置不敏感与低密度区梯度弱问题，在新视角合成和CT重建任务上均提升质量并加速训练。
AI.motivation: 稀疏视角X射线成像角度覆盖不足，导致结构歧义与噪声累积。将3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）与X射线吸收物理结合虽有前景，但存在初始化噪声大、位置不敏感、低密度区域梯度弱等问题，限制了重建效果与训练效率。
AI.method: 提出统一的潜在初始化与梯度优化（LINGO）框架：结合潜在掩码空间初始化与动态梯度优化；从X射线掩码构建体素级3D滤波器以抑制背景噪声并提供几何先验；采用自适应体素缩放策略与动态缩放损失，调整空间分辨率并显式放大低密度结构的梯度；同时提出初始化点云结构偏差（IPSD）指标评估初始化质量。
AI.result: 在X3D数据集上，新视角合成任务中，相同稀疏视角设置下PSNR和SSIM平均分别提升0.72和0.0039；在约5k步内即可达到通常需30k迭代训练的先进模型的重建质量。CT重建任务中PSNR和SSIM平均分别提升0.36和0.0134。
AI.conclusion: LINGO在不同稀疏视角成像场景中均能加速训练并提升重建质量，验证了其有效性。

title: SmoLSTM: A Compact Vision-Language-Action Model with Recurrent Memory that Persists
comment: Submitted to ICRA 2027
summary: Vision-language-action models often predict actions from only the current observation, which can leave tasks involving object occlusion or visually identical objects ambiguous without episode history. The usual countermeasure, widening the observation window, turns the horizon into a hyperparameter and lets per-step cost grow with it. We instead capture the episode in a recurrent state. SmoLSTM couples a frozen 256M-parameter SmolVLM backbone to a matrix-memory LSTM control layer in which observation tokens and action queries are unified in a single causal stream that is never reset throughout the entire episode. Recurrent-state storage is therefore O(1) in episode length. A flow-matching action head predicts chunks of 10 end-effector pose deltas and gripper commands at each control step. Our single policy, trained jointly on 7,461 demonstrations across 140 tasks and evaluated on held-out initial states, performs best, reaching 85.1% subgoal coverage and 77.5% full-task success on LIBERO-Mem with 0.04B trainable parameters, surpassing both the benchmark's own object-centric baseline and recent memory-based approaches. Resetting the recurrent state at every control step reduces full-task success to 7.0%, showing that the trained policy relies on context carried between decisions. The same model achieves 79.6% average success on standard LIBERO.

AI.tldr: 提出 SmoLSTM：将冻结的 SmolVLM 主干与矩阵记忆 LSTM 控制层结合，把观测 token 与动作查询统一为整段 episode 内不重置的因果流，以 O(1) 状态存储实现历史记忆，在 LIBERO-Mem 上取得最优表现。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通常仅依据当前观测预测动作，在存在物体遮挡或视觉上相同物体的任务中，缺乏 episode 历史会导致任务歧义。常见对策是扩大观测窗口，但这会把时间视野变成超参数，并使单步计算成本随窗口增长。
AI.method: SmoLSTM 以冻结的 256M 参数 SmolVLM 为主干，耦合一个矩阵记忆 LSTM 控制层；观测 token 与动作查询统一在单个因果流中，且在整个 episode 内从不重置，因此循环状态存储相对 episode 长度为 O(1)。动作端采用 flow-matching 动作头，每个控制步预测 10 个末端执行器位姿增量与夹爪命令的动作块。
AI.result: 单一策略在 140 个任务、7,461 条演示上联合训练，并在留出初始状态上评估：在 LIBERO-Mem 上达到 85.1% 子目标覆盖率和 77.5% 全任务成功率，可训练参数仅 0.04B，优于该基准自带的物体中心基线及近期基于记忆的方法；若每个控制步重置循环状态，全任务成功率降至 7.0%。同一模型在标准 LIBERO 上平均成功率为 79.6%。
AI.conclusion: 以循环状态承载 episode 历史，可在不扩大观测窗口、不增加单步成本的情况下解决遮挡与同形物体歧义；循环状态重置导致的性能骤降表明策略确实依赖决策间传递的上下文，且该记忆机制可泛化到标准 LIBERO 任务。

title: Image Frame Dynamic Object Segmentation and Ego Motion Estimation using Radar Image Fusion
comment: Accepted for presentation at IEEE IROS 2026 Workshop LTP
summary: Dynamic object segmentation and ego-motion estimation are closely coupled problems in autonomous driving, as accurate ego-motion estimation typically requires static scene observations, while identifying static observations requires knowledge of the ego motion. We present Radar-Dot, a radar--RGB framework that exploits radar Doppler measurements to address this coupling. Radar returns are first used to estimate ego velocity through a linear Doppler constraint, with residual-based static/dynamic segmentation and robust estimation used to reduce the influence of moving objects. The estimated motion is then combined with metric depth and dense optical flow to identify image regions whose observed motion is inconsistent with the rigid scene motion. Experiments on 10 nuScenes scenes (part of nuscenes-mini) demonstrate that the resulting geometric pipeline achieves 20.24% dynamic IoU and 33.67% F1-score over 394 frame pairs, while radar-based static-point filtering improves ego-velocity estimation compared with using all radar returns. These results demonstrate the potential of radar as a modality for jointly improving ego-motion estimation and dynamic object segmentation.

AI.tldr: 提出Radar-Dot框架，利用雷达多普勒测量解耦动态物体分割与自运动估计的耦合问题。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶中动态目标分割与自运动估计紧密耦合：精确自运动估计通常需要静态场景观测，而识别静态观测又依赖已知自运动，两者互为前提。
AI.method: 雷达-图像框架。先用雷达回波通过线性多普勒约束估计自车速度，并借助残差驱动的静态/动态分割与鲁棒估计降低运动物体影响；再将估计运动与度量深度、稠密光流结合，识别观测运动与刚性场景运动不一致的图像区域。
AI.result: 在nuScenes的10个场景（nuscenes-mini子集）上，394个帧对上动态IoU达20.24%、F1-score达33.67%；相比使用全部雷达回波，基于雷达的静态点滤波提升了自车速度估计精度。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明雷达作为联合提升自运动估计与动态目标分割的模态具有潜力。

title: From Lexical Baselines to Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation: Structured Skill and Responsibility-Level Extraction with the SFIA Framework
summary: Automated skill extraction underpins workforce planning, yet most systems represent skills as flat labels with no notion of the responsibility level at which a skill is practiced. The Skills Framework for the Information Age (SFIA) captures exactly this dimension, defining 147 professional skills across seven responsibility levels, but no automated LLM-based extraction targeting SFIA has been reported. We formalize the task as structured prediction of (skill, level) pairs from free text and ask three questions: how accurately can text be mapped onto SFIA's closed vocabulary, which strategies reliably predict the level alongside the skill, and do agentic designs improve on simpler retrieval and prompting? We evaluate five strategies (a lexical baseline, dense retrieval with LLM reranking, a zero-shot schema-constrained LLM, single-agent agentic RAG, and a three-agent retriever--matcher--verifier crew) against expert-mapped European ICT role profiles, all drawing on an SFIA~9 corpus built by a fully automated agentic pipeline that we release. Retrieval-based matching identifies the most skills while generative strategies are markedly more precise; only strategies assigning the level as an explicit decision predict it reliably, with similarity-based selection more than twice as inaccurate; and the crew doubles latency without improving accuracy, so added agent roles do not automatically benefit closed-taxonomy matching. These results provide the first reproducible baseline for structured, level-aware skill extraction against SFIA.

AI.tldr: 本文首次针对SFIA框架开展结构化的"技能-职责等级"联合抽取研究，比较五种策略并给出可复现基线。
AI.motivation: 现有技能抽取系统多将技能表示为扁平标签，缺乏"技能所对应的职责等级"这一维度；SFIA框架恰好定义了147项技能与七个职责等级，但尚无基于LLM的自动化抽取工作。
AI.method: 将任务形式化为从自由文本预测（技能, 等级）对的结构化预测，并构建自动化agentic流程生成SFIA 9语料；在专家标注的欧洲ICT角色画像上评测五种策略：词汇基线、稠密检索+LLM重排、零样本schema约束LLM、单智能体agentic RAG，以及三智能体（检索—匹配—验证）协作方案。
AI.result: 检索式匹配识别出的技能数量最多，而生成式策略精确率明显更高；只有将等级作为显式决策输出的策略才能可靠预测等级，基于相似度的选择错误率高出两倍以上；三智能体协作使延迟翻倍却未提升准确率。
AI.conclusion: 增加智能体角色并不必然有利于封闭分类体系下的匹配；该研究为SFIA的结构化、等级感知技能抽取提供了首个可复现基线。

title: Planning-Aligned Pretraining of BEV Representations with Sparse Action-Conditioned Targets for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summary: End-to-end driving requires planning-relevant bird's-eye-view (BEV) representations, but existing pretraining approaches often rely on task annotations or dense scene reconstruction. We introduce PAVER, Planning-Aligned BEV Encoder Pretraining. From a single LiDAR sweep, PAVER constructs sparse risk and unknown targets describing occupied and unobserved evidence along rule-based ego motions. A 10K-parameter head predicts these targets from masked BEV features conditioned on the action state, directing supervision toward geometric constraints on candidate motions. Pretraining requires no driving-task annotations or dense reconstruction. Only the BEV encoder is transferred, preserving the downstream architecture and camera-only inference. On nuScenes, PAVER reduces VAD-Tiny's average collision rate from 0.51% to 0.19%, while improving planning L2, motion prediction, detection, and mapping. The selected VAD-Tiny and VAD-Base schedules use about 36% less estimated total training time than scratch training, including pretraining. On Bench2Drive Town05 Long, PAVER improves UniAD-Tiny's closed-loop Driving Score from 48.45 to 58.79. The project page is available at https://archiiive99.github.io/PAVER.

AI.tldr: PAVER 提出一种与规划对齐的 BEV 编码器预训练方法，无需驾驶任务标注或稠密重建，仅用单次 LiDAR 扫描构造稀疏风险与未知目标进行自监督预训练，仅迁移 BEV 编码器，在 nuScenes 与 Bench2Drive 上提升规划安全性与闭环性能并降低训练成本。
AI.motivation: 端到端驾驶需要规划相关的 BEV 表示，但现有预训练方法通常依赖任务标注或稠密场景重建，成本高且与规划目标不直接对齐。
AI.method: 从单次 LiDAR 扫描出发，沿基于规则的 ego 运动构造稀疏的 risk 与 unknown 目标，分别描述被占据与未观测证据；用一个 10K 参数的头在动作状态条件下从掩码 BEV 特征预测这些目标，将监督导向候选运动的几何约束。预训练不需驾驶任务标注或稠密重建，且仅迁移 BEV 编码器，保持下游架构与纯相机推理。
AI.result: nuScenes 上，VAD-Tiny 平均碰撞率从 0.51% 降至 0.19%，同时改善规划 L2、运动预测、检测与建图；所选 VAD-Tiny 与 VAD-Base 训练方案相比从头训练（含预训练）约减少 36% 估计总训练时间。Bench2Drive Town05 Long 上，UniAD-Tiny 闭环驾驶分数从 48.45 提升至 58.79。
AI.conclusion: PAVER 证明无需任务标注或稠密重建的规划对齐 BEV 预训练可有效提升端到端驾驶的安全性与闭环表现，并降低训练成本，且与下游架构解耦、兼容纯相机推理。

title: Per-Query Gating of LLM Rerankers for Multi-Hop Retrieval
comment: 15 pages, 2 figures, 13 tables. v2 adds a loss-budget (calibrated) gating rule with expected versus realised harm, and a retrained deployment policy. Evaluation code, per-query results and generated tables in the source archive
summary: LLM rerankers add of the order of \$0.2-0.3 per 1,000 queries and about a second of tail latency on top of a graph-augmented dense pipeline such as HippoRAG2, and on three multi-hop benchmarks they improve final-hop top-K coverage on seven of nine (dataset, K) cells, by up to +34.8 pp. We ask whether a learned per-query gate can skip the reranker where it will not help, using only features available before the LLM call (27 score and lexical statistics of the two retrieval lists plus a PCA of a small query embedding) with an executable fallback. Every choice, including the fallback and the threshold, is made inside the training fold and applied once to held-out queries, and harmful skips (the rerank would have found the target, the fallback did not) are reported next to the aggregate coverage. Across nine cells on 2WikiMultiHopQA, MuSiQue and HotpotQA the gate skips 51% of calls at an average held-out LastHop@K cost of 1.2 pp; four cells meet a pre-registered 1 pp rule, harmful skips occur in eight (190 harmful against 136 beneficial), and a random gate at the same skip rate loses 2 to 11 pp on the high-lift cells. A second rule sets each cell's threshold from a pre-specified budget on the expected harmful-skip rate over Platt-calibrated harm probabilities (ECE 0.025 after calibration, 0.094 before): at a 1 pp budget the gate skips 42% at -0.8 pp with 66 harmful skips and six cells within 1 pp, but realised harm exceeds the promise in six cells (mean 1.45 vs 0.83 pp), a selection optimism we quantify; a 0.5 pp budget realises about 1 pp. The harm probabilities are calibrated but barely discriminative (AUC 0.16 to 0.70). An earlier version reported 73% "lossless" savings; that figure rested on an oracle fallback and a wrong MuSiQue target, and we document both.

AI.tldr: 本文研究能否用可学习的逐查询门控（gate），仅凭 LLM 调用前的特征来判断是否跳过 LLM 重排器。在 2WikiMultiHopQA、MuSiQue、HotpotQA 九个 (数据集, K) 单元上，门控可跳过 51% 的调用，平均 held-out LastHop@K 损失 1.2 pp；但有害跳过多于有益跳过（190 对 136），且危害概率虽经校准却几乎无区分度（AUC 0.16–0.70）。
AI.motivation: LLM 重排器在 HippoRAG2 这类图增强稠密检索流水线上代价不低：每千次查询增加约 0.2–0.3 美元、约一秒尾延迟，但在三个多跳基准上能提升九个 (数据集, K) 单元中七个的最终跳 top-K 覆盖率，最高 +34.8 pp。作者由此提出：能否用一个可学习的逐查询门控，在重排器无益时跳过它，从而在保留收益的同时削减成本。
AI.method: 门控仅使用 LLM 调用前可获得的特征：两个检索列表的 27 个分数与词汇统计量，以及小型查询嵌入的 PCA。所有选择（包括回退策略与阈值）均在训练折内确定，并一次性应用于留出查询。评估时同时报告有害跳过（重排本可找到目标、而回退未找到）与总体覆盖率。第二种规则用 Platt 校准后的危害概率，在预先指定的期望有害跳过率预算下设定各单元阈值。
AI.result: 在九个单元上，门控跳过 51% 的调用，平均 held-out LastHop@K 损失 1.2 pp；四个单元满足预注册的 1 pp 规则；有害跳过出现在八个单元（190 次有害对 136 次有益）；同跳过率下的随机门控在高增益单元上损失 2–11 pp。基于预算的规则：1 pp 预算下跳过 42%、-0.8 pp、66 次有害跳过、六个单元在 1 pp 内，但六个单元实际危害超出承诺（均值 1.45 vs 0.83 pp）；0.5 pp 预算实际约 1 pp。危害概率经校准（ECE 0.094→0.025）但区分度很弱（AUC 0.16–0.70）。
AI.conclusion: 仅用 LLM 调用前特征的门控确实能大幅削减重排调用（约 42%–51%），但代价并非无损：有害跳过在多数单元多于有益跳过，且危害概率缺乏区分度，导致基于预算的阈值存在选择乐观与超预算风险。早期版本报告的 73% “无损”节省依赖 oracle 回退与错误的 MuSiQue 目标，本文对这两点均予以更正。

title: Block-Sparse Attention with Semantic-Geometric Decoupled Routing
comment: Technical report; Submitted to ACL ARR 2026 May
summary: Long-context inference has become a defining capability of large language models, but exact dense attention remains costly due to its quadratic scaling with sequence length. Block-sparse attention offers a hardware-friendly alternative by routing each query block to a small set of relevant key blocks, yet accurate training-free block routing remains difficult. Existing routers often pool post-RoPE token representations, which entangles semantic aggregation with RoPE-induced geometry and attenuates local positional cues through high-frequency phase cancellation. To resolve this mismatch, we propose \textbf{Semantic-Geometric Decoupled Routing}, a training-free block routing framework that shifts semantic aggregation to the pre-RoPE space and reconstructs geometric bias with an offline structural prior and relative block distances. This decomposition yields an explicit closed-form block routing score without token-level search or post-hoc calibration. Experiments on long-context text and video tasks show that our method approaches full-attention accuracy across 4K--128K contexts, keeps routing overhead below 3.4 ms, and achieves a 5.03$\times$ speedup over FlashAttn at a 128K context length.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"语义-几何解耦路由"（Semantic-Geometric Decoupled Routing），一种免训练块稀疏注意力路由框架：将语义聚合移至RoPE前空间，并用离线结构先验与相对块距离重构几何偏置，得到显式闭式路由分数，无需token级搜索或事后校准。在4K–128K长文本与视频任务上接近全注意力精度，路由开销低于3.4 ms，128K下较FlashAttn加速5.03倍。
AI.motivation: 长上下文推理成为LLM核心能力，但精确稠密注意力随序列长度二次增长，代价高昂。块稀疏注意力通过将每个查询块路由到少量相关键块，提供硬件友好的替代方案，但免训练的精确块路由仍困难。现有路由器多在RoPE后对token表示做池化，导致语义聚合与RoPE引入的几何纠缠，并通过高频相位抵消削弱局部位置线索。
AI.method: 提出语义-几何解耦路由：将语义聚合迁移到RoPE前空间，避免语义与RoPE几何耦合；同时用离线结构先验与相对块距离重构几何偏置。通过该分解得到显式的闭式块路由评分，无需token级搜索或事后校准。
AI.result: 在长上下文文本与视频任务上，方法在4K–128K上下文范围内接近全注意力精度；路由开销低于3.4 ms；在128K上下文长度下相较FlashAttn取得5.03倍加速。
AI.conclusion: 通过在RoPE前空间做语义聚合、并显式建模几何偏置，可有效解决现有块路由器的语义-几何纠缠与位置线索衰减问题，实现免训练、低开销且高精度的块稀疏注意力路由，兼具精度与效率优势。

title: Are Coreset Selection Methods Worth Their Cost?
comment: 23 pages, 7 figures. Benchmark artifacts include per-run result tables, selected indices, and raw timing-audit tables
summary: Coreset selection picks a representative subset of the labeled training set to make training cheaper. However, it is usually evaluated by downstream accuracy at a fixed subset size, ignoring both the time spent selecting the subset and the training recipe behind each reported number. We introduce an end-to-end benchmark that standardizes downstream training and charges selection and training to the same auditable wall-clock budget, spanning 4 datasets from CIFAR-10 to ImageNet-1K, 11 selectors, 5 fractions, and 3 seeds, with over 1,500 released runs. Repeated-sampling work has shown that budget-aware evaluation already favors random strategies. Our two budget studies test whether that verdict survives when every selector is granted its most favorable operating point. Across eight wall-clock budget anchors on each of CIFAR-10 and Tiny ImageNet, no anchor is won by a sophisticated selector: every winner is class-balanced random sampling, repeated random sampling, or full-data training. In fixed-budget duels on ImageNet-1K, training on all data for fewer epochs beats every selection strategy we probe while also costing the least. A per-dataset cost audit shows that selection cost is dominated at every scale by a fixed full-dataset scan, so it cannot be amortized away by selecting a smaller fraction, and its absolute size does not extrapolate from one dataset to another. We further quantify when selection does pay back through subset reuse, and document 9 correctness fixes to a widely used codebase, one of which shifts a standard Herding baseline by nearly 6 points. Selection time is not free preprocessing, and an evaluation that ignores it measures the wrong quantity.

AI.tldr: 论文提出端到端基准，将coreset选择与下游训练计入同一可审计的wall-clock预算，发现预算感知下没有复杂选择器胜出，选择成本不可忽视。
AI.motivation: 现有coreset选择通常以固定子集规模下的下游精度评估，忽略选择子集所耗时间以及每次报告数字背后的训练方案，导致评估的是"错误量"，需要纳入端到端预算进行重新审视。
AI.method: 构建标准化下游训练的端到端基准，将选择与训练计入同一wall-clock预算；覆盖4个数据集（CIFAR-10至ImageNet-1K）、11种选择器、5种比例、3个随机种子，发布超1,500次运行；在CIFAR-10与Tiny ImageNet各8个预算锚点进行两部预算研究，并在ImageNet-1K进行固定预算对决，同时做按数据集成本审计。
AI.result: 8个预算锚点无一由复杂选择器获胜，胜者均为类平衡随机采样、重复随机采样或全数据训练；ImageNet-1K固定预算对决中，全数据少轮训练击败所有选择策略且成本最低；选择成本在各规模均被固定全数据扫描主导，无法通过更小比例摊销，其绝对值也不可跨数据集外推；并记录9处代码修正，其中一处使标准Herding基线偏移近6个点。
AI.conclusion: 选择时间并非免费预处理，忽略它的评估测量的是错误目标；预算感知的端到端评估表明，在此设定下复杂coreset选择器难以胜出，选择有时需通过子集复用来回本。

title: Combining Foundation Model Confidence and Monocular Depth for Training-Free Out-of-Distribution Segmentation
summary: Autonomous vehicles operating in open-world scenarios are inevitably confronted with previously unknown objects, such as exotic animals or loose cargo. The reliable detection and segmentation of these out-of-distribution (OOD) objects is therefore crucial for a safe understanding of the environment and decision-making. Most existing approaches require access to OOD training samples, retraining of the segmentation backbone, or dedicated auxiliary architectures, limiting their practical applicability. We propose a training-free method that derives dense OOD scores directly from the confidence predictions of a foundation segmentation model, without any task-specific fine-tuning or access to anomalous data. To improve the robustness of our OOD segmentation, geometric information from monocular depth estimation is incorporated into the decision process, providing complementary cues to uncertainty-based predictions. We evaluate the proposed method on the SegmentMeIfYouCan benchmark and additionally assess its performance on OOD tracking in video sequences, reflecting the temporal nature of real-world perception systems. The method performs strongly on road-centered benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出一种免训练的OOD分割方法，直接从基础分割模型置信度预测导出密集OOD分数，并融合单目深度几何信息提升鲁棒性，在SegmentMeIfYouCan基准及视频OOD跟踪上评估，在道路场景基准上表现良好。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶在开放世界场景中必然遭遇未知物体（如奇异动物、散落货物），可靠检测与分割这些分布外（OOD）物体对安全的环境理解与决策至关重要。然而现有方法多依赖OOD训练样本、需重训练分割主干或专用辅助架构，限制了实际应用性。
AI.method: 无需训练的方法：直接从基础分割模型的置信度预测中导出密集OOD分数，无需任务特定微调，也无需访问异常数据；并将单目深度估计提供的几何信息融入决策过程，为基于不确定性的预测提供互补线索。
AI.result: 在SegmentMeIfYouCan基准上进行评估，并额外评估其在视频序列中OOD跟踪的性能，以反映真实感知系统的时间特性。该方法在以道路为中心的基准上表现强劲。
AI.conclusion: 该方法以免训练方式实现OOD分割，避免了对异常数据的依赖与重训练开销，结合深度几何线索增强鲁棒性，并在道路场景基准及视频OOD跟踪中取得良好表现。

title: Scout: Open-World Species Recognition on the Edge
comment: Under Review
summary: Large vision-language models (VLMs) enable recognition beyond a fixed class set, but their computational demands prevent them from running on many edge devices. Cloud offload makes this capability accessible, but sending every image consumes scarce bandwidth and communication energy. We ask how to bring the open-world recognition capability of VLMs to the edge while operating within tight compute, energy, and bandwidth budgets. Wildlife monitoring provides a natural setting for exploring this question because camera traps encounter species not known at deployment. We present Scout, an autonomous open-world recognition system that invokes a cloud VLM intermittently to teach new classes to a compact edge model. Given only the deployment location and empty site frames, Scout autonomously turns each species identified by the VLM into persistent, site-conditioned recognition capability in a resource-efficient edge model, without a predefined species list, human labeling, or manual tuning. Across 30 camera-trap deployments in three regions on an NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano, the accuracy of Scout remains within 0.1-2.5% of a model given a predefined species list. On species outside its initial class set, Scout achieves 53.7-59.1% accuracy, compared with 56.5-65.1% for full cloud offload, while using 59-71% less deployment energy.

AI.tldr: Scout 是一个面向边缘设备的自主开放世界识别系统，通过间歇性调用云端 VLM 指导紧凑边缘模型学习新类别，在野生动物监测场景中实现接近云端全卸载的精度，同时减少 59-71% 部署能耗。
AI.motivation: 大型视觉语言模型（VLM）具备开放世界识别能力，但计算需求高、难以在边缘设备运行；云端卸载虽可行，却因上传每张图像而消耗稀缺带宽与通信能量。因此需要在紧苛的计算、能量与带宽预算下，将 VLM 的开放世界识别能力带到边缘。
AI.method: 提出 Scout 自主开放世界识别系统：仅间歇性调用云端 VLM，将 VLM 识别出的物种转化为紧凑边缘模型中持久、站点条件化的识别能力。系统仅需部署地点与空场景帧，无需预定义物种列表、人工标注或手动调参。
AI.result: 在三个区域、30 个相机陷阱部署、NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano 上：Scout 精度与给定预定义物种列表的模型相差仅 0.1-2.5%；对初始类别集之外的物种达到 53.7-59.1% 准确率，而完整云端卸载为 56.5-65.1%，但 Scout 减少 59-71% 的部署能耗。
AI.conclusion: Scout 证明了在边缘端以低通信与能耗预算实现开放世界识别是可行的，能够在不依赖预定义类别与人工干预的情况下接近云端全卸载的识别性能。

title: LLMs Anchor on Chief Complaint and Fail to Integrate Evidence in Sequential Clinical Triage
comment: Under Review
summary: Triage in the emergency department (ED) is a sequential decision process that unfolds turn by turn. Existing evaluations of large language models (LLMs) for triage use completed retrospective records and report performance close to that of physicians. We implement a methodology for evaluating LLMs on sequential triage, the task of predicting a triage acuity label from a growing prefix of a nurse-patient conversation. We evaluate six LLMs at five sequential checkpoints on two corpora: 425 LLM-generated (SIMULATED) and 50 physician-authored (CLINICIAN) conversations, both labelled under the Emergency Severity Index (ESI). Every model, measured by quadratic weighted kappa (QWK), degrades from moderate-to-substantial agreement on completed records to fair-to-moderate agreement at every sequential checkpoint. Controlled perturbations show that the label at every checkpoint is anchored on the chief complaint exchanges, and prompting interventions fail to lift this plateau. Models extract clinically relevant content from later turns, yet the surprisal of the true label rises across the checkpoints. So the model fails to integrate the evidence. Three expert clinicians on the same conversations reach a QWK of 0.887-0.929, while the best model reaches 0.295. Predictions concentrate at ESI-2 and ESI-3, and models agree with each other more than with the ground truth, so ensembling worsens the failure. Deploying LLMs for ED triage based on offline benchmarks alone misses this sequential failure.

AI.tldr: 本文提出序贯分诊评测方法，发现LLM在逐轮对话前缀上性能显著下降，仅锚定主诉，无法整合后续证据。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM分诊评测基于已完成回顾性病历，报告的准确率接近医生水平；但真实急诊分诊是逐轮展开的序贯决策过程，这种离线评测方式可能掩盖模型在信息逐步累积场景中的失效。
AI.method: 构建序贯分诊评测方法：让模型根据护士-患者对话的不断增长前缀预测ESI分诊等级。评测6个LLM在5个序贯检查点上的表现，使用两个语料：425段LLM生成（SIMULATED）对话与50段医生撰写（CLINICIAN）对话，均以ESI标注。指标为二次加权kappa（QWK）；并进行受控扰动实验和提示干预；另由三位专家临床医生在相同对话上进行标注对照。
