AI.result: 所有模型从完整病历上的中等至较高一致性下降至每个序贯检查点的中等偏下一致性。受控扰动表明各检查点标签均锚定于主诉交流；提示干预无法提升这一平台期。模型虽能提取后续轮次的临床相关内容，但真实标签的surprisal随检查点上升，说明未能整合证据。三位专家QWK达0.887–0.929，最佳模型仅0.295。预测集中于ESI-2与ESI-3，且模型间一致性高于与真值的一致性，故集成反而恶化性能。
AI.conclusion: 仅凭离线基准部署LLM进行急诊分诊会遗漏其序贯失效问题；需采用序贯评测以真实反映临床可用性。

title: AVTR-1: Open Stack for Real-Time Interactive Avatars
summary: Talking-head and dyadic models now achieve real-time inference, yet fast motion generation alone does not produce an interactive conversation. A live system must synchronize the model's output with speech from an external voice agent, schedule video frames for playback, and handle interruptions. We introduce AVTR-1, an open stack for real-time interactive avatar conversations, built around a compact 153M-parameter autoregressive flow-matching motion generator conditioned on both participants' audio. We adapt its audio encoder for streaming through self-distillation. The stack turns the model's chunk-based generation into a continuous, synchronized audio-video stream driven by an external voice agent, and we analytically derive its contribution to the user-facing latencies and validate the resulting bounds with two commercial voice agents. Further experiments demonstrate that AVTR-1 leads the compared dyadic systems on all reported visual-quality metrics and most conventional listening-motion metrics while remaining competitive in lip synchronization. Its inference runtime operates in real time on data-center and consumer GPUs. However, conventional listening metrics do not establish whether the paired speaker's speech contributes to generated motion. We therefore introduce the Reference-Based Directed Granger Gain (R-DGG), which measures the additional predictive information carried by speaker speech after accounting for listener history and speaker motion. R-DGG finds statistically supported predictive dependence for recorded listeners and all evaluated dyadic systems, but not for talking-head generators without paired audio or mismatched speaker-listener pairs. We release the model weights, renderer, and serving backend under component-specific licenses.

AI.tldr: AVTR-1：面向实时交互式数字人对话的开源全栈系统，含153M参数自回归流匹配动作生成器，支持流式音频编码与外部语音代理同步，并提出R-DGG指标验证二元听者动作对说话人语音的预测依赖。
AI.motivation: 现有talking-head与dyadic模型虽已实现实时推理，但快速动作生成本身不足以构成交互式对话：系统还需与外部语音代理同步、调度视频帧播放并处理打断。此外，传统听者动作指标无法证明配对说话人的语音是否真正影响生成动作。
AI.method: 构建AVTR-1开源栈，核心为153M参数、以双方音频为条件的紧凑自回归流匹配动作生成器；通过自蒸馏将音频编码器改造为流式；将分块生成转为由外部语音代理驱动的连续同步音视频流；解析推导其对用户可感延迟的贡献并用两个商业语音代理验证边界；提出R-DGG指标，在控制听者历史与说话人动作后度量说话人语音带来的额外预测信息。
AI.result: AVTR-1在所有报告的视觉质量指标及多数常规听者动作指标上领先对比的dyadic系统，唇同步保持竞争力，推理在数据中心与消费级GPU上均实时运行；延迟边界经两个商业语音代理验证。R-DGG在录制的听者及所有评估的dyadic系统上发现统计显著预测依赖，而在无配对音频的talking-head生成器或不匹配的说话人-听者配对上未发现。
AI.conclusion: 实时动作生成需与语音代理同步、帧调度及打断处理共同构成完整交互系统的抽象，AVTR-1验证了该全栈路线的可行性与实时性；R-DGG为听者动作的交互依赖性提供了可检验的度量，并区分了真正的dyadic生成与单向talking-head生成。模型权重、渲染器与服务后端已按组件许可开源。

title: Planning and Rendering in Concert: DeepFusion of Autoregressive Layouts and Diffusion for Visual Text Generation
summary: Generating text-rich images from prompts requires both textual fidelity and the coherent integration of text into the surrounding image. An explicit layout can provide structured guidance about what text should appear and where, but a well-formed plan alone does not guarantee that the renderer will realize it faithfully. Existing layout-based AR-diffusion systems typically optimize planning and rendering separately, preventing the planner's representations from being adapted jointly with image synthesis. We introduce DuetGen, an autonomous visual text generator built on DeepFusion, which jointly learns autoregressive planning and continuous diffusion rendering. DeepFusion conditions a diffusion transformer on the planner's prompt and bbox-content hidden states, allowing rendering supervision to shape the representations connecting textual plans with visual outputs. Its joint objective combines autoregressive plan supervision, text-region-weighted diffusion learning, and auxiliary coordinate supervision to maintain structured planning, emphasize text-bearing regions, and improve the spatial precision of planner representations. During inference, Phase-Aware Attention Modulation strengthens the correspondence between image regions and their matched coordinate and content states, facilitating region-specific execution of the generated plan. With a 2B planner and a 4B single-stream DiT, DuetGen achieves 0.8293 word accuracy on CVTG-2K and 0.938 accuracy on LongText-Bench, closely matching the substantially larger Qwen-Image on both benchmarks. These results demonstrate the value of jointly learned planning representations and region-specific rendering for autonomous visual text generation.

AI.tldr: 提出DuetGen，基于DeepFusion联合学习自回归布局规划与扩散渲染，在文本图像生成中兼顾文字保真与视觉融合，以较小模型规模接近大模型性能。
AI.motivation: 从提示生成富含文本的图像需同时保证文本保真度与文字和图像的整体融合。显式布局虽能提供“写什么、写在哪”的结构化指导，但仅有好的规划并不能保证渲染器忠实实现。现有基于布局的自回归-扩散系统通常将规划与渲染分开优化，导致规划器表示无法与图像合成联合适配。
AI.method: 提出DuetGen，一种基于DeepFusion的自主视觉文本生成器，联合学习自回归规划与连续扩散渲染。DeepFusion将扩散Transformer的条件建立在规划器的prompt与bbox-content隐状态之上，使渲染监督能够塑造连接文本规划与视觉输出的表示。联合目标融合三项：自回归规划监督、文本区域加权扩散学习、辅助坐标监督，以维持结构化规划、强调含文本区域并提升规划器表示的空间精度。推理阶段采用Phase-Aware Attention Modulation，加强图像区域与其匹配的坐标、内容状态之间的对应，实现按区域执行生成计划。模型采用2B规划器与4B单流DiT。
AI.result: 在CVTG-2K上取得0.8293的单词准确率，在LongText-Bench上取得0.938准确率，两项基准上均接近规模大得多的Qwen-Image。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，联合学习的规划表示与区域特定渲染对自主视觉文本生成具有重要价值。

title: An Iterative LangGraph Agent for Text-to-SQL: Natural Language Access to the Chicago Crime Database
summary: Non-technical stakeholders frequently cannot write the SQL needed to extract insights from operational databases. We built and evaluated a Text-to-SQL agent that closes this gap end to end: a six-node LangGraph StateGraph checks question relevance, fetches the live schema, generates PostgreSQL, validates it with a dry run, retries on failure, executes the query, and narrates the result set in plain English. The agent uses prompt engineering only; no model was fine-tuned. We evaluated it on the Chicago Crime dataset (approximately 8.5 million records, 22 attributes) against a hand-built benchmark of 100 natural language questions with ground-truth SQL, stratified into 30 Easy, 40 Medium and 30 Hard items. Comparing two prompt revisions of the same agent, the revised system (V2) reached a Valid SQL Rate of 93% (from 87%), an Execution Accuracy of 60% under a hybrid relational equivalence metric (from 47%; 19% from 12% under strict JSON matching), and a mean Synthesis Quality of 4.34 out of 5 (from 3.91). The single largest driver was removing a LIMIT 10 instruction from the system prompt, which had been truncating multi-row answers. Error analysis attributes the residual failures to relevance-checker false rejections, ambiguous question semantics, and free-tier API rate limits rather than to the language generation step. We report no comparison against an external baseline system or a public benchmark; the study is a single-model engineering evaluation.

AI.tldr: 构建并评估了一个仅靠提示工程的六节点LangGraph Text-to-SQL智能体，在Chicago Crime数据集（约850万条、22属性）的100题自建基准上，V2版将有效SQL率提升至93%、混合关系等价下的执行准确率达60%、结果叙述质量均值4.34/5。
AI.motivation: 非技术业务方往往无法编写SQL，难以从业务数据库中直接获取洞察；作者希望通过端到端的Text-to-SQL智能体填补"自然语言提问—可执行查询—通俗解释"这一链路缺口，且不依赖模型微调以降低工程门槛。
AI.method: 采用纯提示工程（无微调），在LangGraph中构建六节点StateGraph流程：问题相关性检查、实时schema获取、PostgreSQL生成、dry run校验、失败重试、查询执行、结果自然语言叙述。在Chicago Crime数据集（约850万条记录、22个属性）上，用100道带标准SQL的自然语言问题自建基准评测，分层为30道Easy、40道Medium、30道Hard，并对比同一智能体的两个提示版本（V1/V2）。
AI.result: V2相较V1：有效SQL率93%（原87%）；混合关系等价度量下执行准确率60%（原47%），严格JSON匹配下19%（原12%）；结果叙述质量均值4.34/5（原3.91）。改善的最大单一驱动因素是移除系统提示中的"LIMIT 10"指令（该指令此前会截断多行答案）。残余失败主要归因于相关性检查器的误拒、问题语义歧义与免费层API限流，而非语言生成环节。
AI.conclusion: 仅提示工程的Text-to-SQL智能体能显著提升SQL有效性与执行准确率，提示细节（如LIMIT约束）对多行回答质量影响巨大。该研究未与外部基线或公开基准对比，属单模型工程性评估，泛化性与相对先进性尚待验证。

title: Measuring Behavioural Signatures of Large Language Models through Psychometric Profiling
comment: 22 pages, 6 figures
summary: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly mediate human decisions and communication, yet their behavioural regularities remain difficult to characterize systematically. We develop a cross-linguistic psychometric profiling framework and evaluate nine LLMs using seven psychological instruments, with five repeated administrations per model and language in Chinese and English. Items unresolved after a prespecified retry procedure are retained as NA. Joint analysis of scored and NA responses captures response tendencies and boundaries of self-report applicability. LLMs exhibit structured, model-specific profiles despite a shared alignment-shaped pattern of higher prosocial and self-regulatory responses and lower dominance, disengagement and harmful-intent endorsement. NA responses are structured rather than uniformly distributed, indicating where outputs are treated as inapplicable, refused or cannot be mapped to valid response options. Language condition and provider origin are associated with profile configuration and answerability, whereas repeated administrations show high reproducibility and permit recovery of model identity. Human-reference and prompt-robustness analyses further indicate that these signatures are context dependent. Joint analysis of psychometric profiling and answerability offers a framework for quantifying deployment-level behavioural signatures.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建跨语言心理测量画像框架，用7种心理量表、中英双语、每模型每语言重复5次测评9个大语言模型，并将未解决的作答记为NA，联合分析计分与NA反应，以刻画模型的行为特征与自我报告适用边界。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型日益介入人类决策与交流，但其行为规律难以被系统刻画；现有评估多为单一任务或单语言，缺乏跨语言、可重复、能同时反映作答倾向与"无法作答"边界的测量框架。
AI.method: 提出跨语言心理测量画像框架；对9个LLM施测7种心理测量工具，中英双语，每模型每语言重复5次；对预设重试流程后仍无法解决的条目保留为NA；对计分反应与NA反应进行联合分析；并开展人类参照与提示稳健性分析。
AI.result: LLM表现出结构化的、模型特异的心理画像，同时共享一种"对齐塑造"的总体模式：亲社会与自我调节反应更高，支配性、脱离投入度与有害意图认同更低；NA反应呈结构化而非均匀分布，反映输出被视为不适用、被拒绝或无法映射到有效选项之处；语言条件与供应商来源与画像配置及可作答性相关；重复施测显示高可重复性，且可据此恢复模型身份；人类参照与提示稳健性分析表明这些特征具情境依赖性。
AI.conclusion: 联合心理测量画像与可作答性分析，可作为量化模型部署层面行为特征签名的通用框架。

title: Beyond Linear Context: Graph-Guided Evidence Navigation for Long-Novel Reasoning with a Local 9B Language Model
comment: 10 pages, 11 figures, 2 tables. Code, graph data and an interactive demo: https://github.com/fuxiaoji/novel-graph-lab
summary: Long-context models read a novel the way a person reads a printout: one token after another, in narrative order, with the whole history competing for a fixed budget of attention. A detective does not work that way. They sort what happened when, and they keep a map of who relates to whom, so a clue from chapter one can meet a question asked at the end of the book. We test whether a frozen knowledge graph can give a small local model that same freedom. Thirty detective novels and 234 multiple-choice questions are answered by one fixed qwen3.5:9b reader under nine conditions: five graph routes, a recent-window baseline, whole-book compression, ordinary vector retrieval, and a question-only control. The strongest graph route reaches 53.85% (126/234) against 46.15% for the recent window, 51.28% for compression, 51.71% for vector retrieval and 40.17% for question-only. On the subset that no model can answer without the book, the graph route reaches 42.86%. None of the fifteen graph-baseline contrasts survives Holm correction, so we present the result as exploratory evidence about a design. Two structural findings survive scrutiny better than the headline number: annotated evidence concentrates in the topological core of these graphs (2.35x enrichment, pooled), and the two graph-building pipelines differ so much in annotation coverage (16% versus 73% of clue paragraphs) that pooled accuracy alone would hide which bottleneck is being measured.

AI.tldr: 冻结知识图谱为小型本地模型提供结构化长文本访问：图路由准确率53.85%，优于滑动窗口、整书压缩与向量检索，但优势经Holm校正后不显著，属探索性设计证据。
AI.motivation: 长上下文模型按叙事顺序逐token读取，历史信息竞争固定注意力预算；而侦探式阅读需要按时间排序并维护人物关系地图，使第一章线索能与结尾问题对接。作者据此检验冻结知识图谱能否赋予小型本地模型这种自由，并对比多种图/非图检索路线。
AI.method: 使用固定qwen3.5:9b阅读器，在30部侦探小说、234道多选题上测试9种条件：5种图路由、近期窗口基线、整书压缩、普通向量检索、仅问题对照。统计15组图与基线的对比并做Holm多重校正；同时分析标注证据在图拓扑结构中的分布，以及两条图构建流程的标注覆盖率差异。
AI.result: 最强图路由53.85%(126/234)，近期窗口46.15%、压缩51.28%、向量检索51.71%、仅问题40.17%；在无书不可答子集上图路由42.86%。15组图-基线对比无一通过Holm校正。两个稳健结构发现：标注证据集中于图的拓扑核心（合并分析2.35倍富集）；两条建图流程标注覆盖率相差悬殊（16% vs 73%线索段落），仅看合并准确率会掩盖所测瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: 知识图谱路由在数值上优于各基线，但统计上不足以支持确证性结论，应视为关于设计的探索性证据；更可靠的发现是证据的拓扑核心富集与建图流程覆盖率的巨大差异，提示评测需区分瓶颈来源而非只看总准确率。

title: D3GS: Depth, DINO, and RGB Diffusion Co-Guided 3D Gaussian Splatting for Sparse-View Reconstruction
summary: Novel view synthesis from sparse inputs remains challenging for 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) due to ambiguous geometry, cross-view inconsistency, and missing details in under-constrained regions, resulting in degraded reconstruction and unstable rendering. To tackle these issues, we propose D$^{3}$GS, a Depth-DINO-Diffusion guided sparse-view Gaussian reconstruction framework that jointly enhances geometry and appearance. D$^{3}$GS first recovers a high-resolution, metric depth map via diffusion-based completion and DPT (Dense Prediction Transformer) refinement, providing robust Gaussian initialization and geometric constraints. Then, a DINO-guided view-consistent learning is introduced to augment Gaussian attributes with structural features, improving multi-view consistency. Finally, a diffusion-based Gaussian refinement module injects generative priors into an iterative optimization strategy, enhancing high-frequency geometric and appearance details within the Gaussian representation. Experiments on DTU, LLFF, and Mip-NeRF 360 show that D$^{3}$GS achieves consistent and substantial improvements over strong baselines, with ablation studies validating the effectiveness and complementary roles of each component.

AI.tldr: D$^{3}$GS：面向稀疏视角3DGS的深度-DINO-扩散联合引导重建框架，通过深度补全初始化、DINO引导视角一致性学习与扩散先验细化，提升几何与外观重建质量。
AI.motivation: 稀疏输入下的3D高斯泼溅存在几何歧义、跨视角不一致、欠约束区域细节缺失等问题，导致重建质量下降与渲染不稳定。
AI.method: 框架包含三部分：（1）基于扩散补全与DPT细化的高分辨率度量深度图恢复，为高斯提供稳健初始化与几何约束；（2）DINO引导的视角一致性学习，用结构特征增强高斯属性以改善多视角一致性；（3）基于扩散的高斯细化模块，将生成先验注入迭代优化，增强高斯表示中的高频几何与外观细节。
AI.result: 在DTU、LLFF、Mip-NeRF 360数据集上相较强基线取得一致且显著的提升，消融实验验证了各模块的有效性及其互补作用。
AI.conclusion: 联合深度、DINO语义结构与扩散生成先验可有效缓解稀疏视角3DGS的几何与外观退化问题，是一种可扩展的稀疏视角重建方案。

title: An Evolutionary Agentic Approach for Open-ended Image Quality Perception
summary: Generative models are rapidly expanding image quality assessment (IQA) beyond traditional fidelity factors to emerging dimensions such as physical plausibility and text-rendering correctness. However, existing IQA models rely on fixed definitions and heavy supervision, making them difficult to extend to open-ended perceptual dimensions. We identify holistic bias as an important limitation: when scoring an unseen dimension, models reuse generic quality priors, leading to scoring errors and rank inversion. To address this, we propose PACE (Perceptual Agentic Collaborative Evolution), a training-free multi-agent framework that formulates open-ended IQA as explicit protocol construction. Given a target dimension, PACE uses collaborative agents to construct an evaluation protocol composed of verifiable Visual Question Answering (VQA) probes, grounding evaluation in concrete visual evidence rather than holistic impressions. The resulting protocol is calibrated using only four human-annotated images per dimension, while a dual-track scoring mechanism aligns model perception with human scoring scales. Across traditional IQA, structural fidelity, context-aware aesthetics, and newly defined open-ended dimensions, PACE consistently improves its MLLM backbone, achieving competitive performance across diverse IQA settings, and reduces the Holistic Override Rate (HOR) from 44.4\% to 8.6\%.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练多智能体框架PACE，将开放式图像质量评估（IQA）重构为评估协议构建，用可验证VQA探针替代整体印象打分，仅需每维度4张人工标注图像即可校准，将整体覆盖错误率从44.4%降至8.6%。
AI.motivation: 生成模型使IQA从传统保真度扩展到物理合理性、文本渲染正确性等新兴维度，但现有IQA模型依赖固定维度定义与重监督，难以扩展到开放式感知维度。作者指出"整体偏置"（holistic bias）是关键局限：模型面对未见维度时复用通用质量先验，导致评分错误与排序反转。
AI.method: PACE为免训练的多智能体协作演化框架，把开放式IQA形式化为显式协议构建：针对目标维度，由协作智能体生成由可验证VQA探针组成的评估协议，将评估落地于具体视觉证据而非整体印象；协议仅用每维度4张人工标注图像校准，并采用双轨评分机制使模型感知对齐人类评分尺度。
AI.result: 在传统IQA、结构保真度、上下文感知美学及新定义的开放式维度上，PACE稳定提升其MLLM主干性能，在多种IQA设定下取得有竞争力的表现，并将整体覆盖错误率（HOR）从44.4%降至8.6%。
AI.conclusion: 显式协议构建与可验证VQA探针能有效缓解整体偏置，使免训练多智能体方案在低监督条件下适配开放式感知维度，为可扩展IQA提供了新范式。

title: Integrated Deep Learning Framework Designed on Hybrid Optimization Strategies for Automated Health Detection and Analysis in Silkworms
summary: A Hybrid Residual Attention Network is proposed for accurately classifying silkworm images into six different classes, including healthy and diseased states. It uses residual blocks for deep feature extraction and attention to focus on disease related features. A novel Integrated Adaptive Momentum Optimizer was introduced to enhance convergence and improve training efficiency. The dataset of silkworm images underwent preprocessing techniques such as normalization, resizing, and noise reduction, along with augmentation strategies to improve data quality and diversity. It is optimized using IAMO, achieved an accuracy of 98.67%.The integration of spatial and channel wise attention mechanisms, coupled with IAMO, significantly enhanced the model ability to recognize subtle differences between classes. Results indicate that HRAN can be used to detect disease at an early stage in sericulture, and future work will enhance scalability and efficiency in different environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出混合残差注意力网络（HRAN）用于蚕图像六分类，并引入集成自适应动量优化器（IAMO），准确率达98.67%。
AI.motivation: 蚕业中病害的早期检测对生产至关重要，而传统方法难以准确区分健康与患病状态及细微类别差异，因此需要高精度的图像分类模型。
AI.method: 采用残差块进行深层特征提取，结合空间与通道注意力机制聚焦病害相关特征；数据经归一化、缩放、降噪及增强处理；引入集成自适应动量优化器（IAMO）提升收敛性与训练效率。
AI.result: 模型在蚕图像六分类任务上使用IAMO优化，取得98.67%的准确率；空间与通道注意力结合IAMO显著提升了模型识别类间细微差异的能力。
AI.conclusion: HRAN可用于蚕业病害的早期检测，未来工作将提升其在不同环境下的可扩展性与效率。

title: RewardVerse: Rubric-Guided Policy Optimization for Video Reward Modeling
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) is vital for optimizing video generation models, with a robust reward model (RM) serving as the cornerstone. However, existing video reward models often produce unstable scalar scores because they directly map complex, subjective video quality into a single score without explicit evaluation criteria. This leads to scalar drift, where the scoring scale collapses or shifts across different prompts, making the reward unreliable for RL. Drawing inspiration from professional human annotation engineering, we address this problem with RewardVerse, a rubric-based video reward framework that introduces a dynamic rubric as an intermediate representation between the evaluation query and the scorer. Instead of unconstrained direct scoring, RewardVerse first generates explicit evaluation criteria and then performs rubric-guided scoring, providing a stable semantic anchor that mitigates scalar drift. To efficiently optimize this collaborative pipeline, we propose Rubric-Guided Policy Optimization (RGPO), a two-stage training algorithm. RGPO first warms up the scorer using self-evolving seed rubrics and then jointly optimizes the rubric generator to produce query-adaptive evaluation criteria while continuously aligning the scorer with human ratings. Extensive experiments on the 16-dimensional EvalVerse benchmark and external datasets demonstrate that RewardVerse mitigates scalar drift, achieves state-of-the-art performance on both pointwise and pairwise evaluation, and provides a robust and interpretable reward signal for RL in video generation.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出RewardVerse，一种基于评分量表（rubric）的视频奖励框架，通过在评估查询与打分器之间引入动态rubric作为中间表示，并配合Rubric-Guided Policy Optimization (RGPO)两阶段训练算法，缓解奖励模型的标量漂移问题，为视频生成模型的强化学习提供稳定、可解释的奖励信号。
AI.motivation: 强化学习对视频生成模型优化至关重要，其核心依赖鲁棒的奖励模型。然而现有视频奖励模型常输出不稳定的标量分数：它们在没有显式评估标准的情况下，直接将复杂、主观的视频质量映射为单一分数，导致标量漂移（scalar drift），即评分尺度在不同prompt间坍塌或偏移，使奖励信号对RL不可靠。受专业人工标注工程启发，作者希望引入显式评估标准作为语义锚点来稳定打分。
AI.method: 提出RewardVerse，一个基于rubric的视频奖励框架，将动态rubric作为评估查询与打分器之间的中间表示：先为每个查询生成显式评估标准，再进行rubric引导的打分，而非无约束直接打分，从而提供稳定的语义锚点以缓解标量漂移。为高效优化该协作流程，提出Rubric-Guided Policy Optimization (RGPO)两阶段训练算法：第一阶段用自演化种子rubric预热打分器；第二阶段联合优化rubric生成器以产出查询自适应评估标准，同时持续将打分器与人工评分对齐。
AI.result: 在16维EvalVerse基准及外部数据集上的大量实验表明：RewardVerse能缓解标量漂移，在逐点（pointwise）与成对（pairwise）评估上均达到state-of-the-art性能，并为视频生成的强化学习提供鲁棒且可解释的奖励信号。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入rubric作为中间表示并结合RGPO两阶段优化，RewardVerse有效解决了视频奖励模型的标量漂移问题，兼顾评估性能的领先性与奖励信号的可解释性，为视频生成RL提供可靠基础。

title: Beyond Single-Model Injection: A Threat Model and Defense Architecture for Prompt Injection in Multi-Agent Systems
comment: Accepted at the AIWILD Workshop, ICML 2026. Camera-ready version
summary: Existing prompt injection research focuses on single-model chatbot scenarios, where an attacker manipulates one LLM through crafted input. Multi-agent systems amplify this threat through three mechanisms absent from single-model settings: inter-agent message passing creates injection channels invisible to perimeter defenses, shared tool access enables privilege escalation across agent boundaries, and trust propagation allows a compromised agent to influence upstream orchestrators. We construct a threat model enumerating 14 attack vectors across four categories: direct injection via user input (3 vectors), indirect injection via tool outputs (4 vectors), inter-agent injection via message passing (4 vectors), and cascading injection through orchestrator manipulation (3 vectors). Testing all 14 vectors against a 6-agent production-representative system, we find that 67% of agents are vulnerable to at least one scope violation even with system-prompt-level guardrails, and indirect injection via tool outputs succeeds in 43% of attempts. Four architectural defenses reduce overall injection success from 31.2% to 4.2%: message signing with provenance tracking (inter-agent injection down 91%), input/output sanitization at agent boundaries (indirect injection down 78%), privilege-scoped tool access per agent role (privilege escalation eliminated entirely), and anomaly detection on inter-agent communication patterns (84% of cascading attempts caught).

AI.tldr: 本文研究多智能体系统中的提示注入威胁，构建了涵盖4类14种攻击向量的威胁模型。在6智能体系统上测试表明，67%的智能体易受权限越界攻击，工具输出间接注入成功率43%；四种架构防御将整体注入成功率从31.2%降至4.2%。
AI.motivation: 现有提示注入研究聚焦于单模型聊天机器人场景，即攻击者通过精心构造的输入操纵单个LLM。而多智能体系统通过三种单模型场景中不存在的机制放大了这一威胁：智能体间消息传递形成对边界防御不可见的注入通道、共享工具访问使权限提升可跨智能体边界发生、信任传播使被攻陷的智能体能够影响上游编排器。因此需要针对多智能体场景系统性地刻画攻击面并验证防御有效性。
AI.method: 构建威胁模型，枚举四大类共14种攻击向量：用户输入直接注入（3种）、工具输出间接注入（4种）、消息传递的智能体间注入（4种）、通过编排器操纵的级联注入（3种）。在具有生产代表性的6智能体系统上测试全部14种向量，并评估四种架构防御：带溯源追踪的消息签名、智能体边界处的输入/输出净化、按角色划分的权限受限工具访问、智能体间通信模式异常检测。
AI.result: 67%的智能体即使有系统提示级护栏也至少对一种权限越界攻击易感；通过工具输出的间接注入在43%的尝试中成功。四种架构防御将整体注入成功率从31.2%降至4.2%：消息签名与溯源追踪使智能体间注入下降91%，边界输入/输出净化使间接注入下降78%，按角色权限限定工具访问彻底消除权限提升，通信模式异常检测捕获84%的级联攻击尝试。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体系统显著放大提示注入风险，仅依靠系统提示级护栏不足以防护。需采用纵深防御架构：消息签名与溯源、边界净化、权限最小化、通信异常检测四者协同，可将注入成功率压缩至4.2%量级，其中权限范围化是消除权限提升的关键，异常检测对级联攻击最为有效。

title: CLEAR: Complex Learned Explicit Analytical Regularization for Ultra-Accelerated 4D Flow CMR Reconstruction
comment: 8 figures, 1 table
summary: While compressed-sensing regularizers enable interpretable reconstruction of 4D Flow CMR through transparent variational objectives, their hand-crafted nature is too restrictive under high acceleration. State-of-the-art learning-based approaches mitigate this, but typically encode regularization implicitly through unrolled network modules, which limits their interpretability. To address this limitation, we propose CLEAR, designed to combine the interpretability of compressed sensing with the flexibility of learned models. To the best of our knowledge, it is the first learned regularizer for a 4D reconstruction task. In the ultra-accelerated \(10\times\)--\(50\times\) regime of the CMRx4DFlow2026 challenge, CLEAR outperforms compressed sensing locally low-rank (LLR) and the popular variational network FlowVN, while using less than 10k parameters and preserving an interpretable regularization structure.

AI.tldr: 提出CLEAR，首个面向4D重建任务的可学习正则化器，在4D Flow CMR重建中兼顾压缩感知的可解释性与学习模型的灵活性。
AI.motivation: 压缩感知正则化器虽能通过透明的变分目标实现可解释的4D Flow CMR重建，但其手工设计特性在高加速倍数下限制过强；而现有学习类方法虽缓解该问题，却通过展开网络模块隐式编码正则化，牺牲了可解释性。因此需要一种兼具二者优势的方案。
AI.method: 提出CLEAR，将压缩感知的可解释性与学习模型灵活性结合，作为首个用于4D重建任务的可学习正则化器，保留可解释的正则化结构。
AI.result: 在CMRx4DFlow2026挑战赛10×–50×超高加速场景下，CLEAR性能优于压缩感知局部低秩（LLR）方法和流行的变分网络FlowVN，且参数量少于10k。
AI.conclusion: CLEAR证明可学习正则化器能在超高加速4D重建中同时实现优越性能与可解释性，并以极少参数超越现有方法。

title: AgentRouter: Heterogeneous Model Routing for Cost-Optimal Multi-Step Agentic Workflows
comment: Accepted at the AgenticUQ Workshop, ICML 2026. Camera-ready version
summary: Enterprise agentic systems that route every trajectory step to a frontier model waste 60-80% of their inference budget on subtasks that smaller models handle equally well. Existing routing solutions optimize single-turn query assignment but ignore a property unique to agentic workflows: subtask complexity varies widely within a single trajectory. A planning step may require frontier-class reasoning while a subsequent formatting step needs only a 7B model. We formalize step-level model routing as a sequential assignment problem over agent trajectories and propose AgentRouter, a lightweight classifier (12M parameters, <5ms overhead per step on an A100 GPU) that maps each trajectory step to one of four model tiers using five features extractable at routing time. Trained on 50,000 annotated agent trajectory steps spanning planning, coding, research, and data analysis tasks, AgentRouter achieves 72% cost reduction relative to frontier-only baselines, retaining 97.3% of frontier-only quality (less than 3% degradation in end-to-end task completion); per-step routing accuracy reaches 91% on minimal-complexity steps and 85% on efficient-tier steps, with 76-82% on the harder mid-range and frontier tiers. On the same benchmarks, RouteLLM and FrugalGPT (applied per-step) achieve only 31% and 44% cost reduction respectively, because their single-turn training signal misses trajectory-level quality dependencies.

AI.tldr: 提出 AgentRouter，将智能体轨迹的每一步骤动态路由到四个模型层级，实现 72% 成本下降并保留 97.3% 的前沿模型质量。
AI.motivation: 企业级智能体系统将轨迹每一步都交给前沿模型，导致 60-80% 推理预算浪费在轻量模型即可胜任的子任务上；现有路由方法针对单轮查询分配，忽略了智能体工作流特有的「同一轨迹内子任务复杂度差异巨大」这一性质。
AI.method: 将步骤级模型路由形式化为智能体轨迹上的序列分配问题；提出 AgentRouter，一个 12M 参数、基于可在路由时提取的五个特征的轻量分类器（A100 上每步开销小于 5ms），把每个轨迹步骤映射到四个模型层级之一；在覆盖规划、编码、研究、数据分析任务的 50,000 条标注轨迹步骤上训练。
AI.result: 相对仅用前沿模型的基线实现 72% 成本下降，并保留 97.3% 的质量（端到端任务完成度下降小于 3%）；步骤级路由准确率在最低复杂度步骤达 91%、高效层级步骤达 85%，较难的中间层级与前沿层级为 76-82%。相同基准下，RouteLLM 与 FrugalGPT（按步骤应用）仅分别实现 31% 与 44% 的成本下降。
AI.conclusion: 轨迹级质量依赖关系是步骤级路由的关键，单轮训练信号无法捕获；AgentRouter 证明按步骤分配模型层级可在几乎不损质量的前提下大幅压缩推理成本，优于现有多模型路由方案。

title: General Collaborative Intelligence: Architecting Cognition for Resilient Multi-Agent Ecosystems
summary: Multi-agent unmanned systems are moving from isolated, ego-centric sensing toward collaborative intelligence, in which distributed agents exchange compact features to overcome a local observation trap that no single agent can escape: occlusions, finite sensor range, and environmental degradation. The field has matured across architectural, communication, embodied, resilience, and trust dimensions, yet existing surveys examine these dimensions in isolation and rarely expose their dependencies. This review offers a unified synthesis through two complementary lenses. The first is a five-dimensional taxonomy spanning collaboration stage, communication paradigm, fusion architecture, learning strategy, and application domain. The second is three cognitive synergy conditions, Semantic Disambiguation, Pragmatic Information Exchange, and Proactive Informational Foraging, that turn cognitive synergy into operational criteria. Across these lenses we survey collaboration architectures and topologies, neural-communication co-design that treats the channel as a differentiable pipeline component, embodied action-perception loops via multi-agent reinforcement learning, and resilience mechanisms for synchronization, uncertainty quantification, and label-efficient learning. We then map these advances onto four operational domains, V2X, unmanned aerial, industrial logistics, and smart cities, and onto the safety-privacy-utility triad. To counter benchmark saturation and evaluation fragmentation, we propose GCI-Bench, a five-pillar scoring protocol with a maturity model that makes the trade-offs of collaborative methods comparable across studies. A critical reflection on reproducibility, the sim-to-real gulf, and conditions under which collaboration degrades performance identifies open challenges and charts directions toward general collaborative intelligence under real-world uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 本文综述多智能体无人系统的协作智能，提出五维分类法与三项认知协同条件，构建GCI-Bench评估协议，并指出可复现性、虚实迁移等开放挑战。
AI.motivation: 多智能体无人系统正从孤立的自中心感知转向协作智能，以克服遮挡、有限感知范围和环境退化等单智能体无法摆脱的局部观测困境。该领域已在架构、通信、具身、韧性和信任等维度趋于成熟，但现有综述孤立考察这些维度，鲜少揭示其相互依赖关系，缺乏统一综合。
AI.method: 采用两个互补视角进行统一综合：其一为五维分类法，涵盖协作阶段、通信范式、融合架构、学习策略和应用领域；其二为三项认知协同条件——语义消歧、语用信息交换和主动信息觅食，将认知协同转化为可操作标准。基于此综述协作架构与拓扑、将信道视为可微流水线组件的神经通信协同设计、基于多智能体强化学习的具身动作-感知闭环，以及面向同步、不确定度量化和标签高效学习的韧性机制。
AI.result: 将上述进展映射到V2X、无人机、工业物流和智慧城市四个应用领域，以及安全-隐私-效用三元组。针对基准饱和与评估碎片化问题，提出GCI-Bench——一种含成熟度模型的五支柱评分协议，使协作方法的权衡可跨研究比较。
AI.conclusion: 通过对可复现性、虚实迁移鸿沟以及协作反而导致性能下降的条件进行批判性反思，识别出开放挑战，并勾勒出面向真实世界不确定性下通用协作智能的发展方向。

title: Automatic multimodal UX improvement recommendations from LLM agent user simulations
summary: Evaluating user experience (UX) on live websites through user testing is expensive, subjective, and difficult to scale. LLM agents offer a promising route to automating UX testing by simulating realistic user behaviour. However, existing simulation approaches typically lack multimodality and require time-consuming manual review to extract actionable insights. We formalise UX improvement recommendation from simulation data as a structured natural language generation and ranking problem, and establish an evaluation protocol using expert annotation and LLM-as-a-Judge. We present AMUSER, a multimodal framework which simulates user behaviour and automatically generates prioritised UX improvement recommendations from resulting data. We evaluate AMUSER on commercial websites and show that its recommendations substantially outperform those from text-only simulation (NDCG@3 = 0.758 versus 0.359) at an 89% lower simulation cost. Our results suggest an asymmetric role of multimodality: visual access during simulation improves recommendations through richer traces, while providing visual inputs during recommendation generation can modestly degrade quality. We also discuss practical deployment lessons from applying AMUSER to commercial websites.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AMUSER——一个多模态LLM智能体框架，将"基于模拟数据的UX改进建议生成"形式化为结构化自然语言生成与排序问题，并建立专家标注与LLM-as-a-Judge评估协议，在商业网站上以更低成本显著优于纯文本模拟基线。
AI.motivation: 在真实网站上评估用户体验（UX）依赖用户测试，成本高、主观性强且难以规模化。LLM智能体虽可通过模拟真实用户行为来自动化UX测试，但现有模拟方法普遍缺乏多模态能力，且需要耗时的人工审查才能提炼出可操作的改进建议。
AI.method: 1）将"从模拟数据中生成UX改进建议"形式化为结构化自然语言生成与排序（ranking）任务；2）建立基于专家标注与LLM-as-a-Judge的评估协议；3）提出AMUSER多模态框架，模拟用户行为并自动生成带优先级的UX改进建议；4）在商业网站上开展实证评测，并对比纯文本模拟与多模态模拟、以及在建议生成阶段是否提供视觉输入的差异。
AI.result: 在商业网站上，AMUSER的建议质量显著优于纯文本模拟（NDCG@3 = 0.758 对比 0.359），同时模拟成本降低89%。多模态作用呈非对称性：模拟阶段具备视觉访问可通过更丰富的轨迹提升建议质量，而在建议生成阶段引入视觉输入反而会小幅降低质量。文中亦总结了将AMUSER应用于商业网站的实际部署经验。
AI.conclusion: 多模态LLM智能体能够以低成本实现可扩展的UX测试与改进建议生成，但多模态信息的价值依任务阶段而异——模拟阶段受益于视觉，生成阶段则未必需视觉输入。该工作为UX自动化评估提供了可复现的任务形式化与评估协议，并给出面向商业部署的实践经验。

title: Beyond Similarity: Coverage-Aware Prompt Selection for Time Series Forecasting with LLMs
comment: Accepted to Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2026. 24 pages, 8 figures, 15 tables
summary: Similarity-based retrieval is the dominant rule for conditioning large language models (LLMs) in in-context learning, retrieval-augmented generation, and prompt-based time series forecasting. The rule concentrates on near-duplicate candidates, an issue that has motivated diversity-aware retrieval but remains unexamined in other retrieval-conditioned pipelines. We study this issue using prompt-based time series forecasting as a test bed, where a learned prompt pool is retrieved by similarity. Dominant methods in this setting retrieve top-K entries by cosine similarity without redundancy control, producing a bias toward dominant temporal patterns while overlooking rare but informative events. We propose CASP-LLM, a coverage-aware semantic prompting framework that addresses this prompt selection bias by combining usage-tracking and saturating-gate techniques into a coverage regularizer that adds no learnable parameters. On six long-term benchmarks and the M4 short-term benchmark, CASP-LLM matches or improves on similarity-based LLM forecasters on most dataset-horizon settings, with the exceptions of Electricity, M4-Monthly, and the few-shot long-horizon setting. A controlled study locates the failure mode at the cross-batch usage level rather than per-retrieval redundancy: within-retrieval diversification such as MMR does not help, whereas regularizing anchor usage across training does.

AI.tldr: 论文以基于提示的时间序列预测为试验台，指出相似度检索偏好近似重复候选、忽视稀有但信息量大的模式，提出无额外可学习参数的覆盖感知语义提示框架 CASP-LLM。
AI.motivation: 相似度检索是LLM上下文学习、检索增强生成与提示式时间序列预测中的主导规则，但它集中于近重复候选，导致对主导模式的偏置并忽视稀有事件；该问题在除多样性感知检索之外的其他检索条件化流程中尚未被考察。
AI.method: 提出CASP-LLM覆盖感知语义提示框架，将使用量追踪与饱和门控技术结合为覆盖正则化器，且不引入可学习参数，用于缓解提示池检索中的选择偏置。
AI.result: 在六个长期基准与M4短期基准上，CASP-LLM在多数数据集-预测步长设置中达到或优于基于相似度的LLM预测器；但在Electricity、M4-Monthly及少样本长期预测设置上除外。受控研究将失效模式定位在跨批次使用层面而非单次检索冗余：MMR等检索内多样化无帮助，而跨训练正则化锚点使用有效。
AI.conclusion: 提示选择偏置的根源是跨批次使用层面的锚点使用不均衡，而非单次检索的冗余；通过无参数覆盖正则化可有效改善多数设置，但特定数据集与少样本长期场景仍存在局限。

title: CLC-YOLO: A Compact Channel-Gated Prototype Network for Real-Time Leakage-Aware Breast Ultrasound Lesion Segmentation
comment: Accepted to IEEE ICAITech 2026
summary: Reliable breast ultrasound lesion segmentation requires accurate boundaries and evaluation that prevents patients or duplicate images from crossing data splits. We propose Channel Local Contrast (CLC), a compact refinement of the YOLO26 segmentation prototype head. CLC adds a fixed local high-pass residual controlled by 64 zero-initialized, bounded channel gates. Baseline and CLC were compared in five matched folds on each of four breast ultrasound datasets. BUS-BRA used patient-disjoint outer tests with separate inner validation. BUS-UCLM and BrEaST used patient-grouped validation folds; BUSI used duplicate-component groups because patient identifiers are unavailable. Group-macro Dice increased by 1.68, 3.11, 1.12, and 2.45 percentage points on BUS-BRA, BUS-UCLM, BUSI, and BrEaST, respectively. Only the BUS-BRA paired 95% confidence interval excluded zero. CLC adds 64 parameters and 0.0049 giga floating-point operations (GFLOPs). At 640 pixels, single-T4, batch-one, 16-bit floating-point (FP16) TensorRT graph times were 2.1478 ms for CLC and 2.0512 ms for baseline, excluding preprocessing and postprocessing. CLC increased group-macro Dice across all four datasets with a measured T4 forward-pass overhead of 0.0966 ms. Code: https://github.com/mfazrinizar/CLC-YOLO

AI.tldr: 提出通道局部对比度（CLC）模块，对YOLO26分割原型头做轻量精修，在4个乳腺超声数据集上以分组防泄漏评测提升组宏Dice，仅增64参数与0.0049 GFLOPs，T4前向开销0.0966 ms。
AI.motivation: 乳腺超声病灶分割既需要准确边界，也需要防止同一患者或重复图像跨数据划分造成评测泄漏；同时要求方法足够轻量、可部署。
AI.method: CLC对YOLO26分割原型头做紧凑精修，加入固定局部高通残差，由64个零初始化、有界通道门控调制。采用患者级分组验证：BUS-BRA用患者不相交外层测试与独立内层验证；BUS-UCLM与BrEaST用患者分组验证折；BUSI因缺患者标识，用重复图像成分分组。基线与此方法在每数据集5个配对折上比较。
AI.result: 组宏Dice分别提升1.68、3.11、1.12、2.45个百分点（BUS-BRA、BUS-UCLM、BUSI、BrEaST）；仅BUS-BRA配对95%置信区间不含零。额外成本64参数、0.0049 GFLOPs；640像素、单T4、batch=1、FP16 TensorRT图时间：CLC 2.1478 ms，基线2.0512 ms（不含前/后处理）。
AI.conclusion: CLC在4个数据集上均提升组宏Dice，T4前向额外开销0.0966 ms，属于极轻量精修；但统计显著性仅在BUS-BRA上成立，其余数据集提升需更大样本验证。

title: Rethinking Pivot Programming Languages in Code Language Models
comment: Accepted at EMNLP 2026
summary: Multilingual code language models transfer skills across programming languages (PLs), but whether any PL occupies a privileged pivot position remains contested: geometric analyses point to C-family languages and Go, while behavioral evidence highlights Python. We revisit this question under controls for representational anisotropy and length variation across PLs, two confounds that compromise prior cosine-based analyses. Across three code models on multilingual competitive-programming data, we study three views of cross-PL organization: pairwise PL geometry, PL-English alignment, and pivoted retrieval through candidate PL representation spaces. The results are relation-dependent. Code-code geometry reveals structured language regions but no universal center; code-English alignment favors high-level scripting languages; and pivoted retrieval favors different intermediate spaces for code-to-code and English-to-code transfer. These findings suggest that Python's special role is better understood as English-facing affinity than as universal geometric centrality.

AI.tldr: 该论文在控制表征各向异性与长度变化两个混杂因素后，重新审视多语言代码模型中是否存在"特权枢轴语言"的问题。基于三个代码模型和多语言竞赛编程数据，从PL间几何、PL-英语对齐、枢轴检索三个视角分析，发现结论依赖具体关系类型，Python的特殊性更体现为面向英语的亲和性而非普遍几何中心性。
AI.motivation: 多语言代码语言模型可跨编程语言迁移技能，但哪种编程语言占据特权枢轴位置仍存争议：几何分析指向C族语言和Go，行为证据则强调Python。这一分歧部分源于以往基于余弦相似度的分析未控制表征各向异性和长度变化两个混杂因素，因此需要重新检验。
AI.method: 在三个代码模型上使用多语言竞赛编程数据，控制跨PL的表征各向异性与长度变化，从三个视角研究跨PL组织：PL间成对几何、PL与英语的对齐、以及经由候选PL表征空间的枢轴检索。
AI.result: 结果依赖于具体关系类型：代码-代码几何呈现有结构的语言区域但无普遍中心；代码-英语对齐更偏好高层脚本语言；枢轴检索在代码到代码与英语到代码迁移中偏好不同的中间空间。
AI.conclusion: Python的特殊角色更应被理解为面向英语的亲和性，而非普适的几何中心性。这挑战了单一代"枢轴语言"的观点，表明跨PL组织是多面的、关系依赖的。

title: M3GA-Wild: A Large-Scale Dataset and Benchmark for Multi-Modal Multi-session Ground-to-Aerial Place Recognition in Forests
comment: Accepted for publication in WACV 2027
summary: We present M3GA-Wild, the first benchmark for multi-modal, multi-session ground-to-aerial place recognition in forests. M3GA-Wild unifies and extends existing forest localisation datasets, providing a holistic benchmark with synchronised RGB imagery and LiDAR from ground traversals spanning 36 km, aligned high-resolution aerial imagery and multi-altitude LiDAR covering 370 hectares, and accurate geo-referenced 6-DoF poses for precise evaluation. M3GA-Wild captures diverse forest scenes with varying viewpoints, occlusion, and environmental conditions, enabling systematic evaluation of visual, LiDAR, cross-modal, and multi-modal methods. Baseline experiments show that LiDAR-based approaches significantly outperform vision-only methods under severe viewpoint differences, while current multi-modal fusion strategies yield limited gains due to poor cross-modal alignment. By pairing aerial RGB imagery with geo-referenced aerial LiDAR, M3GA-Wild also enables evaluation of foundation models for monocular depth estimation as a cheap source of 3D geometry from forest imagery, with initial experiments revealing shortfalls of current methods. These results highlight key challenges in cross-platform localisation, including modality misalignment and severe domain gaps. M3GA-Wild establishes a new benchmark to support research in robust multi-modal localisation and long-term autonomy in unstructured natural environments. The dataset and code will be available upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出M3GA-Wild，首个面向森林的多模态、多会话地空场所识别基准，整合同步RGB与LiDAR地面数据、航空影像与多高度LiDAR，并提供6-DoF位姿用于评估。
AI.motivation: 森林等非结构化自然环境中跨平台（地面—空中）定位面临显著视角差异、遮挡、环境变化和模态域差，现有数据集缺乏统一、多模态、多会话的评测基准。
AI.method: 构建M3GA-Wild基准：统一并扩展既有森林定位数据集，包含36 km地面RGB与LiDAR、覆盖370公顷的航空高分辨率影像与多高度LiDAR、精确地理参考6-DoF位姿；支撑视觉、LiDAR、跨模态及多模态方法的系统评测，并利用航空RGB与LiDAR评测单目深度基础模型。
AI.result: 基线实验显示，在严重视角差异下LiDAR方法显著优于纯视觉方法；现有多模态融合因跨模态对齐不佳增益有限；单目深度基础模型在森林影像上仍存在明显不足。
AI.conclusion: M3GA-Wild揭示了跨平台定位中的模态错位与严重域差等关键挑战，为鲁棒多模态定位与非结构化自然环境长期自主性研究提供新基准，数据集与代码将在录用后公开。

title: Compressing 3D Gaussian Splatting via Cross-Representation Priors
comment: 14 pages, 8 figures. Accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Image Processing
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables high-quality novel view synthesis but incurs high storage and transmission costs due to dense Gaussian primitives. Recent anchor-based compression reduces per-primitive redundancy, yet redundancy across anchors remains largely unexploited. We propose CRP-GS (Cross-Representation Priors for Gaussian Splatting), a rate-distortion optimized compression framework that leverages cross-representation priors to improve anchor-level entropy modeling. First, a Correspondence-Oriented Hierarchical Structure (COHS) organizes anchors by feature correspondence rather than spatial proximity, constructing root-leaf dependencies so that selected anchors can act as informative priors to conditionally encode others, yielding more accurate likelihood prediction and lower conditional entropy. Second, Shared Feature Aggregation (SFA) extracts globally shared features from a contextual hash grid and injects them into anchor representations, factoring out scene-consistent low-frequency information that would otherwise be redundantly embedded in individual anchors. Both modules are trained under a unified rate-distortion objective to balance bitrate reduction and rendering fidelity. Experiments across multiple benchmarks show that CRP-GS achieves a favorable overall rate-distortion trade-off, yielding around 30% average bitrate reduction compared to anchor-based baselines while maintaining comparable rendering quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CRP-GS，一种率失真优化的 3DGS 压缩框架，利用跨表征先验改进锚点级熵建模，在保持渲染质量的同时相比锚点基线平均降低约 30% 码率。
AI.motivation: 3D Gaussian Splatting 虽能实现高质量新视角合成，但密集的 Gaussian 图元带来高昂的存储与传输开销。现有的基于锚点的压缩方法减少了单个图元内的冗余，但锚点之间的冗余仍未被充分利用。
AI.method: 提出 CRP-GS 框架，包含两个模块：(1) Correspondence-Oriented Hierarchical Structure (COHS)，按特征对应关系而非空间邻近性组织锚点，构建根-叶依赖，使选定锚点可作为信息先验对其他锚点进行条件编码，实现更准确的似然预测与更低的条件熵；(2) Shared Feature Aggregation (SFA)，从上下文哈希网格中提取全局共享特征并注入锚点表征，剥离本会被冗余嵌入各锚点的场景一致低频信息。两模块在统一的率失真目标下联合训练。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试上，CRP-GS 取得了良好的整体率失真权衡，相比基于锚点的基线方法平均降低约 30% 码率，同时保持可比的渲染质量。
AI.conclusion: 通过挖掘锚点间的跨表征先验并对锚点级熵建模进行优化，CRP-GS 有效缓解了 3DGS 的存储与传输成本问题，验证了锚点间冗余利用与共享特征分解在率失真压缩中的有效性。

title: MixiMotion: One-Step Text-to-Motion Generation via Asymmetric Set Distillation
comment: Under Review
summary: Iterative text-to-motion generation delivers high-quality and semantically aligned motions but requires multiple network evaluations, resulting in substantial inference latency. We present \textbf{MixiMotion}, a strict one-step text-to-motion generation framework based on offline set distillation. Instead of distilling a single teacher trajectory for each text prompt, MixiMotion constructs an offline bank of multiple teacher motions and aligns teacher and student sample sets through \textbf{asymmetric bidirectional matching}. The teacher-to-student direction promotes coverage of diverse teacher-supported motions, while the student-to-teacher direction suppresses unsupported generations. We further introduce differentiable decoded-space kinematic supervision to complement normalized representation matching with constraints in the decoded motion space. At inference, MixiMotion generates a complete motion sequence with a single network evaluation, without teacher queries, iterative sampling, or candidate ranking. On ViMoGen, MixiMotion achieves a semantic alignment score of $0.835$, outperforming the evaluated one-step baselines and approaching the $0.858$ score of its 50-step HY-Motion-1.0-Lite teacher. In blinded human evaluation, MixiMotion obtains an overall rating of $4.33$, compared with $4.50$ for the teacher, while outperforming the evaluated one-/few-step baselines. Meanwhile, generation latency is reduced from $829.58$\,ms to $9.30$\,ms, corresponding to an $89.2\times$ speedup. These results demonstrate an effective quality--efficiency trade-off for strict one-step text-to-motion generation.

AI.tldr: MixiMotion是一个严格单步文本到动作生成框架，通过离线集合蒸馏实现高质量、低延迟生成。
AI.motivation: 迭代式文本到动作生成质量高但需多次网络评估，推理延迟大，亟需在保证质量的前提下实现单步生成。
AI.method: 构建离线多教师动作库，采用非对称双向匹配对齐师生样本集（教师到学生方向促进覆盖多样性，学生到教师方向抑制不支持生成），并引入可微解码空间运动学监督以补充归一化表示匹配。
AI.result: 在ViMoGen上语义对齐得分0.835，超越评估的单步基线并接近50步教师HY-Motion-1.0-Lite的0.858；盲测人工评估总评4.33（教师4.50），优于单步/少步基线；延迟从829.58ms降至9.30ms，实现89.2倍加速。
AI.conclusion: MixiMotion在严格单步文本到动作生成中实现了有效的质量-效率权衡。

title: CrowdCue: Specialist-Cue Conditioning for Vision-Language Crowd Counting
summary: Generative vision-language models (VLMs) offer a counting paradigm in which one model produces both a count and a natural-language account of the scene, yet their raw counting accuracy sits in the range of sub-million-parameter specialist regressors. The open question is whether auxiliary guidance from a pretrained specialist can lift them into useful territory, and through which channel that guidance is best routed. We evaluate Qwen2.5-VL-7B on four widely used crowd counting benchmarks (ShanghaiTech A and B, UCF-QNRF, NWPU-Crowd). Zero-shot prompting rarely produces a parseable count, so LoRA supervised fine-tuning establishes the baseline at overall MAE 81.64. Conditioning on a P2PNet-derived density heatmap as an auxiliary visual signal fails in every encoding we tested, and an adversarial-swap protocol shows the model reads the heatmap but applies it counterproductively. We propose CrowdCue, a family that supplies the same specialist's already-integrated integer count to the VLM as a discrete symbol. The text-channel variant reaches MAE 72.04. The visual-channel variant, which renders the integer as printed digits and supplies it as a second image, reaches MAE 62.65, the strongest result in this paper and well ahead of the cue-supplying specialist alone (84.45 on the same split). In the late-fusion VLM we study, the binding constraint is not the channel but the abstraction level at which the specialist signal is delivered.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究如何借助专家模型引导生成式视觉语言模型（VLM）进行人群计数，提出CrowdCue方法将专家整数计数以离散符号形式注入VLM，视觉通道变体取得最优MAE 62.65。
AI.motivation: 生成式VLM虽能同时给出计数和自然语言描述，但其原始计数精度仅相当于参数不足百万的专用回归器。研究旨在探索预训练专家模型的辅助引导能否将VLM的计数能力提升到实用水平，以及通过何种通道传递引导最有效。
AI.method: 在四个常用人群计数基准（ShanghaiTech A/B、UCF-QNRF、NWPU-Crowd）上评估Qwen2.5-VL-7B。零样本提示难以输出可解析计数，故用LoRA监督微调建立基线。测试将P2PNet密度热力图作为辅助视觉信号的多种编码方式，并设计对抗交换协议分析模型行为。提出CrowdCue，将专家已集成的整数计数作为离散符号提供：文本通道变体（文本符号）与视觉通道变体（将整数渲染为印刷数字作为第二张图像）。
AI.result: LoRA微调基线整体MAE为81.64。密度热力图条件化在所有编码方式下均失败，对抗交换协议显示模型虽读取热力图却反向应用。文本通道CrowdCue达到MAE 72.04；视觉通道CrowdCue达到MAE 62.65，为本文最优结果，且显著优于提供线索的专家本身（同划分下84.45）。
AI.conclusion: 在所研究的晚期融合VLM中，制约性能的并非引导信号的传递通道，而是专家信号被交付时的抽象层级——离散整数符号优于连续密度图。

title: Reconstructed holograms and explanation-aware evaluation for low-cost computational pollen analysis in veterinary cytology
comment: 25 pages, 17 figures, 20 tables. Supplementary material included. Submitted to a journal for peer review
summary: Automated pollen analysis supports veterinary cytology, but brightfield microscopy is costlier and more complex than lens-less digital in-line holographic microscopy. We evaluate whether reconstructed holograms can narrow this gap and whether model explanations remain reliable under modality change. Six pollen species were imaged by brightfield and holographic microscopy. Raw, single back-propagation and iterative phase retrieval holograms were evaluated with YOLOv26s detection and MobileNetV4 classification after anchor-based annotation transfer. Six attribution methods were assessed for spatial grounding and faithfulness with the Attribution Health Inspection and Repair (AHIR) protocol, which tests model brittleness under weak noise and corrects attribution-map granularity when needed. Brightfield achieved 0.6890 mAP50-95 (0.8865 mAP50) for detection and 0.9687 macro-F1 (0.9705 accuracy) for classification. Reconstructed holograms narrowed the gap with a task-dependent split: p-type was strongest for detection at 0.5324 mAP50-95 (0.8229 mAP50), while r-type was strongest for classification at 0.7695 macro-F1 (0.7866 accuracy), both far above raw-hologram baselines. Activation-based explanations localized strongly on grains, and region-based methods retained ~60 to ~80% of faithfulness under holography. The holographic detector was highly brittle to weak perturbations, saturating deletion-based evaluation while insertion remained informative. Pixel-level gradient explanations approached random floor, yet spatial smoothing restored p-type gradient faithfulness from 0.05 to 0.51. For holographic classification, perturbation-based explanations remained faithful while gradient-based methods fell below random floor. Reconstruction improves low-cost holographic pollen analysis, while AHIR distinguishes genuine attribution failure from artifacts caused by model brittleness and map granularity.

AI.tldr: 该论文比较明场与无透镜数字全息显微在花粉自动分析中的表现，发现全息重建可缩小两类模态的差距，并通过AHIR协议揭示模型脆弱性与归因图粒度会干扰可解释性评估，经修正后部分梯度解释恢复可信度。
AI.motivation: 明场显微镜虽支持兽医细胞学中的自动化花粉分析，但其成本和复杂度高于无透镜数字全息显微。作者希望检验全息重建能否缩小这一模态差距，以及在模态转换下模型解释是否仍然可靠。
AI.method: 对六种花粉分别用明场和全息显微成像。原始全息、单次反向传播重建和迭代相位恢复全息图均经基于锚框的标注迁移后，用YOLOv26s做检测、MobileNetV4做分类。采用AHIR协议评估六种归因方法的空间定位与忠实性，包括弱噪声下的模型脆弱性测试，并在需要时修正归因图粒度。
AI.result: 明场检测为0.6890 mAP50-95（0.8865 mAP50），分类为0.9687 macro-F1（0.9705准确率）。重建全息缩小差距且呈任务依赖：p-type检测最强，为0.5324 mAP50-95（0.8229 mAP50）；r-type分类最强，为0.7695 macro-F1（0.7866准确率），均远高于原始全息基线。基于激活的解释能在花粉粒上强定位，区域方法在全息下保留约60%~80%忠实性。全息检测器对弱扰动高度脆弱，使删除式评估饱和，而插入式仍有信息量。像素级梯度解释接近随机下限，但空间平滑将p-type梯度忠实性从0.05提升至0.51。全息分类中扰动式解释仍忠实，梯度方法则低于随机下限。
AI.conclusion: 重建能改善低成本全息花粉分析；AHIR可区分真实的归因失败与模型脆弱性、归因图粒度造成的伪影。

title: SomaNet: Weakly Supervised Learning for Instance Soma Segmentation in 3D Electron Microscopy with Partial Annotations
comment: 10 pages, 7 figures, 1 table,
summary: Soma instance segmentation, i.e., identifying and delineating individual cell somas as distinct instances, is crucial for cellular analysis and connectomic reconstruction. Three-dimensional electron microscopy (3D EM) provides nanometer-scale resolution for capturing fine-grained soma morphology. However, dense instance-level manual annotation is prohibitively costly, limiting the scalability of fully supervised methods. To address this challenge, we propose SomaNet, a weakly supervised framework for 3D EM soma instance segmentation under partial annotation constraints. SomaNet adopts a teacher--student learning paradigm tailored to partial labels. The teacher is trained using partially annotated data to generate pseudo-labels, while the student jointly learns from the partial ground-truth annotations and the generated pseudo-labels, progressively recovering dense instance segmentations. To accurately delineate cell somas under limited supervision with varying instance counts, SomaNet incorporates affinity learning, which encourages high similarity within instances and low similarity across instance boundaries. Semantic-guided affinity decoding and 2D-to-3D reconstruction then produce volumetrically consistent 3D soma instances while preserving the large receptive fields of 2D backbones. The framework is architecture-flexible and supports diverse backbones, including vision transformers and foundation models, enabling direct transfer of pretrained visual representations to volumetric EM segmentation. Experiments on 3D EM brain datasets demonstrate that SomaNet achieves accurate and robust soma instance segmentation across regions with diverse soma morphologies under partial annotation. Code is available at https://github.com/mkhateri/SomaNet.

AI.tldr: 提出SomaNet，一种面向部分标注约束下3D EM胞体实例分割的弱监督框架，采用师生学习范式结合亲和力学习，实现从部分标注递归恢复稠密实例分割，并在多形态胞体区域取得稳健准确结果。
AI.motivation: 胞体实例分割对细胞分析和连接组重建至关重要，3D EM虽提供纳米级分辨率以捕捉精细胞体形态，但稠密的实例级人工标注成本极高，限制了全监督方法的可扩展性，因此需要能在部分标注下工作的弱监督方案。
AI.method: SomaNet采用面向部分标签的教师-学生学习范式：教师用部分标注数据训练以生成伪标签，学生同时从部分真值标注和伪标签中学习，逐步恢复稠密实例分割。为在有限监督和实例数目变化下准确勾画胞体，引入亲和力学习，促使实例内部高相似、跨实例边界低相似；再通过语义引导的亲和力解码与2D到3D重建，在保留2D骨干大感受野的同时生成体一致的3D胞体实例。框架架构灵活，支持ViT和基础模型等多种骨干，可将预训练视觉表征直接迁移到体EM分割。
AI.result: 在3D EM脑数据集上的实验表明，SomaNet在部分标注条件下，于胞体形态多样的多个区域均能实现准确、稳健的胞体实例分割。
AI.conclusion: SomaNet验证了师生伪标签机制与亲和力学习在部分标注3D EM胞体实例分割中的有效性，具备架构灵活性和预训练表征迁移能力，代码已开源。

title: BrainIAC: Interactive 3D Brain Lesion Segmentation across Heterogeneous MRI Modalities with Online Adaptation
summary: Brain lesion segmentation is a fundamental task in medical image analysis, playing a critical role in diagnosis, treatment planning, and longitudinal disease monitoring. Yet existing models still struggle to meet the demands of real clinical use, where deployments contain data distribution shifts, arising from differences in scanner hardware, imaging protocol (varying MRI modality sets), and new pathologies. We present BrainIAC (Brain lesion Interactive Adaptive Continuously learning segmentation), a unified framework that integrates (i) a multi-modal backbone network trained to segment multiple types of brain lesions and handle heterogeneous sets of modalities via zero-filling and random modality dropping; (ii) 3D interactive segmentation with bounding-box and click prompts that preserves fully automatic prediction when no prompt is given; and (iii) an online adaptation mechanism combining Mid-Interaction adaptation and Post-Interaction adaptation, supervised by the network's own predictions as pseudo labels and guided by an extra Click-Centered Gaussian loss. To our knowledge, this is one of the first 3D online adaptation methods for interactive segmentation, and the first to combine handling of heterogeneous modality sets with online adaptation. Experiments across seven brain MRI datasets demonstrate that the proposed components provide complementary and synergistic benefits. The method consistently outperforms existing approaches and generalizes well across heterogeneous imaging modalities, including those unseen during training, as well as previously unseen brain pathology types. The code and a 3D Slicer plug-in will be released at https://github.com/WenTXuL/BrainIAC upon publication.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BrainIAC统一框架，用于脑病灶分割，集成多模态骨干网络、3D交互式分割与在线自适应机制，可应对扫描仪、模态组合与病理类型差异带来的分布偏移，在七个脑MRI数据集上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 临床部署中脑病灶分割模型面临数据分布偏移：扫描仪硬件不同、成像协议（MRI模态组合）各异，以及新出现的病理类型。现有模型难以满足真实临床使用需求，因此需要一种能同时处理异构模态集合并具备在线自适应能力的统一方案。
AI.method: BrainIAC框架包含三个部分：(i) 多模态骨干网络，通过零填充（zero-filling）和随机模态丢弃（random modality dropping）处理异构模态集合并分割多种脑病灶；(ii) 3D交互式分割，支持边界框与点击提示，且在无提示时保持全自动预测；(iii) 在线自适应机制，结合交互中自适应（Mid-Interaction）与交互后自适应（Post-Interaction），以网络自身预测作为伪标签进行监督，并由额外的点击中心高斯损失（Click-Centered Gaussian loss）引导。
AI.result: 在七个脑MRI数据集上的实验表明，各组件具有互补且协同的增益；方法持续优于现有方法，并在训练中未见过的异构成像模态以及未见过的脑病理类型上均表现良好。作者称这是首批面向交互式分割的3D在线自适应方法之一，也是首个将异构模态集合处理与在线自适应相结合的方法。
AI.conclusion: BrainIAC通过多模态骨干、3D交互式分割与在线自适应的统一集成，有效缓解临床场景下的分布偏移问题，具备良好的泛化性；代码与3D Slicer插件将在论文发表后于 https://github.com/WenTXuL/BrainIAC 开源。

title: Auditing Political Alignment in LLM Assistants: Engagement, Stance, and User Identity
comment: 51 pages, 6 figures. Preregistered; registration at doi:10.5281/zenodo.21135155
summary: LLM-based AI systems answer political questions for hundreds of millions of people. Current audits measure what they say to an average user, but their behavior is dynamic. I argue that their political behavior is a set of policies over whom to answer, what to say, and whether to engage at all, conditional on the topic and what the system knows about the user. I call these policies the system's speech regime, which is how a developer settles the tradeoff between answering, accommodating the user, and refusing, each of which carries a cost that varies by topic. I derive a typology of five regimes from two dimensions, engagement and stance. I test six AI systems (OpenAI, Anthropic, xAI, Google, Mistral, DeepSeek) in a preregistered experiment of 7,500 multi-turn conversations that randomly assign the user's political identity across five topics: abortion, Catalan independence, climate change, Nazism, and a zero-stakes control (pineapple on pizza). Two LLM judges from different developers score every answer, validated against human coding, and refusal is treated as an outcome rather than missing data. Every system accommodates the user on the control topic, showing that political restraint is a policy. On contested topics the systems fall into different regimes: on abortion, GPT engages and mirrors every user, Gemma refuses everyone, Claude answers strongly conservative users 35 percent of the time and almost no one else, and Grok accommodates conservatives only. On settled topics such as climate change and Nazism, five systems hold firm for every user. The systems also infer the user's overall ideology, so accommodation can spill over to topics not yet discussed. A comparison of two Grok releases shows the regime changing between versions in a way current audits miss. Speech regimes matter for alignment research and for polarization, political knowledge, and the quality of democracy.

AI.tldr: 该文提出"言论体制(speech regime)"概念，指LLM在"是否回答、说什么、是否拒答"上随话题与用户身份而变的政治行为策略集；通过7,500段多轮对话的预注册实验，将六个AI系统归类为五种体制，并证明政治克制是一种可变的政策而非固有属性。
AI.motivation: 现有审计只测量模型对"平均用户"的静态回答，忽略了其行为的动态性与条件性。作者希望建立一种能刻画AI系统在不同话题、不同用户政治身份下差异化回应策略的审计框架，以厘清开发者如何在"回答—迎合—拒答"这一权衡中做出选择，并揭示版本更迭中被现有审计遗漏的体制变化。
AI.method: 理论层面：将AI政治行为形式化为以话题和用户信息为条件的策略集（言论体制），并依据"参与度(engagement)"与"立场(stance)"两个维度推导出五种体制类型。实证层面：预注册实验，6个AI系统（OpenAI、Anthropic、xAI、Google、Mistral、DeepSeek）共7,500段多轮对话，随机分配用户政治身份，覆盖五个话题（堕胎、加泰罗尼亚独立、气候变化、纳粹主义，以及零风险对照话题"披萨加菠萝"）；由来自不同开发者的两个LLM评判员对全部回答打分，并以人工编码验证；拒答被作为结果变量而非缺失数据。
AI.result: 所有系统在对照话题上都迎合用户，说明政治克制是一种政策选择。在有争议话题上各系统分属不同体制：堕胎话题上，GPT参与并镜像所有用户，Gemma对所有人拒答，Claude对强硬保守派约35%的情况下作答而对他人几乎不作答，Grok仅迎合保守派。在已定型话题（气候变化、纳粹主义）上，五个系统对所有用户立场一致。系统还会推断用户的整体意识形态，使迎合行为溢出到尚未讨论的话题。对Grok两个版本的比较显示，体制会随版本更替而变化，而这种变化是当前审计所遗漏的。
AI.conclusion: AI政治行为应被视为条件化、随版本演化的"言论体制"。该框架对对齐研究具有方法论价值，并关系到政治极化、政治知识水平与民主质量等现实后果。

title: Enforcing Narrative Reliability and Epistemic Pacing in LLM-Driven Detective Games via Structured Knowledge Trees
comment: 10 pages
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) enable open-ended dialogue in interactive games, but their non-deterministic outputs make it difficult to preserve authorial control, factual consistency, and the intended sequence of information disclosure. These challenges are particularly significant in detective games, where premature revelation or fabricated details can undermine the logic of player progression. We present a Structured Knowledge Tree architecture coupled with a tri-agent LLM pipeline for controlling dialogue in an open-ended interrogation game. The system separates knowledge retrieval, dialogue generation, and response verification to ensure that the virtual suspect reveals only information permitted by the current narrative state. We evaluate the approach through The Interrogation of Adrian Gale, a playable detective-game testbed, and a formal user study examining hallucination reduction, adherence to authored disclosure sequences, and perceived logical progression. Our results demonstrate that the structured architecture reduces critical hallucinations by 64.78% and entirely prevents premature narrative disclosure. While the strict mechanical constraints introduced usability trade-offs regarding forced conversational reveals, the system successfully enforces rigorous epistemic pacing and provides players with a clear, subjective sense of progression toward solving the case.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"结构化知识树"+三智能体LLM流水线，用于开放式审讯游戏的对话控制，实验显示严重幻觉减少64.78%并彻底杜绝提前剧透，但强制揭示机制带来可用性权衡。
AI.motivation: LLM支持交互式游戏的开放式对话，但其非确定性输出难以维持作者的叙事控制、事实一致性与预设的信息披露顺序。侦探类游戏对此尤为敏感：过早揭示或虚构细节会破坏玩家推理进程的逻辑性。
AI.method: 设计结构化知识树（Structured Knowledge Tree）架构，并搭配三智能体LLM流水线，将知识检索、对话生成与回复验证三者分离，确保虚拟嫌疑人仅披露当前叙事状态所允许的信息；并以可玩侦探游戏原型《The Interrogation of Adrian Gale》作为测试平台开展正式用户研究。
AI.result: 结构化架构将关键幻觉降低64.78%，并完全防止了叙事信息的提前披露；严格的机械约束在"强制对话揭示"方面造成了可用性上的取舍，但系统成功实现了严格的认知节奏（epistemic pacing），并让玩家对案件推进产生清晰的主观进展感。
AI.conclusion: 将知识检索、生成与验证解耦的三智能体+结构化知识树方案，可在开放式LLM对话中有效保持作者控制与叙事一致性，代价是部分交互自然度；该架构适用于对信息披露顺序高度敏感的叙事类游戏。

title: VDGS: Visibility-Driven Large-Scale 3D Gaussian Splatting for Aerial Scene Reconstruction
comment: 8 pages, 6 figures
summary: Large-scale scene reconstruction is a critical foundational technology in robotic autonomous systems such as 3D mapping and autonomous driving. In recent years, 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has demonstrated remarkable advantages in both visual quality and computational efficiency, making it a promising representation for large-scale scene reconstruction. However, it still faces challenges in large-scale scenes, including excessive memory consumption and uneven viewpoint coverage caused by UAV acquisition, limiting its real-world applications. To address this, we propose VDGS, a novel 3DGS framework that incorporates camera distribution into scene modeling. VDGS introduces visibility-driven statistics for scene anchors to quantify supervision strength. These statistics are further leveraged for scene partitioning and for gradient compensation in under-optimized regions, thereby promoting balanced optimization across different regions. Extensive experiments on multiple large-scale aerial scene datasets demonstrate that, under imbalanced viewpoint distributions, VDGS consistently outperforms existing methods, while maintaining competitive performance in scenarios with more uniform view distributions.

AI.tldr: 提出VDGS框架，将相机分布引入3DGS场景建模，通过可见性驱动统计缓解大规模航拍场景中的内存消耗与视角覆盖不均问题。
AI.motivation: 大规模场景重建是机器人自主系统（3D建图、自动驾驶）的关键基础技术。3DGS在视觉质量与计算效率上有优势，但应用于大规模场景时面临内存消耗过大、UAV采集导致的视角覆盖不均等挑战，限制其实用性。
AI.method: VDGS将相机分布纳入场景建模，为场景锚点引入可见性驱动统计（visibility-driven statistics）以量化监督强度；基于该统计进行场景划分（scene partitioning），并在欠优化区域实施梯度补偿（gradient compensation），从而促进不同区域间的均衡优化。
AI.result: 在多个大规模航拍场景数据集上的大量实验表明，在视角分布不均衡情况下，VDGS持续优于现有方法；在视角分布较均匀的场景中亦保持有竞争力的性能。
AI.conclusion: VDGS通过引入相机分布与可见性驱动统计，有效缓解大规模航空场景中视角覆盖不均与优化不平衡问题，提升3DGS在大规模场景重建中的鲁棒性与适用范围。

title: Attributable Post-Rationalization in RAG Citations: A Controlled Reproduction and an RLVR Comparison
comment: 11 pages, 1 figure, code available at: https://github.com/mehedikhan72/RAG-Post-Rationalization-RLVR-Comparison
summary: A RAG system can hand you the right answer and cite a source it did not actually use. Models output these unfaithful citations via post-rationalization: they write the answer first and then attach a citation to whatever passage looks close enough. Search agents are now trained with reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR), which pays them for getting the answer right. We asked whether that training also teaches them to cite honestly. Improving an existing methodology with a required control, we compared an instruction-tuned model against three RLVR agents trained from it, on four question-answering datasets, using only free-tier Kaggle GPUs. Post-rationalization is everywhere: on Wikipedia-based questions roughly one citation in seven is unfaithful. RLVR does not fix it. The agents post-rationalize at their base model's rate, and one lands slightly worse. Rewarding correct answers buys nothing in citation faithfulness, so faithfulness has to be trained and measured on its own terms.

AI.tldr: RLVR训练提升问答准确率，但并不能改善RAG系统引用的忠实性；后合理化现象普遍存在，忠实性需独立训练与评估。
AI.motivation: RAG系统常出现"答案正确但引用来源并非实际使用"的不忠实引用，模型通过后合理化（先写答案再贴看似相近的证据）实现。当前搜索智能体普遍采用RLVR训练，奖励正确答案，作者想探究这种训练是否同时能教会模型诚实地引用。
AI.method: 在改进现有方法并加入必要对照的基础上，将指令微调模型与由其训练的三种RLVR智能体进行对比，在四个问答数据集上评测，仅使用免费层Kaggle GPU。
AI.result: 后合理化现象普遍存在：在基于Wikipedia的问题上，约每七条引用中就有一条不忠实。RLVR并未改善这一问题，各智能体的后合理化率与基座模型相当，其中一个甚至略差。
AI.conclusion: 奖励正确答案无法带来引用忠实性，忠实性必须以其自身标准单独训练和度量。

title: Bridging Static and Agentic RAG for Taiwanese Historical Question Answering
summary: Agentic retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) enables language models to adapt retrieval based on previously retrieved evidence, but it remains unclear whether such adaptive orchestration consistently outperforms well-designed static pipelines. We conduct a controlled comparison of agentic and static RAG for Taiwanese historical question answering, sharing the same generator and hybrid retrieval backend. Despite similar aggregate performance, the two pipelines differ on 70.83% of questions, with their advantages largely canceling out when averaged. An oracle that selects the better response per question improves the composite score by 0.2417 over the better individual pipeline, revealing substantial headroom for question-level selection. We therefore introduce a post-hoc selector that compares the two responses and their cited evidence, significantly outperforming either individual pipeline and recovering 60.34% of the oracle headroom. These results show that aggregate comparisons can obscure meaningful question-level differences between retrieval strategies, suggesting that exploiting their complementarity may be more fruitful than seeking a universally superior pipeline.

AI.tldr: 该论文对智能体式（agentic）与静态 RAG 进行了受控对比，发现二者聚合性能相近但在 70.83% 的问题上存在差异，通过事后选择器利用二者互补性可显著超越任一单一流程。
AI.motivation: 学界普遍假设智能体式 RAG 的自适应检索编排优于设计良好的静态流程，但缺乏在同一生成器与检索后端下的受控验证，且聚合层面的比较可能掩盖问题级别的真实差异。
AI.method: 在台湾历史问答任务上，控制生成器与混合检索后端一致，对比智能体式与静态 RAG；引入 oracle 上界衡量问题级选择的理论空间；提出一个事后选择器（post-hoc selector），通过比较两种流程的回复及其引用证据来选择更优答案。
AI.result: 两种流程聚合性能相似，但在 70.83% 的问题上给出不同结果，优势相互抵消；oracle 选择较更优单一流程在综合得分上提升 0.2417；事后选择器显著优于任一单一流程，并回收了 60.34% 的 oracle 提升空间。
AI.conclusion: 聚合比较会掩盖检索策略间有意义的问题级差异，与其追求普遍最优的单一流程，不如利用不同策略的互补性，问题级选择是更有效的方向。

title: HDMamba-YOLO: Efficient State-Space Perception and Local Spatial Reconstruction for UAV Small Object
summary: Small-object detection in UAV imagery is challenged by weak visual evidence, ambiguous boundaries, dense object distributions, and complex backgrounds. Effective detection therefore requires long-range contextual information for target-background discrimination while preserving explicit local two-dimensional structures for accurate localization. These requirements arise at different stages of the detection pipeline and are not naturally addressed by a uniform feature-processing strategy. We propose Hybrid Dual-domain Mamba-YOLO (HDMamba-YOLO), a stage-wise heterogeneous SSM-CNN detector organized according to a perception-reconstruction-alignment-interaction rationale. EfficientVMamba-based EVSS establishes long-range contextual perception in the backbone, while PhasePatchMerging2D provides phase-aware hierarchical transitions. DST-Wrapper and Native C3k2-ASSAF then perform perception-to-reconstruction transition and repeated local two-dimensional reconstruction during FPN/PAN aggregation. DySample provides content-adaptive cross-scale resampling, while OS-CVTIA introduces macro-micro interaction and task-specific modulation for localization and classification. On VisDrone2019, HDMamba-YOLO-B achieves 42.737% mAP50 and 25.713% mAP50:95 with 10.042M parameters and 29.879 corrected GFLOPs. HDMamba-YOLO-Lite achieves 41.140% mAP50 and 24.741% mAP50:95 with 5.344M parameters. Under the unified AI-TOD evaluation protocol, HDMamba-YOLO-B obtains 21.621% AP and 47.881% AP50. Controlled ablations further support the stage-wise allocation of state-space perception, convolutional reconstruction, dynamic alignment, and task interaction for UAV small-object detection.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出HDMamba-YOLO，一种按"感知-重建-对齐-交互"分阶段组织的异构SSM-CNN无人机小目标检测器，在VisDrone2019和AI-TOD上取得优异性
AI.motivation: 无人机图像小目标检测面临视觉证据弱、边界模糊、目标密集和背景复杂等挑战。有效检测既需要长程上下文信息以区分目标与背景，又需保留显式局部二维结构以准确定位。这两类需求出现在检测流程的不同阶段，统一的特征处理策略难以兼顾。
AI.method: 提出HDMamba-YOLO，按感知-重建-对齐-交互的分阶段异构架构。骨干网络采用基于EfficientVMamba的EVSS建立长程上下文感知，PhasePatchMerging2D实现相位感知的分层过渡；DST-Wrapper与Native C3k2-ASSAF在FPN/PAN聚合中完成感知到重建的转换及重复局部二维重建；DySample提供内容自适应的跨尺度重采样；OS-CVTIA引入宏观-微观交互及面向定位与分类的任务特定调制。
AI.result: 在VisDrone2019上，HDMamba-YOLO-B以10.042M参数和29.879修正GFLOPs达到42.737% mAP50和25.713% mAP50:95；HDMamba-YOLO-Lite以5.344M参数达到41.140% mAP50和24.741% mAP50:95。在统一AI-TOD评估协议下，HDMamba-YOLO-B获得21.621% AP和47.881% AP50。对照消融实验进一步验证了分阶段配置的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 分阶段地分配状态空间感知、卷积重建、动态对齐与任务交互，对无人机小目标检测是有效且必要的设计原则，HDMamba-YOLO以较低参数量实现了竞争性甚至领先的检测性能。

title: From Concept Alignment to Causal Grounding: An Intervention Test of Chain-of-Thought Faithfulness
comment: In submission
summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) can sound plausible yet be unfaithful to the model's underlying reasoning. Most prior work probes CoT faithfulness through input--output behavior or input attributions, leaving internal computation largely underexplored. We instead cast faithfulness as internal concept grounding: Does a large language model's (LLM) CoT reasoning engage the same internal concepts that support the LLM's direct prediction, and do the shared concepts causally drive its answer? Encoding a prediction pass and a CoT pass with a single shared sparse autoencoder (SAE), a reliable approximator of the latent concepts LLMs use, makes their internal concepts directly comparable. We introduce three correlational metrics of concept-level alignment and a causal metric, $Δp$, which ablates the shared concepts and measures the drop in answer probability. Across five LLMs and four datasets, concept alignment is generally high, as indicated by the correlational metrics; yet these only identify which concepts are shared, not how much they causally contribute. $Δp$ fills this gap: causal faithfulness varies substantially with model depth, peaking at mid-to-late layers rather than the final ones, and model scale reshapes the layer-wise profile. Moreover, causally important shared concepts are not always verbalized in the CoT. These dissociations suggest that faithfulness cannot be reliably assessed from surface-level or representational correspondence alone; assessing it requires causal tests of whether the internal concepts underlying a CoT actually drive the model's prediction.

AI.tldr: 该论文将思维链忠实性重新定义为"内部概念接地"问题：CoT推理是否与模型直接预测依赖相同的内部概念，且这些共享概念是否因果性地驱动答案。作者用共享稀疏自编码器（SAE）对齐预测通道与CoT通道的潜在概念，提出三个相关性对齐指标和一个因果指标Δp（消融共享概念后答案概率的下降）。在5个LLM和4个数据集上，概念对齐普遍较高，但因果忠实性随模型深度显著变化，峰值出现在中后层而非末层，且模型规模会重塑层间分布；因果重要的共享概念未必在CoT中被显式表达。
AI.motivation: 现有CoT忠实性研究多基于输入-输出行为或输入归因，未充分探究内部计算。作者认为仅凭表面或表征对应无法可靠评估忠实性，需要因果检验CoT背后的内部概念是否真正驱动预测。
AI.method: 用单一共享稀疏自编码器（SAE）分别编码预测通道与CoT通道，使两者的潜在概念可直接比较；提出三个概念级对齐的相关性指标；提出因果指标Δp，通过消融共享概念并测量答案概率的下降来量化其因果贡献。实验覆盖5个LLM与4个数据集。
AI.result: 相关性指标显示概念对齐总体较高，但只能识别共享概念、无法反映因果贡献。Δp揭示因果忠实性随模型深度大幅变化，峰值位于中后层而非末层；模型规模会改变层间分布形态。此外，因果重要的共享概念并不总是在CoT中被言语化。
AI.conclusion: 概念层面的相关性对齐与因果忠实性存在分离，忠实性不能仅由表面文本或表征对应可靠判断，必须通过因果测试检验CoT所依赖的内部概念是否真正驱动模型预测。

title: LD-RSVIS: A Large-Scale and Diverse Benchmark for Referring Surgical Video Instrument Segmentation
summary: Referring surgical video instrument segmentation (RSVIS) aims at segmenting the instrument in a surgical video, given a textual description. Despite recent progress, current models are trained and assessed on relatively small-scale benchmarks, hindering the development of more general RSVIS. In addition, existing benchmarks support only the single-target expression that refers to one instrument in the video, while overlooking multi-target and no-target referring expressions, restricting the applicability of RSVIS in practical scenarios. Addressing these issues, we propose LD-RSVIS, a new benchmark aiming to facilitate more robust and general RSVIS. Specifically, LD-RSVIS consists of 3,536 surgical videos with 1.09 million frames and covers a broad set of 30 instrument classes from 25 various procedures. By including abundant videos and classes, LD-RSVIS could benefit large-scale training and evaluation of more general RSVIS methods. Besides, unlike existing datasets, LD-RSVIS offers diverse referring settings, including no-target, single-target, and multi-target expressions, which enables the development of more practical RSVIS models in real applications. In order to ensure high-quality annotations, all videos in LD-RSVIS are manually labeled with multiple rounds of inspection and refinement. To our knowledge, LD-RSVIS is the largest and most diverse benchmark for RSVIS. To analyze LD-RSVIS and to provide comparison for future research, we evaluate 12 representative methods, and the results reveal that more efforts are required for improvements. To encourage future research, we present a simple yet effective RSVIS method, dubbed Cascade-RSVIS, that first mines target-specific cues using the complementary multi-cue text information and then employs such cues and textual information for segmentation, achieving promising performance. Our benchmark and code will be released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LD-RSVIS，一个大规模、多样化的指代外科视频器械分割（RSVIS）基准，包含3536个视频、109万帧、30类器械及25种术式，并首次支持无目标、单目标和多目标指代表达，同时提出Cascade-RSVIS方法。
AI.motivation: 现有RSVIS方法与评估仅基于小规模基准，且只支持指向单个器械的单目标表达，忽视了多目标与无目标表达，限制了RSVIS在实际场景中的通用性与适用性。
AI.method: 构建LD-RSVIS基准：3536个外科视频、109万帧、30类器械、25种术式，经多轮人工标注与复核；提供无目标、单目标、多目标三类指代设置；评估12种代表性方法；并提出Cascade-RSVIS方法——先利用互补的多线索文本信息挖掘目标特定线索，再结合该线索与文本信息进行分割。
AI.result: LD-RSVIS是迄今最大且最多样化的RSVIS基准。对12种代表性方法的评估结果显示，现有方法仍有较大提升空间；Cascade-RSVIS取得了有前景的性能。
AI.conclusion: LD-RSVIS可支撑大规模训练与评估，推动更通用、更实用的RSVIS模型发展；Cascade-RSVIS为未来研究提供了简洁有效的参考方案，基准与代码将公开。

title: Tutoring Large Language Models to be Domain-adaptive, Precise and Safe
comment: This is a preprint of a PhD thesis submitted to IIT KGP. The final, official version of record is available through the university's institutional repository
summary: This thesis proposes a framework for "responsible intelligence" to address AI's critical challenges in safety, ethics, and cultural sensitivity. It advances three core areas: First, it improves domain adaptation in specialized fields using active learning and graph-based knowledge to reduce hallucinations. Second, it enhances ethical rigor via a novel decoding-time alignment mechanism that proactively blocks harmful text generation in real-time. Finally, it ensures cultural and multilingual safety through language-specific steering that respects diverse linguistic and social norms. Ultimately, this work provides a blueprint for building next-generation AI that is contextually knowledgeable, ethically sound, and culturally adaptable.

AI.tldr: 本论文提出"负责任智能"框架，从领域适应、伦理对齐、文化多语言安全三方面提升AI的安全性、伦理性与文化敏感性。
AI.motivation: AI在安全性、伦理性和文化敏感性方面面临严峻挑战，亟需一个系统性的"负责任智能"框架来应对。
AI.method: 1）利用主动学习与图结构知识改进专业领域的域适应，减少幻觉；2）提出一种新的解码时对齐机制，实时主动阻断有害文本生成，增强伦理严谨性；3）通过语言特定的引导（language-specific steering）保障文化与多语言安全，尊重语言与社会规范差异。
AI.result: 在三个核心方向取得进展：降低专业领域幻觉、实时阻断有害生成、实现尊重多样语言与社会规范的文化与多语言安全。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为构建兼具情境知识、伦理健全与文化适应性的下一代AI提供了蓝图。

title: Directing large language models to follow the letter or spirit of the law
summary: The distinction between the spirit and letter of the law is a central issue across research and everyday life, and a growing concern for building safe, intelligent machines. What is this distinction based on, and how can we develop machines that follow the intention behind a rule? We used targeted adaptation that made large language models prioritize the spirit or letter of the law. With minimal modifications, our method significantly changed LLM behavior across diverse measures, novel vignettes, real-world scenarios, and influential legal cases. An analysis of model internals revealed a low-dimensional space with three interpretable dimensions matching a formal pre-specified framework for the geometry of legal concepts. These findings show how legal thought in LLMs may be organized and directed.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过"针对性适应"方法让大语言模型在"法律精神"与"法律字面"之间进行取舍，发现微小修改即可显著改变模型行为，并在模型内部识别出与预设法律概念几何框架匹配的三维可解释空间。
AI.motivation: 法律精神与法律条文字面之间的区分是法学研究和日常生活中 的核心问题，也是构建安全、智能机器的重要关切。作者希望探究这一区分的依据，以及如何让机器遵循规则背后的意图。
AI.method: 采用针对性适应（targeted adaptation）方法，使大语言模型分别优先遵循法律精神或法律字面；通过分析模型内部表征，寻找与预先设定的法律概念几何框架相对应的低维结构。
AI.result: 仅需极小的修改，该方法便在多种测量指标、新情境短文（vignettes）、现实场景以及有影响力的法律案例中显著改变了模型行为。模型内部分析揭示出一个低维空间，包含三个可解释维度，与预先设定的法律概念几何框架相匹配。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明大语言模型中的法律思维可能以可组织、可引导的方式存在，为让机器遵循规则意图提供了机制层面的启示。

title: OmniEdu: Open Foundation Models for Learning and Teaching
summary: Educational foundation models must solve problems, understand curriculum structure, diagnose learner difficulties, and provide appropriate instructional support. Existing educational language models often focus on either problem solving or tutoring, with training mixtures organized by source or task rather than capability. We present OmniEdu, an open family of foundation models for K-12 learning and teaching. Its instruction-tuning corpus combines over 100 educational resources and general instruction sources, organized around four capabilities: subject competence, curriculum grounding, diagnostic reasoning, and pedagogical action and scaffolding. Our pipeline integrates deterministic cleaning, semantic auditing and rewriting, task-specific quality scoring, token-budgeted diversity selection, and pedagogical instruction assignment. It yields 69,999 examples and 15.96M supervised response tokens, including 60,951 education-specific examples. We fine-tune 4B, 9B, and 27B models and evaluate curriculum grounding, K-12 problem solving, and pedagogical tutoring, alongside general capability. Education-oriented tuning consistently improves all three educational benchmark groups across model scales. OmniEdu-27B achieves 63.12% EM and 76.69% F1 on K12-Bench, 85.89% on MathFish, 86.95% on EDUMATH, and 78.74% in MathTutorBench's Scaffold setting. It also achieves the highest Teaching average on LongTutor among the evaluated models, at 3.02. These results demonstrate the value of curated, capability-balanced supervision for adapting general language models to educational tasks spanning problem solving, curriculum understanding, and instructional support.

AI.tldr: 提出OmniEdu——面向K-12教与学的开放教育基础模型系列，按四项能力组织指令微调语料，在多个教育基准上跨模型规模一致提升。
AI.motivation: 现有教育语言模型多偏重解题或辅导单一方向，训练数据按来源或任务而非按能力组织，难以同时支撑解题、课程理解、学情诊断与教学支持等综合需求。
AI.method: 构建指令微调语料，整合100余个教育资源与通用指令来源，围绕四项能力（学科胜任力、课程锚定、诊断推理、教学行动与支架）组织；流水线含确定性清洗、语义审计与改写、任务特定质量打分、按token预算的多样性选择及教学指令分配；产出69,999条样本、15.96M监督响应token（其中教育专属60,951条）；微调4B、9B、27B三种规模模型，评测课程锚定、K-12解题、教学辅导及通用能力。
AI.result: 教育导向微调在各模型规模上一致提升三组教育基准表现。OmniEdu-27B在K12-Bench达63.12% EM、76.69% F1，MathFish 85.89%，EDUMATH 86.95%，MathTutorBench Scaffold设定78.74%；LongTutor教学平均分在受评模型中最高，为3.02。
AI.conclusion: 经策展、能力均衡的监督数据对将通用语言模型适配到涵盖解题、课程理解与教学支持的教育任务具有显著价值。

title: MM-ContextFold: Context Folding for Multimodal Agentic Retrieval
summary: Multimodal Agentic Retrieval (MAR) requires agents to solve complex information-seeking tasks by iteratively invoking external tools. Typical frameworks such as ReAct maintain raw multimodal inputs and the accumulating interaction history in a single, ever-growing context, leading to the context explosion problem. While existing methods alleviate this issue by compressing redundant text, effective strategies for managing token-intensive visual content remain largely underexplored. To address this gap, we first conduct a systematic empirical study of approximately 10,000 trajectories. The results show that as visual cues are progressively extracted through external tools and textualized into the context, raw images become increasingly redundant. Continued image retention is associated with higher output entropy and can even degrade task accuracy. Motivated by these findings, we propose MM-ContextFold, a training-free framework that loads raw images only when needed. It maintains a persistent, text-only main context for high-level planning and spawns ephemeral branch contexts for image-dependent subtasks. Within each branch, the agent loads the relevant images, completes the subtask, and folds the result back into the main context as a concise textual summary; the images and branch trace are then discarded. Experiments on seven MAR benchmarks across five backbone models show that MM-ContextFold improves average accuracy by 6.3 percentage points over ReAct while reducing the working context length by 27.5\%.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练框架 MM-ContextFold，按需加载图像，将图像依赖子任务放入临时分支上下文处理，结果折叠回纯文本主上下文，缓解多模态智能体检索中的上下文爆炸问题。
AI.motivation: 多模态智能体检索（MAR）需迭代调用外部工具，ReAct 等框架将原始多模态输入与交互历史累积于单一不断增长的上下文中，导致上下文爆炸。现有方法多压缩冗余文本，对 token 密集的视觉内容管理策略研究不足。
AI.method: 先对约 10,000 条轨迹进行系统性实证研究，发现随视觉线索经工具抽取并文本化，原始图像日益冗余，继续保留图像会提高输出熵甚至降低准确率。据此提出 MM-ContextFold：维护持久、纯文本的主上下文用于高层规划，按需派生临时分支上下文处理图像依赖子任务；分支内加载相关图像、完成子任务，并将结果以简明文本摘要折叠回主上下文，随后丢弃图像与分支轨迹。
AI.result: 在五个骨干模型、七个 MAR 基准上，MM-ContextFold 相较 ReAct 平均准确率提升 6.3 个百分点，同时工作上下文长度减少 27.5%。
AI.conclusion: 通过按需加载图像、分支化处理并及时折叠为文本摘要，可在免训练条件下有效缓解多模态检索中的上下文爆炸，兼顾准确率与上下文效率。

title: QwenVLConnector: A Fast, Unified Medical VLM Chatbot for Fine-Grained Clinical Perception and Text Generation
comment: MICCAI FLARE 2025
summary: Most medical vision-language models (VLMs) excel at open-ended report generation and VQA but provide limited support for structured, fine-grained clinical perception within a unified interface.
