We present QwenVLConnector, a Qwen2.5-VL-based medical chatbot that unifies classification, multi-label classification, textualized detection, counting, regression, and free-form report generation under a single next-token objective. Our key component is a lightweight dense multi-layer Connector that aggregates low- and high-level visual features, aligns them through the pretrained vision Merger, and fuses them with the final visual representation without increasing sequence length. This design enriches visual tokens with complementary spatial and semantic cues while preserving efficiency. On FLARE-2D, QwenVLConnector improves detection F1 from 0.55 to 0.85, raises single-label classification from 0.37 to 0.51, and boosts report-generation GREEN by up to 18.3 points over the Qwen2.5-VL baseline. We further explore multimodal in-context learning for report generation, showing additional improvements without updating model parameters. Overall, QwenVLConnector offers a unified and efficient framework for combining structured medical perception with open-ended clinical text generation. Our code can be found at https://github.com/plnguyen2908/QwenConnector.

AI.tldr: QwenVLConnector 是一个基于 Qwen2.5-VL 的医学聊天机器人，通过轻量级稠密多层 Connector 融合视觉特征，在统一的 next-token 目标下整合分类、检测、计数、回归与报告生成，并在 FLARE-2D 上显著提升性能。
AI.motivation: 现有医学视觉语言模型擅长开放式报告生成与 VQA，但在统一接口下对结构化、细粒度临床感知（如分类、检测、计数、回归）支持有限。
AI.method: 提出 QwenVLConnector，核心为轻量级稠密多层 Connector：聚合低层与高层视觉特征，经预训练 vision Merger 对齐，并与最终视觉表示融合，且不增加序列长度，从而在保持效率的同时丰富视觉 token 的空间与语义信息。此外探索了用于报告生成的多模态上下文学习。
AI.result: 在 FLARE-2D 上，检测 F1 从 0.55 提升至 0.85，单标签分类从 0.37 提升至 0.51，报告生成 GREEN 较 Qwen2.5-VL 基线最高提升 18.3 点；多模态上下文学习无需更新参数即可带来额外提升。
AI.conclusion: QwenVLConnector 为结合结构化医学感知与开放式临床文本生成提供了统一且高效的框架。代码见 https://github.com/plnguyen2908/QwenConnector。

title: SparkDiffusion: Mitigating the High-Sparsity Trap --- A Unified Framework for up to $265\times$ Single-GPU Acceleration of Visual Generation
comment: Code and weights are available at:https://github.com/AlibabaResearch/SparkDiffusion and https://huggingface.co/collections/alibabagroup/sparkdiffusion
summary: Video diffusion transformers are expensive because attention dominates long spatiotemporal token sequences. We identify the \emph{high-sparsity trap}: at extreme attention sparsity, step-local training losses keep decreasing while terminal generation quality stagnates or degrades. The trap is one of supervision: the dominant terminal errors originate in the high-noise structure-generation stage, and terminal-aligned training corrects terminal errors that substantially extended step-local training cannot. This yields a simple staging principle: \emph{first adapt the sparse architecture into a coarse prior, then correct the terminal distribution}. We instantiate the principle as \method, a unified acceleration framework for visual generation that combines a short sparse warm-up, few-step trajectory-mixed distillation, and FP8 quantization with fused kernels. \method sustains $97\%$ attention sparsity with strong visual quality on long-sequence 720P generation across Wan2.1/Wan2.2 backbones and T2V/I2V tasks, and $90\%$ sparsity on Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B-480P. With 3-step CFG-free inference, \method achieves a $265\times$ end-to-end speedup over the 50-step CFG dense baseline for Wan2.1-T2V-14B-720P on a single RTX~5090 ($220\times$ on H100), and denoises a Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B-480P video in $1.3$s.

AI.tldr: 论文提出视频扩散Transformer中注意力训练的"高稀疏陷阱"现象，并给出一套"先适应稀疏架构作为粗先验、再校正终端分布"的分阶段加速框架（含稀疏预热、少步轨迹混合蒸馏、FP8量化），在保持高稀疏率的同时实现大幅端到端加速。
AI.motivation: 视频扩散Transformer因注意力计算在长时空token序列上占主导而代价高昂。作者发现极端注意力稀疏下存在"高稀疏陷阱"：步内局部训练损失持续下降，但终端生成质量停滞甚至退化。其根源在于监督信号的错位——主导性的终端误差产生于高噪声的结构生成阶段，仅靠步内局部训练无法有效修正。
AI.method: 基于"先适应稀疏架构作为粗先验，再校正终端分布"的分阶段原则，提出统一的视觉生成加速框架，包含三部分：短时稀疏预热、少步轨迹混合蒸馏（trajectory-mixed distillation），以及配合融合kernel的FP8量化。
AI.result: 在Wan2.1/Wan2.2主干与T2V/I2V任务的长序列720P生成上，维持97%注意力稀疏率且视觉质量良好；在Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B-480P上达90%稀疏率。采用3步无CFG推理时，Wan2.1-T2V-14B-720P在单张RTX 5090上相对50步CFG稠密基线实现265倍端到端加速（H100上220倍），Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B-480P去噪仅需1.3秒。
AI.conclusion: 终端对齐的训练可纠正终端误差，而这是大幅延长的步内局部训练所无法做到的；据此提出的分阶段加速框架能在极端注意力稀疏下兼顾生成质量与大幅推理加速。

title: An Eternal Irradiance Camera
comment: 18 pages, 18 figures. SIGGRAPH Asia '26
summary: A conventional camera uses millions of pixels to measure radiance from all directions within its field of view. We present an omnidirectional irradiance camera that measures the irradiance function---the illumination incident upon every point on a sphere. The irradiance function varies smoothly over the sphere and hence is bandlimited. We have analyzed this function in the frequency domain and have shown that it is well approximated by a weighted sum of the first seven degrees of spherical harmonics. As a result, the irradiance function can be accurately reconstructed from a small number of samples. This implies that an irradiance camera does not need millions of detectors (pixels)---just a handful of measurements suffice. This brings two major benefits. First, the camera consumes such little energy that it can be completely powered by the light falling on its detectors. Second, it does not capture the visual details needed to identify an individual, and hence privacy is preserved. We have built a prototype irradiance camera, called FluxCam, using 49 detectors arranged on the surface of a sphere. In a well-lit indoor environment, FluxCam can read out and wirelessly transmit its measurements at 30 frames per second using energy harvested from the light falling on it (i.e., without a battery, cable, or external power supply). We show how FluxCam can be used as an optical gyroscope for computing rotation, to monitor a workspace, as an untethered light probe for diffuse relighting, and as an omnidirectional pyranometer for estimating sky conditions and determining the best orientation of a solar panel.

AI.tldr: 提出全向辐照度相机（FluxCam），用49个探测器球面采样，利用辐照度函数的球谐带限特性仅需少量测量，实现无电池无线30fps，并具备隐私保护。
AI.motivation: 传统相机需数百万像素测量全视场辐亮度，功耗与数据量大且会捕捉可识别个体的视觉细节。作者希望以极少探测器测量入射到球面每点的辐照度函数，从而实现低功耗、可自供能且保护隐私的成像设备。
AI.method: 在频域分析辐照度函数，证明其可用前七阶球谐函数的加权和良好近似，因而带限且可由少量样本精确重建；据此设计49个探测器布置于球面的FluxCam原型，读取并通过无线传输测量值，能量由落在探测器上的光收集。
AI.result: 在光照良好的室内环境中，FluxCam依靠收集的光能（无需电池、线缆或外部电源）以30帧每秒读出并无线传输测量值；并演示了其作为光学陀螺仪计算旋转、工作空间监控、用于漫反射重光照的无束缚光探针，以及估算天空状况并确定太阳能板最佳朝向的全向辐照度计等应用。
AI.conclusion: 辐照度函数带限且低频特性使少探测器全向测量可行，带来自供能与隐私保护双重优势，FluxCam验证了该类相机在旋转测量、空间监测、重光照与日照评估等多场景的实用性。

title: UltraTex: Unleashing 2K Multi-View Diffusion for 3D Texturing
summary: High-quality texture generation is essential for creating realistic and production-ready 3D assets. Recent multi-view diffusion methods have shown promising results for image-guided 3D texturing, but they are typically constrained to low operating resolutions such as 512 or 768, making it difficult to preserve high-frequency details from high-resolution reference images. Scaling this paradigm to 2048 resolution is computationally prohibitive, as the unified multi-view sequence exceeds 212K tokens and incurs excessive memory and latency. In this paper, we present UltraTex, an efficient end-to-end framework for high-resolution multi-view diffusion-based 3D texturing. Our key observation is that object-centric multi-view renderings contain two major sources of redundancy: background-induced sequence redundancy and sparse token interactions within the foreground. To address them, we introduce Background Token Dropping, which removes background tokens before the DiT backbone, and Block-Sparse Attention, which reduces attention computation over the retained foreground sequence. To enable efficient foreground-only inference while avoiding reconstruction artifacts, we further design Foreground-Aware VAE Decoding to ensure the quality of the final high-resolution views. To satisfy the demanding data requirements of 2K-resolution multi-view diffusion training, we construct G-buffer TexVerse, a large-scale, ultra-high-resolution multi-view rendering dataset covering over 268,000 3D assets. Extensive experiments show that UltraTex generates visually faithful textures with rich fine-grained details, while substantially improving efficiency, achieving $20.6\times$--$91.1\times$ training speedup and $22.3\times$--$74.6\times$ end-to-end inference speedup over the baseline on common samples in our dataset. Code and data is at https://yiboz2001.github.io/UltraTex.

AI.tldr: UltraTex 是一个高效的端到端高分辨率多视图扩散 3D 纹理生成框架，通过背景 token 丢弃、块稀疏注意力和前景感知 VAE 解码，并构建 G-buffer TexVerse 数据集，实现 2048 分辨率纹理生成，训练提速 20.6×–91.1×、推理提速 22.3×–74.6×。
AI.motivation: 高质量纹理生成对逼真、可生产的 3D 资产至关重要，但现有多视图扩散方法受限于 512/768 等低操作分辨率，难以保留高分辨率参考图像中的高频细节。将范式扩展到 2048 分辨率在计算上不可行，因为统一多视图序列超过 212K tokens，带来过高显存和延迟。
AI.method: 作者观察到物体中心多视图渲染存在两类冗余：背景导致的序列冗余和前景内稀疏 token 交互。为此提出：Background Token Dropping（在 DiT 主干前移除背景 token）、Block-Sparse Attention（减少保留前景序列上的注意力计算）；并设计 Foreground-Aware VAE Decoding 以在仅前景推理时避免重建伪影。同时构建 G-buffer TexVerse 大规模超高分辨率多视图渲染数据集，覆盖超过 268,000 个 3D 资产。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，UltraTex 能生成视觉逼真、细粒度细节丰富的纹理，并显著提升效率：相比基线在数据集常见样本上实现 20.6×–91.1× 训练加速和 22.3×–74.6× 端到端推理加速。
AI.conclusion: UltraTex 通过针对多视图冗余的高效设计和大规模高分辨率数据集，成功将多视图扩散 3D 纹理生成扩展到 2048 分辨率，在保证纹理质量的同时大幅提升效率。

title: Chronologic: Measuring Language Models' Ability to Represent the Past
comment: 22 pages, 3 figures, 8 tables
summary: Language models are appealing tools for research on the past. But to trust the evidence a model provides, researchers need to know whether its responses fit the period represented. Validation is challenging, because this is not a task living people ordinarily perform, and because many questions have multiple correct answers. We use historical texts to develop a benchmark for a model's representation of English-language contexts 1831-1930, relying on pairwise comparisons to multiple ground truths and strong distractors to score the hardest questions in an appropriately graduated way. We find that generative tasks are harder than discriminative ones; in fact, reasoning models can typically discern the weakness of their own generated answers. While models pretrained exclusively on historical text lead the pack when evaluated by answer likelihood, they cannot compete with commercial models in free generation. None of the models we tested represent historical contexts in a fully persuasive way yet, but progress toward that goal is evident.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建了一个基于历史文本的基准，用于评估语言模型对1831–1930年英语语境的理解，发现生成任务比判别任务更难，模型对历史语境的表征尚未达到令人信服的水平，但已有明显进展。
AI.motivation: 语言模型是历史研究的有力工具，但要让研究者信任其提供的证据，必须知道模型的回答是否符合所代表的时代。验证这一点的困难在于：这不是普通人日常执行的任务，且许多问题存在多个正确答案。
AI.method: 利用历史文本构建基准，评估模型对1831–1930年英语语境的表征。采用对多个标准答案和强干扰项的成对比较，以适当分级的方式对最难的问题进行打分。
AI.result: 生成任务比判别任务更难；推理模型通常能识别自身生成答案的弱点。仅用历史文本预训练的模型在答案似然度评估中领先，但在自由生成方面无法与商业模型竞争。
AI.conclusion: 所测试的模型均尚未以完全令人信服的方式表征历史语境，但朝着这一目标的进展是明显的。

title: GrapeSplat: Geometry-Grounded Reconstruction via Amalgamated Pose-Free Encoding for Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting now reconstructs renderable scenes from unposed, uncalibrated images. Yet, most models supervise only photometric consistency and predict Gaussians pixel by pixel, which leaves global structure fragile and ties primitive count to image resolution and view count. To this end, GrapeSplat amalgamates multi-view cues into a voxel-aligned scene representation and decodes Gaussians directly from the learned grid, requiring no per-scene optimization or post-processing. An Atlas Encoder lifts all views into pixel-wise geometry-and-appearance features anchored at predicted 3D points. PEACH-Vox compands the unbounded scene into a bounded sparse grid through a smooth per-axis map with an exact closed-form inverse. The Sparse Decoder then consolidates the grid with sparse convolutions and decodes the full scene as multiple Gaussians per occupied cell. This amalgamated representation exploits sparse voxel occupancy, where the Gaussian count follows the occupied cells and saturates as views cover the scene, while grid resolution sets its ceiling. GrapeSplat turns unposed images into a renderable Gaussian scene in a single forward pass. Trained with 2D and 3D supervision on 8-view sequences, it generalizes zero-shot from 4 to 64 views across indoor and unbounded scenes. Code and trained weights are available at https://github.com/VAISR/GrapeSplat

AI.tldr: GrapeSplat 提出一种前馈式3D高斯泼溅框架，将多视角线索聚合为体素对齐的场景表示，直接从学习到的稀疏网格解码高斯，无需逐场景优化或后处理，实现单次前向渲染并具备跨视角与场景的零样本泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有前馈3D高斯泼溅虽能从无位姿、未标定图像重建可渲染场景，但多数模型仅用光度一致性监督并逐像素预测高斯，导致全局结构脆弱，且图元数量被图像分辨率和视角数绑定，难以灵活扩展。
AI.method: 采用体素对齐场景表示：Atlas Encoder 将各视角提升为锚定在预测3D点上的像素级几何-外观特征；PEACH-Vox 通过平滑的逐轴映射及精确闭式逆变换，将无界场景压缩到有界稀疏网格；Sparse Decoder 用稀疏卷积整合网格，并在每个占据单元解码多个高斯。
AI.result: 在8视角序列上用2D与3D监督训练，可在室内及无界场景中从4到64视角实现零样本泛化；高斯数量随占据单元变化并随视角覆盖趋于饱和，网格分辨率决定其上限，单次前向即可将无位姿图像转为可渲染高斯场景。
AI.conclusion: GrapeSplat 通过体素对齐的聚合表示与稀疏解码，解耦了图元数量与输入图像分辨率/视角数的绑定，无需逐场景优化或后处理，实现了高效、可泛化的前馈高斯场景重建。

title: CausalWM: Causal Chain-of-Thought Reasoning for Embodied World Model
summary: Embodied world models learn to predict future physical dynamics from visual observations and control signals, where physical knowledge is implicitly entangled within latent representations. We introduce CausalWM, a 16B embodied world model that performs explicit causal chain-of-thought reasoning before future video prediction. CausalWM organizes useful variables into a reasoning trajectory, allowing the model to progressively capture causal dependencies underlying physical evolution. To train CausalWM, we collect 31K hours embodied data and develop a three-stage paradigm consisting of large-scale video pre-training, causal CoT mid-training, and multi-objective RL post-training. Despite using only a limited set of supervised CoT variables, CausalWM exhibits emergent in-context learning capabilities, enabling contextual visual feature guidance and efficient few-step generation. CausalWM achieves state-of-the-art performance across language-conditioned, action-conditioned, single-view and multi-view benchmarks, including Top-1 performance on TriWorldBench leaderboard.

AI.tldr: CausalWM是一个16B参数具身世界模型，通过显式因果思维链推理实现未来视频预测，在多个基准上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有具身世界模型从视觉观测和控制信号预测未来物理动态时，物理知识隐含地纠缠在潜在表示中，缺乏显式可解释的因果推理机制，难以捕捉物理演化背后的因果依赖关系。
AI.method: 提出CausalWM，将有用变量组织为推理轨迹，在预测未来视频前进行显式因果思维链推理，逐步捕捉物理演化的因果依赖。训练上收集31K小时具身数据，采用三阶段范式：大规模视频预训练、因果CoT中期训练、多目标强化学习后训练。
AI.result: 仅使用有限的有监督CoT变量，模型展现出涌现的上下文学习能力，支持上下文视觉特征引导和高效少步生成。在语言条件、动作条件、单视角与多视角基准上均达到SOTA，包括TriWorldBench排行榜Top-1。
AI.conclusion: 显式因果思维链推理能够有效解耦并利用物理知识，结合三阶段训练范式，CausalWM在具身世界模型任务上取得领先性能，并具备涌现的上下文学习与高效生成能力。

title: Low resource cross-modal alignment using HGNN to enhance speech representation
summary: Speech-text space alignment is a multimodal representation learning method consisting to map different speech and text into a shared representation space, leading to enrichment of the representation of each modality. Proposed architectures, such as SAMU-XLSR, typically follow a student/teacher framework, with the goal of fine-tuning an audio encoder to produce representations that closely match those of the text. In this way a speech representation is semantically enriched. However, such systems generally require large amounts of training data and considerable computational resource, making them difficult to apply to low resources languages under frugal constraints. The present work proposes a data-efficient space alignment method based on Heterogeneous Graph Neural Networks and link prediction. The core idea is to leverage message passing to explicitly transfer information from the text modality to the speech modality, thereby reducing the need for large training datasets and intrinsically enriching the acoustic representations, all in a more interpretable manner. Although thoroughly explored for high-resource languages, word-level tasks in speech remain relevant for certain low-resource languages. Therefore, we conducted experiments on speech-text alignment at the word level using the TIMIT (English) dataset and Yemba (a Cameroonian language). Our approach yields results comparable to those of SAMU-XLSR, a state-of-the-art method, and even surpasses it for the Yemba language in the task of word retrieval, while using far fewer resources, demonstrating its power, frugality, and efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于异构图神经网络与链接预测的数据高效语音-文本空间对齐方法，通过消息传递显式地将文本模态信息迁移到语音模态，在TIMIT（英语）和Yemba（喀麦隆语）词级任务上取得与SAMU-XLSR相当甚至更优的结果，且资源消耗显著更低。
AI.motivation: 现有语音-文本空间对齐方法（如SAMU-XLSR）多采用师生框架微调音频编码器以逼近文本表示，虽能语义增强语音表示，但通常依赖大量训练数据和大量算力，难以在资源受限的低资源语言场景下应用。因此，亟需一种数据高效、低资源友好的对齐方法。
AI.method: 提出一种数据高效的空间对齐方法，基于异构图神经网络（HGNN）与链接预测。核心思想是利用消息传递机制，将信息从文本模态显式迁移至语音模态，从而减少对大规模训练数据的依赖，并在更具可解释性的方式下内在增强声学表示。实验在词级别进行语音-文本对齐，使用TIMIT（英语）与Yemba（喀麦隆语）数据集。
AI.result: 该方法取得与当前最优方法SAMU-XLSR相当的结果，并在Yemba语言的词检索任务上超越SAMU-XLSR，同时所需资源远少于后者。
AI.conclusion: 基于异构图神经网络与链接预测的语音-文本空间对齐方法验证了其高效性、节俭性与可解释性，特别适用于低资源语言场景，为资源受限条件下的多模态表示学习提供了可行路径。

title: LLMs as Linguistic Chameleons: Decoupling Semantics and Structure for Privacy-Preserving Communication
summary: As Large Language Model (LLM) APIs become increasingly integrated into privacy-sensitive workflows, ensuring inference-time privacy without compromising task utility remains a major challenge. Existing approaches preserve most of the original semantic content to maintain downstream performance, but this also leaves exploitable cues for reconstructing the original text. This work investigates semantic decoupling, which replaces original semantics with alternative content while preserving the structure needed for LLM reasoning. Based on this idea, we propose CROSS-MAP, a bidirectional framework that maps private inputs into a different semantic domain before inference and recovers the corresponding outputs afterward. Local models are trained with multi-objective optimization to maximize semantic divergence in the mapping stage while minimizing semantic inconsistency in the recovery stage. Experiments show that CROSS-MAP reduces reconstruction success across multiple attack settings while outperforming existing baselines in utility.

AI.tldr: CROSS-MAP：通过语义解耦的双向映射框架，在LLM推理时保护隐私，兼顾低重构风险与高任务效用。
AI.motivation: LLM API广泛用于隐私敏感场景，现有隐私保护方法为维持下游性能而保留大部分原始语义，导致原文可被重构的线索泄露，推理时隐私与效用难以兼顾。
AI.method: 提出语义解耦思路：用替代内容替换原始语义，同时保留LLM推理所需的结构。基于此构建CROSS-MAP双向框架，在推理前将私有输入映射到不同语义域，推理后恢复相应输出；采用多目标优化训练本地模型，映射阶段最大化语义差异，恢复阶段最小化语义不一致。
AI.result: 在多种攻击设置下，CROSS-MAP降低了重构成功率，同时在任务效用上优于现有基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 语义解耦与双向映射可在不牺牲任务效用的前提下提升LLM推理时隐私保护，为隐私敏感工作流提供可行方案。

title: Enhancing speech representation learning with cross-modal knowledge transfer with HGNN under low resource settings: the case study of Yemba
summary: Acoustic representation learning is crucial for speech processing, yet low-resource languages (LRLs) face severe data scarcity, limiting the effectiveness of traditional and self-supervised methods. As a promising alternative, in this work, we propose to enhance acoustic representation trough a cross-modal transfer knowledge approach, based on heterogeneous graph neural networks (HGNNs), where acoustic and linguistic entities are modeled as distinct node types within a unified graph. Through message-passing mechanisms, linguistic nodes explicitly transfer knowledge to acoustic nodes, enabling structured and interpretable cross-modal information flow. To highlight this knowledge transfer and its benefits, we measured standard clustering metrics as an intrinsic evaluation of acoustic representation, and to emphasize applicability, we performed isolated-word recognition tasks using an English benchmark and a Cameroonian language dataset in low resources settings . Results demonstrate that acoustic representations consistently benefit from linguistic knowledge propagated through the graph. To our knowledge, this is the first demonstration of explicit cross-modal knowledge transfer for acoustic representation learning using HGNNs, highlighting a promising direction for speech representation in low-resource settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于异构图神经网络（HGNN）的跨模态知识迁移方法，将声学与语言学实体建模为图中不同节点类型，通过消息传递将语言学知识显式迁移至声学节点，以增强低资源语言（LRL）的声学表征。在英语基准与喀麦隆语数据集的低资源孤立词识别任务中，结合聚类指标的内在评估，验证了该方法能持续提升声学表征质量，并首次展示了HGNNs用于显式跨模态知识迁移的可行性。
AI.motivation: 低资源语言（LRLs）面临严重的数据稀缺问题，传统方法与自监督方法在声学表征学习上效果受限，亟需一种能有效利用有限资源、并提升声学表征质量的新途径。
AI.method: 提出基于异构图神经网络（HGNNs）的跨模态迁移知识方法。将声学实体与语言学实体建模为统一图中的不同节点类型，通过消息传递机制使语言学节点向声学节点显式传递知识，形成结构化、可解释的跨模态信息流。评估上采用标准聚类指标作为声学表征的内在评估，并在英语基准和喀麦隆语言数据集上进行低资源孤立词识别任务。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，通过图结构传播的语言学知识能够持续提升声学表征质量；所提方法在低资源孤立词识别任务中表现出良好适用性，聚类指标与识别任务均验证了跨模态知识迁移的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 据作者所知，这是首次利用HGNNs实现面向声学表征学习的显式跨模态知识迁移，展示了低资源场景下语音表征学习的一个有前景的方向。

title: Environment Steering: Using Data Flow Control to Improve Agent Utility and Safety
comment: 9 pages, 11 figures, REALM Workshop, EMNLP 2026
summary: LLM agents can make unsafe tool calls even when instructed to behave safely. Existing defenses constrain agents before execution, modify tool inputs/outputs, or rely on LLM judges; these approaches may depend on model behavior or block unsafe actions without helping the agent recover. We argue that the execution environment should instead enforce safety as the agent runs and steer it toward safe alternatives when violations occur---we call this Environment Steering. We implement this by modeling the agent and harness execution state as database tables, track the record-level data flows, and check these data flows against declarative policies during runtime. When violations are detected, policy- and context-specific feedback steers the agent toward safe trajectories. On AgentDyn, this enables the agent to improve task success rate over no-defense while achieving 0% attack success rate.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"环境引导"(Environment Steering)：将智能体与执行环境状态建模为数据库表，追踪记录级数据流并在运行时用声明式策略检测违规，通过策略与上下文相关的反馈引导智能体转向安全轨迹。在AgentDyn上实现0%攻击成功率，任务成功率甚至高于无防御基线。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体即使在明确指示下仍可能发起不安全的工具调用。现有防御要么在执行前约束智能体、要么修改工具输入输出、要么依赖LLM裁判；这些方法依赖模型行为，且往往只是阻断不安全动作而不帮助智能体恢复。
AI.method: 主张由执行环境在智能体运行过程中强制执行安全。实现方式：把智能体与harness的执行状态建模为数据库表，追踪记录级(record-level)数据流，并在运行时对照声明式策略(declarative policies)检查数据流。检测到违规时，给出策略与上下文相关的反馈，引导智能体转向安全轨迹。
AI.result: 在AgentDyn基准上，该方法相比无防御基线提升了任务成功率，同时达到0%的攻击成功率。
AI.conclusion: 安全应由执行环境在运行时强制执行而非仅靠事前约束或模型自身行为；通过数据流追踪与声明式策略检查，并辅以引导式反馈，可在不牺牲任务完成能力的前提下实现零攻击成功率。

title: Euston: Training Away Mathematical Sycophancy Without Losing the Mathematics
summary: Reasoning language models are trained to produce solutions, not to refuse them, and this bias persists when the problem they are handed is false. Asked to prove a corrupted theorem, a strong model will typically comply and produce a confident derivation of something untrue. We present Euston, an 8B mathematical claim-verification model trained to resist exactly this. Training data were generated with GraphSynth, a probabilistic factor-graph generator that couples attribute-level diversity to decode-time structural masking and span-synchronized verification, yielding 3{,}026 matched true/corrupted statement pairs (6,052 statements) drawn from arXiv papers spanning 2010--2025. We fine-tuned DeepSeek-R1-8B with GRPO under a rule-based, zero-API reward for 189 steps on four H100 GPUs. On a balanced 200-true/200-false held-out split, balanced accuracy rises from 29.50% to 63.75% and the discrimination gap---the difference between the rate of calling false statements false and the rate of calling true statements false moves from -0.5% (z=-0.1) to +27.5% (z=+6.0). Critically, the gain is not purchased with general mathematical ability: AIME 2026 accuracy under official semantics is 65.00% against a 69.17% base, a difference of -4.17% that is not statistically significant, whereas an earlier run of the same recipe on a smaller GraphSynth corpus collapsed to 40.00%. Median response length also falls from 19,217 to 18,296 tokens and the truncation rate from 25.8% to 8.3%, so the improvement does not come from thinking longer. We report the result together with the confounds that bound its interpretation, principally the all-false composition of the official evaluation sets and the low precision implied at realistic error prevalence.

AI.tldr: 提出Euston，一个8B数学命题验证模型，通过GraphSynth生成的配对真假命题数据与GRPO微调，在保持通用数学能力不降的前提下显著提升对错误命题的识别与拒绝能力。
AI.motivation: 推理语言模型被训练为"给出解答"而非"拒绝求解"，当被要求证明一个错误命题时，强模型通常会顺从并自信地推导出不真实的结论。作者希望训练模型抵抗这种倾向，能够识别并拒绝被篡改的数学命题。
AI.method: 1) 用GraphSynth（概率因子图生成器）生成数据：将属性级多样性、解码时结构掩码与跨度同步验证相耦合，产出3,026对匹配的真/篡改命题（共6,052条），来自2010–2025年的arXiv论文。2) 用规则化、零API的奖励，在4张H100上以GRPO对DeepSeek-R1-8B微调189步。
AI.result: 在200真/200假的平衡留出集上，平衡准确率由29.50%升至63.75%；判别差距（把假命题判为假的比率减去把真命题判为假的比率）从-0.5%（z=-0.1）升至+27.5%（z=+6.0）。AIME 2026官方语义下准确率为65.00%对基线69.17%，差-4.17%，统计不显著（但同一配方在更小GraphSynth语料上的早期运行崩塌至40.00%）。中位响应长度从19,217降至18,296 tokens，截断率从25.8%降至8.3%。
AI.conclusion: 该改进不以牺牲通用数学能力或延长思考为代价。作者同时报告了限制结论解释的混杂因素，主要是官方评测集全为假命题的构成，以及在现实错误率下的低精确率。

title: ChemCLIR-Bench: Benchmarking Cross-Lingual Information Retrieval in Multilingual Chemical Patents
comment: Accepted to the EMNLP 2026 Industry Track. 22 pages including references and appendices; 7 pages of main text
summary: Cross-lingual information retrieval (CLIR) is increasingly important in multi-national industries, where critical technical evidence may exist in a different language than the query. However, existing benchmarks do not adequately capture domain-specific cross-lingual retrieval or the retrieval-depth and recoverability failures that aggregate recall hides. In this work, we benchmark CLIR in the chemical domain, with a focus on patent data. We construct a multilingual dataset from Google Patents and the European Patent Office (EPO) data, spanning five languages (covering major Eastern and Western languages) and reflecting the diversity and complexity of real-world industrial documentation. Using this dataset, we systematically evaluate eight state-of-the-art embedding models for cross-lingual retrieval. Our results show a substantial performance gap between monolingual and cross-lingual settings: for the best-performing model, Recall@10 drops from 0.72 to 0.53 in cross-lingual setting. Retrieval depth also degrades significantly, with relevant documents ranked lower across languages in cross-lingual scenarios. Furthermore, some multilingual embedding models that perform strongly in monolingual settings exhibit sharp declines when queries and documents are in different languages, providing practical insights for model selection in cross-lingual use cases. These findings highlight critical limitations of current approaches and emphasize the need for more robust cross-lingual retrieval methods in domain-specific settings. Our benchmark provides actionable insights for model selection and establishes a controlled diagnostic evaluation framework for CLIR over industrial technical text. Data and code are publicly available at https://github.com/MohammadKhodadad/Multi-Lingual-QAC.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了化学领域（专利数据）跨语言信息检索（CLIR）基准，涵盖五种语言，系统评测八种嵌入模型，揭示了单语与跨语言场景间的显著性能差距及检索深度退化问题。
AI.motivation: 多国工业场景中关键技术证据常以不同语言存在，跨语言检索需求日益增长；但现有基准无法充分反映领域专属的跨语言检索能力，也掩盖了聚合召回率所隐藏的检索深度与可恢复性失败。
AI.method: 从 Google Patents 与欧洲专利局（EPO）构建覆盖五种语言的多语言数据集，反映真实工业文档的多样性与复杂性；在该数据集上系统评测八种最先进嵌入模型在跨语言检索中的表现。
AI.result: 单语与跨语言之间存在显著性能差距：最佳模型 Recall@10 从 0.72 降至 0.53；检索深度明显退化，相关文档在跨语言场景中排名更低；部分在单语表现优异的多语言嵌入模型在跨语言时性能骤降。
AI.conclusion: 当前跨语言检索方法在领域专属场景存在关键局限，亟需更鲁棒的方法；该基准为模型选择提供可操作洞见，并建立受控的诊断性评测框架，数据与代码已公开。

title: SoK: Formal Methods for Fact-Checking and Information Integrity
summary: An automated fact-checking system returns a label: the claim is true, or it is false. In many such systems the verdict remains the primary output. What is generally missing is a record of which document settled the question, of what would have had to be different for the verdict to change, or of whether the same claim, reworded, would have been judged the same way. We call the missing piece a warrant: a separate statement of what was guaranteed and on what grounds. Formal methods produce evidence of this kind, and regulation is beginning to ask for it, since the Digital Services Act and the AI Act both call for auditable evidence about how systems behave. Surveys of automated fact-checking are usually organised by pipeline stage, and treat logic as one technique among many. We organise the field by what is being formalised instead, which gives five levels: the claim, the reasoning, the system doing the checking, the ecosystem the claim spreads through, and the regulatory obligation. Sorting 121 works into those levels, two patterns stand out. Most of the relevant formal machinery already exists, but it was built for other domains and has rarely been applied here, and the gap is widest for verifying the checking system itself. Several stages of the routine professional fact-checkers follow also have no stated correctness criterion, and two of them, writing a claim in checkable form and correcting a verdict already published, are not formally specified in any work we coded. We close with open problems, each with a suggested first step.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用"warrant"（保证书）概念弥补自动事实核查系统缺失的证据记录，并按"被形式化的对象"将121篇文献划分为五个层次，指出形式化工具多借自其他领域、核查系统自身的验证缺口最大。
AI.motivation: 现有自动事实核查多以标签（真/假）为唯一输出，缺乏三项关键记录：哪份文档决定了结论、何种条件改变会翻转判决、改写后的同一主张是否得到一致判决。同时《数字服务法》与《人工智能法案》均要求系统行为具备可审计证据，而既有综述多按流水线阶段组织、仅将逻辑视为众多技术之一，未能回应这一证据缺口。
AI.method: 提出"warrant"概念，即关于"保证了什么、依据何在"的独立陈述。改变综述组织维度，以"被形式化的对象"替代流水线阶段作为分类标准，划分五个层次：主张、推理、执行核查的系统、主张传播的生态系统、监管义务。据此对121篇文献进行编码归类。
AI.result: 归纳出两个显著模式：其一，多数相关形式化机制已经存在，但为其他领域所建，极少应用于事实核查；其二，验证核查系统本身这一层次的缺口最大。此外，常规专业事实核查流程中的若干阶段缺乏明确的正确性判据，其中"将主张改写为可核查形式"与"更正已发布判决"两项，在编码文献中没有任何形式化规范。
AI.conclusion: 以形式化对象为轴的五层框架揭示了自动事实核查在可审计证据上的系统性空白，尤其集中于核查系统自验证与两个未定义阶段。文末给出开放问题及各自的建议性第一步。

title: SPACE: Semantic Projection and Alignment of CLIP Embeddings for Domain Adaptation
comment: Accepted for publication at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing (ICIP), Tampere, Finland. 7 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables
summary: A fundamental challenge in deploying vision models is domain shift, which arises when training and test data follow different distributions, leading to degraded performance. This challenge is amplified when the same semantic concept appears under distinct visual forms, such as photographs and sketches, where visual similarity is weak despite semantic correspondence. Existing unsupervised domain-adaptation methods aim to align distributions across domains but often ignore semantic relationships among samples of the same class. To address this issue, this paper introduces SPACE, a method that exploits the semantic structure of CLIP's vision-language space for domain adaptation. The key idea is to use text descriptions as semantic anchors by applying Singular Value Decomposition to CLIP embeddings of class descriptions, yielding an orthogonal basis that captures semantic relationships among categories. Visual features from both domains are projected into this semantic subspace, aligning images based on meaning rather than appearance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SPACE方法，利用CLIP视觉-语言空间的语义结构进行无监督域适应，通过SVD构建正交语义子空间并对齐跨域的视觉特征。
AI.motivation: 视觉模型部署中的域偏移问题，尤其当同一语义概念以不同视觉形态（如照片与素描）出现时，视觉相似性弱而语义对应强，使得性能下降。现有无监督域适应方法主要对齐跨域分布，却忽略了同类样本间的语义关系。
AI.method: SPACE利用CLIP视觉-语言空间的语义结构：以文本描述作为语义锚点，对类描述的CLIP嵌入进行奇异值分解（SVD），得到一个捕捉类别间语义关系的正交基（语义子空间）；随后将两个域的视觉特征投影到该语义子空间中，从而基于语义而非外观对齐图像。
AI.result: 抽象中未给出具体实验结果或量化指标。
AI.conclusion: 通过借助文本语义锚点与正交语义子空间，SPACE在概念上实现了基于语义而非外观的跨域特征对齐，为域适应提供了新思路。

title: Exact Quotients of Fresnel-Kummer Surfaces and Certified Biaxial Refraction
summary: The Fresnel wave surface governs the propagation of light in a transparent biaxial crystal. It is a special Kummer quartic, and we identify it exactly. Over the complex numbers the wave surface of a crystal is the Kummer surface of the Jacobian of an explicit genus-two curve branched at the signed square roots of the three principal permittivities. This Jacobian is isogenous, by an isogeny with kernel of order four, to a product of two elliptic curves. One elliptic curve carries the three permittivities, and the other carries the optic-axis angle. The physical family is Zariski dense in the locus of genus-two curves with an extra involution, and its automorphism strata are explicit. The identification instantiates a task-aware quotient, which identifies parameters that differ by a nuisance transformation and carries invariant coordinates and explicit strata. For biaxial crystals, two ratios of the permittivities form a complete invariant of the wave surface up to rotation and rescaling, and the four real nodes are given in closed form. At an interface the candidate transmitted waves are the roots of a quartic of exact degree four. Its real-root count, root order, and repeated-root events are decided by exact algebraic predicates, and along the generic single-node encounters of the paper its discriminant vanishes to second order. Floating-point solvers drop forward transmitted modes near the optic axes, and the certified solver does not. On exact equivalence classes, learned models on quotient coordinates are invariant and more accurate than models on raw tensors, while learned root-count predicates fail near the optic axes.

AI.tldr: 本文将双轴晶体中的Fresnel波面精确识别为一条显式亏格2曲线Jacobi簇的Kummer四次曲面，该簇通过4阶核同源分解为两条椭圆曲线（分别编码主介电常数与光轴角），并据此建立任务感知商、精确代数判定与学习模型。
AI.motivation: Fresnel波面在物理光学中刻画双轴晶体的光传播，但它作为特殊Kummer四次曲面的精确代数身份、其模空间结构以及界面透射波四次方程的精确判定问题此前缺乏统一的代数几何刻画；同时浮点求解器在光轴附近会丢失前向透射模式，学习模型在原始张量坐标下缺乏不变性。
AI.method: 将复波面识别为显式亏格2曲线（分支点为三个主介电常数的带符号平方根）Jacobi簇的Kummer曲面；利用4阶核同源把该Jacobi簇同源到两条椭圆曲线之积；刻画物理族的Zariski稠密性与自同构分层；构造任务感知商，以介电常数两两比值作为旋转与缩放下的完全不变量，给出四个实节点的闭式表达；对界面透射四次方程用精确代数谓词判定实根数、根序与重根事件，并分析判别式在单节点相遇处的二阶消没。
AI.result: 波面被精确识别为上述Kummer曲面；一条椭圆曲线承载三个介电常数、另一条承载光轴角；物理族在带额外对合的亏格2曲线轨迹中Zariski稠密，自同构分层显式给出；介电常数两两比值构成完全不变量，四个实节点有闭式解；透射四次方程实根数等由精确谓词判定，判别式在一般单节点相遇处二阶消没；浮点求解器在光轴附近丢失前向透射模式而认证求解器不丢失；在精确等价类上，商坐标上的学习模型具有不变性且比原始张量模型更精确，但学习到的根数谓词在光轴附近失败。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为双轴晶体波面提供了精确的代数几何识别与模空间刻画，示范了任务感知商在物理参数化中的作用，并表明认证式代数方法优于浮点求解、商坐标学习优于原始坐标学习，同时揭示纯学习型根数判定在光轴附近的失效。
